jobs.title: Senior COBOL Developer (z/OS) - LATAM Remote
jobs.excerpt: Workstate seeks a Senior COBOL Developer to join our team for an 18-month modernization project!
jobs.description:
Workstate seeks a Senior COBOL Developer to join our team for an 18-month modernization project! In this role, you will convert a legacy RPG II codebase to COBOL on IBM z/OS in preparation for a cloud migration to Google Cloud Platform using the Raincode mainframe rehosting platform. If you are a strong COBOL engineer who enjoys working with data and delivering high-quality results for clients, you'll fit right in at Workstate.

We aim to engage consultants who can motivate and galvanize our clients, while diving deeply into the work at hand and envisioning future projects. Our consultants are skilled decision-makers, committed to championing client visions and driving quality results.

This position is fully remote and available to people residing in Colombia or Argentina with the right to work in that country.

Requirements

The ideal candidate will have 6+ years of professional COBOL development experience on IBM z/OS mainframes. Beyond that, we're looking for some of the following skills, but not necessarily all:

  • Strong SQL and data skills, especially DB2 for z/OS (embedded SQL, query tuning, data modeling)
  • JCL, TSO/ISPF and batch processing
  • VSAM, QSAM/sequential files and GDGs
  • Mainframe utilities such as DFSORT/SYNCSORT and IDCAMS
  • CICS
  • Legacy modernization, code conversion or mainframe migration projects
  • Mainframe rehosting or emulation platforms (Raincode, Micro Focus/Rocket Enterprise Server) or GCP
  • Source control and change management tools (Git, Endevor, ChangeMan)
  • Data validation, reconciliation and parallel-run testing
  • C1 level (advanced) or higher English, written and verbal. You will work directly with US-based client teams and need to communicate as comfortably as a US-based colleague.

You do not need RPG II experience. Engineers joining the project are trained on it. Prior experience with RPG II or other IBM midrange languages is a plus.

Job Duties

  • Convert legacy RPG II programs into well-structured, maintainable COBOL on z/OS
  • Analyze existing program logic, file layouts and data flows to make sure the converted code behaves the same way
  • Develop and maintain JCL, batch job streams and related utilities
  • Write and tune SQL (DB2 for z/OS) and work with VSAM and sequential datasets
  • Take part in unit, regression and parallel testing, including data validation and reconciliation between legacy and converted output
  • Prepare code and data for rehosting on GCP with the Raincode compiler and runtime
  • Document converted programs, data dependencies and technical decisions
  • Work with the client's technical and migration teams in an Agile setting

kurzbeschreibung

Wenn du bereit bist, die digitale Landschaft zu verändern, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen – auch ohne konkrete Stellenausschreibung.

Was bietet dir unser Talentpool?
Wenn du dich initiativ bei uns bewirbst, wirst du Teil unseres Talentpools – einer exklusiven Gruppe von Talenten, die wir bei passenden neuen Positionen direkt ansprechen. So verpasst du keine Chance, dein Know-how bei PROLOGA einzubringen. Sobald sich eine Möglichkeit ergibt, die zu deinen Fähigkeiten und Interessen passt, wirst du von uns als Erste/r kontaktiert.
Du hast aber nicht nur die Möglichkeit, auf zukünftige Stellenangebote zu warten: Wir schätzen den offenen Austausch und freuen uns auf inspirierende Gespräche, die vielleicht ganz neue Wege eröffnen – denn oft entstehen die besten Ideen, wenn man gemeinsam nach vorn blickt.
Bist du bereit für deine nächste Herausforderung?
Wir sind immer neugierig auf Menschen, die die Zukunft der IT aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wenn du glaubst, dass du gut zu uns passt, dann werde Teil unseres Talentpools. Erzähle uns mehr über dich und deine Talente – wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

dein profil

Was du mitbringen solltest?
Leidenschaft für das, was du tust: Egal, ob du ein Technik-Experte, kreativer Kopf oder strategischer Denker bist – was zählt, ist dein Antrieb, etwas zu bewegen.
Neugier und Offenheit: Du bist bereit, dich auf neue Herausforderungen einzulassen und den Wandel aktiv mitzugestalten.
Eigeninitiative: Selbst wenn es noch keine konkrete Stelle gibt, weißt du, was du kannst und möchtest das bei uns einbringen.
Teamgeist: Bei PROLOGA arbeiten wir zusammen – denn die besten Ergebnisse erreichen wir als Team.

warum wir?

Unsere Arbeit ist weit mehr als nur das Entwickeln von Software oder das Lösen technischer Probleme. Bei PROLOGA glauben wir daran, dass Technologie echte Veränderungen bewirken kann – in Unternehmen, in Prozessen und im Leben der Menschen. Ob in der Anwendungsentwicklung, im IT-Consulting, im Vertrieb oder Marketing: Wir suchen kreative Köpfe, die über den Tellerrand hinausblicken und die digitale Zukunft mitgestalten wollen.
Bei uns erwartet dich eine dynamische Arbeitsumgebung, in der du wachsen und deine Fähigkeiten stetig weiterentwickeln kannst. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, dass sich jeder bei uns wohlfühlt und sich einbringen kann – egal ob im operativen Tagesgeschäft, bei spannenden Projekten oder durch kreative Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen.
Zusammen schaffen wir Lösungen, die Unternehmen effizienter machen und Menschen in ihrer Arbeit unterstützen. Ob in der Entwicklung, IT-Beratung oder anderen Bereichen – bei PROLOGA bist du nicht nur Teil eines Unternehmens, sondern Teil eines Teams, das an einem gemeinsamen Ziel arbeitet.

jobs.description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS:

As the Sr. Sourcing Manager, you will lead a team of Sourcing Specialists based in India responsible for executing Direct Material sourcing activities across MKS. You will oversee the broader sourcing portfolio, set priorities, allocate resources, and ensure the team is positioned to deliver cost, supply continuity, and business objectives.


You’ll report to the Global NPI and Sourcing Director and work closely with Category Managers, Engineering, Quality, NPI, Procurement, Should-Cost, Supplier Development, and other business stakeholders. While Sourcing Specialists lead and execute individual sourcing projects, you will orchestrate activities across the portfolio by aligning priorities and resources, providing sourcing and commercial guidance, removing roadblocks, facilitating cross-functional alignment, and managing escalations when needed.


You will bring strong sourcing experience, commercial judgment, and knowledge of complex manufacturing to guide the team and support fact-based supplier decisions. As a people leader, you will coach and develop the Sourcing Specialists in India, establish clear expectations, manage workload and performance, and build the team’s sourcing capabilities. You will also promote consistent application of the 6-Gate Sourcing Process and ensure sourcing activities remain aligned with Category Management strategy and broader business needs.


You Will Make an Impact By:

  • Overseeing a portfolio of Direct Material sourcing initiatives across machining, fabrication, electromechanical, and other assigned commodities.
  • Coordinating sourcing priorities based on business needs, cost opportunities, NPI requirements, supply risk, and Category Management direction.
  • Enabling Sourcing Specialists to successfully execute their projects by ensuring clear priorities, requirements, resources, and stakeholder support.
  • Maintaining visibility across sourcing initiatives, including status, milestones, risks, resource constraints, decisions, and financial impact.
  • Ensuring consistent application of the 6-Gate Sourcing Process, sourcing standards, and approval requirements.
  • Orchestrating cross-functional alignment across Category Management, Engineering, Quality, NPI, Procurement, Should-Cost, Supplier Development, and other stakeholders to support timely sourcing decisions.
  • Providing commercial and sourcing guidance on supplier evaluations, complex proposals, negotiations, and supplier selection, while ensuring cost, capability, capacity, quality, lead time, and supply risk are considered.
  • Identifying and driving opportunities for cost reduction, cost avoidance, localization, supplier diversification, dual sourcing, and supply risk mitigation across the portfolio.
  • Removing barriers and serving as an escalation point for complex supplier, commercial, and cross-functional issues, engaging supplier or internal leadership when needed.
  • Coaching and developing Sourcing Specialists while communicating portfolio performance, key risks, opportunities, and decisions requiring leadership attention.

Skills You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 8–10+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or a related complex manufacturing environment, with strong Direct Materials sourcing experience.
  • Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing, competitive bidding, supplier evaluation and selection, commercial negotiation, and sourcing governance.
  • Experience coordinating and prioritizing multiple sourcing initiatives based on business needs, cost opportunity, complexity, and supply risk.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, remove barriers, and drive resolution of escalations.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills, including supplier negotiations, quotation and cost analysis, business cases, and total cost of ownership.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and cost drivers, including machining, fabrication, and electromechanical assembly.
  • Experience supporting supplier transitions, qualification, cost reduction, localization, dual sourcing, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Strong judgment, coaching, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to guide sourcing decisions and support Sourcing Specialists.
  • Experience working with global suppliers and teams, ERP/PLM and project management tools, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and travel up to 30% as needed.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master’s Degree or MBA
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certification or experience.
  • Professional certification in Supply Chain, Procurement, Sourcing, or Project Management.

  • Ability to work remotely with flexibility to accommodate meetings across global time zones.

jobs.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through a couple of internal interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

About Intelligems

There are millions of e-commerce businesses around the world, and the industry is growing every year. Yet achieving profitability has never been harder. Most brands make guesses when it comes to pricing, discounts, shipping fees, and content — leaving 6–10% of potential profit on the table.

Intelligems is a profit optimization platform that helps these businesses succeed. We provide merchants with A/B testing and personalization tools that help them run experiments, understand their data, and price dynamically — tools that were previously only available to companies like Amazon and Uber.

We're currently working with 500+ brands and have processed over $4B of data. Backed by Matchstick Ventures, Vinyl Capital, Techstars, and founders from Klaviyo, Postscript, and Stedi, Intelligems has raised over $4M in funding. Our team is high-performing, low-ego, and extremely collaborative — and we’re excited to scale with top talent.

We’re looking for a Shopify Support Advisor to help our e-commerce clients understand, utilize, and troubleshoot our testing platform. You'll report to the Support & Implementation Manager and communicate with customers daily via email, Slack, and chat to resolve issues and deliver an outstanding customer experience.

  • Ability to multitask, stay organized, and manage time effectively

  • Experience in e-commerce, SaaS, or analytics is a plus

  • Familiarity with tools like Tableau, Looker, SQL, or BI platforms is a bonus

  • Comfortable with providing weekend support

Culture & Values

At Intelligems, we’re customer-first and product-oriented — and our success is driven by the caliber of people we bring on board. We live by these values:

  1. Put customers first

    • Be honest and transparent. Always act in the customer’s best interest.

  2. Be helpful

    • Support teammates, customers, and partners with generosity and kindness.

  3. Strive for excellence

    • Commit to being world-class at what you do.

  4. Build and develop a diverse, world-class team

    • Hire the best, and invest in feedback and growth.

  5. Have a perspective

    • Speak up when you disagree. Everyone is responsible for making us better.

  • Flexible vacation and PTO

  • Develop reusable, maintainable code using modern data engineering practices, with an emphasis on performance, testability, observability, and long-term supportability.

  • Participate in Agile delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, release planning, incident response, and retrospectives.
  • Mentor engineers, promote engineering best practices, and help raise the quality bar for code, documentation, testing, and production readiness.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data lineage notes, implementation guides, and support materials as systems evolve.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting production data pipelines.
  • Strong experience with data modeling, data architecture, ETL/ELT patterns, metadata, data quality, and data warehouse or data lake methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data engineering services such as AWS S3, Lambda, Athena, EMR or EMR Serverless, Glue, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong programming experience in Scala, Java, SQL, or similar languages used for data processing, automation, and integration.
  • Experience with distributed processing and modern data platforms such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Hive, Redshift, Postgres, SingleStore, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, automated testing, and deployment practices using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps practices, incident response, production support, monitoring, and performance tuning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data, application, and platform issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, and leadership.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience working in media, advertising, streaming, analytics, or other data-intensive business environments.
  • Experience building pipelines that integrate files, APIs, event streams, relational systems, data lakes, and warehouse platforms.
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Amazon MWAA, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, cloud security, IAM, secrets management, and secure engineering practices.
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, Looker, or similar tools.
  • Experience designing performant data models, curated datasets, APIs, or interfaces that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision making.
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, observability, data contracts, and production support practices.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations, drive clarity, identify dependencies, and move work from concept through delivery.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance delivery speed, engineering quality, stakeholder communication, and operational readiness.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, analytics, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Finland Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Zoetis, a global leader in animal health, seeks an enthusiastic colleague to join our Veterinary Medicine Research and Development (VMRD) PK/PD Scientist Team to discover and develop novel therapeutics for veterinary medicine. POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead development of scientific strategy across therapeutic areas with a focus on mechanistic platforms/biomarkers to aid in translation, measurement of target engagement, and dose regimen predictions.
  • Work collaboratively and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams to design and prosecute studies in line with the strategic direction of the project.
  • Present research results to scientific teams, management, and regulatory agencies.
  • Write sections of regulatory submissions, respond to inquiries from regulatory agencies, and maintain knowledge of regulatory guidance documents.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Ph.D in pharmacology, biochemistry, or related field with 4 or more years of relevant pharmaceutical development experience. DVM DACVCP or DVM Dipl. ECVPT is highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to design, analyze and interpret in vivo PK and PK/PD studies.Experience with biotherapeutics (protein therapeutics) is highly desirable.
  • Skilled in the use of PK and PK/PD analysis software such as WinNonlin, Monolix or Watson.
  • Must have excellent verbal & written communication skills.
  • Self-starter, able to prioritize work and work efficiently with minimal supervision.
  • Working knowledge of bioanalytical methodology.
  • Knowledge of ADA assays and assessment of immunogenicity of biotherapeutics is highly desirable.
  • Experience in PK/PD modeling and simulation such as PBPK, QSP or population PK modeling using NONMEM, R, or related software is highly desirable.
  • Experience interacting with regulatory agencies is highly desirable.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.excerpt: This role is part of a fast-growing AI company that is set to join saas.
jobs.description:
This role is part of a fast-growing AI company that is set to join saas.group, as one of our upcoming brands.

This role is attached to a future acquisition by saas.group. As the deal has not been officially announced yet, we can’t share the company name in this job post. We’ll tell you more about the company and product during the process.

We are an AI platform that turns images and text into ready-to-use 3D models in minutes, work that traditionally takes a 3D artist days or weeks. Game developers, 3D printing enthusiasts and creators use the platform to generate and edit images, turn them into 3D models in every major format, and chain it all together into their own pipelines. With more than 2 million registered users, we are now expanding into the business space, building custom AI workflows for companies such as 3D printing businesses.

Profile Overview

We’re looking for a Product Engineer who loves building products people enjoy using. You’ll work directly with our founder and take real ownership of the product: deciding what to build, shaping how it looks and feels, and shipping it end to end across frontend and backend.

This is not a role where you wait for tickets. You’ll have the freedom to drive the product yourself, used by a large and growing global user base, and a front-row seat as we move from hobbyists and indie game developers into business customers. If you have the craft and the taste, we’ll help you learn the 3D side.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Ship new product features end to end, from the Next.js frontend to the Django backend.
  • Keep the high UX and UI quality of the product as you ship new features, so everything new feels as polished as what's already there.
  • Get up to speed on how 3D models, formats and pipelines work in our product.
  • Take ownership of parts of the product and proactively propose what to build next.

Your responsibilities

  • Own product features from idea to release, without needing a detailed spec for every task.
  • Build refined, well-designed interfaces in Next.js (roughly 60% of the role).
  • Implement and maintain backend features in Django and PostgreSQL (roughly 40% of the role), integrating third-party AI model APIs.
  • Look after our servers and keep the platform reliable as we handle a lot of user data.
  • Use AI coding tools daily to move fast without compromising quality.

What you bring to the table

  • Full-stack experience: 5+ years building web products across frontend and backend.
  • Tech stack: Strong experience with Next.js on the frontend and Django + PostgreSQL on the backend.
  • Server management: Hands-on experience managing servers and working with Linux.
  • Product taste: You know what a good product looks like, with an eye for clean UX/UI and the details (animations, shadows, polish) that make it feel great.
  • Ownership: You’ve shipped a product with real users, ideally in a startup, as a founder or through your own side projects, and you’re used to driving things yourself.
  • AI Literacy & Application: You actively use AI tools to enhance personal productivity and work quality, staying curious about emerging capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply AI pragmatically in day-to-day work.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with 3D models or the 3D space (meshes, formats, Blender, ideally Blender headless or similar pipeline work).
  • Experience scaling a product.
  • Experience with serverless GPU platforms such as Modal.
  • Experience with Neon database, Celery or third-party AI model APIs.

No 3D experience yet? That’s fine: strong engineering and product skills come first, and we’ll help you get up to speed on the 3D side.

What’s in it for you

This is a hands-on editorial leadership role. The AME will shape story ideas, coach reporters and editors, and own the quality of everything the team publishes, from recurring data series to one-off investigative pieces. The AME will work closely with graphics, research and survey analysts to make sure the numbers behind our stories are sound and the storytelling around them is clear and engaging.

The AME will also help develop new data-driven series, identify datasets worth building, and help guide and shape surveys and research that are topical and genuinely relevant to our audience. We're looking for someone who can look at a dataset and see the stories that readers will care about.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of data reporters and editors, setting clear standards for reporting, writing and production across our data-driven series.

  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration so stories publish on time and meet the highest standards.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated leadership or team management experience in a newsroom

  • Comfort working with data of varying quality and completeness, and the ability to spot when the numbers don't add up

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams

Preferences

  • Experience editing or producing recurring data series or investigative projects

  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as R or Python

  • Experience with data visualization techniques

  • Legal industry reporting or research experience

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Degree in journalism, public policy, political science, economics, statistics or a related field

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, and study assistance, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Overview of Position

The Senior Real Estate & Facilities Analyst supports the Global Corporate Real Estate organization by transforming complex portfolio, financial, occupancy, lease, project, facilities, workplace, sustainability, and employee data into accurate reporting, actionable insights, and decision-support materials.

This role combines advanced analytics, data governance, business intelligence, technology enablement, and practical artificial intelligence capabilities with strong corporate real estate knowledge. The analyst develops dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, scenario models, business cases, and executive presentations that support portfolio optimization, workplace strategy, capital investment, lease decisions, operational improvement, and long-term planning.

The successful candidate is detail-oriented, technically capable, and able to communicate complex findings clearly to executive, financial, operational, and technical audiences while partnering effectively across functions and with external service providers.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Data Analytics, Governance & Portfolio Analysis (25%)

  • Collect, cleanse, reconcile, validate, manipulate, and analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple internal and external systems.

  • Maintain data standards, definitions, ownership, validation procedures, business rules, quality controls, and documentation across Corporate Real Estate data sources.

  • Monitor data quality, identify discrepancies and root causes, and coordinate remediation with internal teams and external service providers.

  • Analyze occupancy cost, utilization, lease activity, facilities operations, capital projects, sustainability, workplace experience, employee work arrangements, and portfolio risk.

  • Develop key performance indicators, benchmarks, forecasts, trends, scenario models, and ad hoc analyses to support portfolio optimization, site consolidation, workplace strategy, lease decisions, and capital investment.

Business Intelligence, Reporting & Technology (25%)

  • Build, manage, and continuously enhance centralized dashboards, scorecards, reporting tools, and analytical platforms for site-level and consolidated portfolio reporting.

  • Translate business requirements into scalable data, reporting, visualization, and technology solutions using advanced Excel and business-intelligence tools.

  • Automate recurring data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting to reduce manual effort and improve the speed, consistency, and reliability of insights.

  • Support system integrations, data pipelines, interfaces, data warehousing, application programming interfaces, and connections between source systems and reporting platforms.

  • Maintain recurring Real Estate & Facilities metrics, balanced scorecards, capital budgeting, fixed-asset reporting, and operational reporting as required.

Artificial Intelligence & Innovation (20%)

  • Serve as a Corporate Real Estate resource for artificial intelligence, generative AI, intelligent automation, and emerging analytical technologies.

  • Identify, prioritize, test, and implement practical AI use cases for document analysis, lease abstraction, portfolio research, forecasting, data-quality monitoring, executive reporting, and employee-service delivery.

  • Partner with Technology, Information Security, Legal, Risk, and Data Governance teams to support responsible and policy-compliant AI adoption.

  • Develop user guidance, demonstrations, training materials, and adoption support while maintaining awareness of developments in AI, analytics, commercial real estate technology, and workplace intelligence.

Executive Reporting & Decision Support (20%)

  • Convert complex data and analysis into clear, concise business recommendations, dashboards, scorecards, business cases, and executive presentations.

  • Communicate portfolio performance, risks, trends, opportunities, business impact, and recommended actions through effective data visualization and storytelling.

  • Tailor reporting for executive, operational, financial, and technical audiences and support annual planning, quarterly reviews, leadership meetings, and strategic initiatives.

Stakeholder & Program Support (10%)

  • Partner with Real Estate, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Technology, Risk, Sustainability, Security, and regional teams to define business questions, reporting requirements, and priorities.

  • Coordinate cross-functional analytics and technology initiatives, including plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, adoption, and performance measures.

  • Maintain productive relationships with service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and data partners; support continuous improvement and other analyses identified by leadership.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, computer science, finance, real estate, business administration, engineering, or a related field.

Professional Experience

  • Five or more years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data governance, technology, corporate real estate, finance, or a related discipline.

  • Experience developing complex analyses, dashboards, reports, data-quality processes, or technology-enabled solutions using information from multiple systems.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, data modeling, scenario analysis, charts, and large-dataset manipulation.

  • Experience developing dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable business-intelligence platform.

  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, master data, business definitions, controls, validation, and ownership.

  • Professional experience using artificial intelligence or generative AI tools and an understanding of responsible-use considerations.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation, and executive-communication skills.

  • Ability to translate technical or analytical findings into clear business recommendations, manage multiple priorities independently, and collaborate across functions and organizational levels.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Masters degree in a relevant field.

Professional Experience

  • Experience supporting a geographically dispersed corporate real estate portfolio or working within a Fortune 500 company.

  • Knowledge of portfolio strategy, transactions, lease administration, occupancy planning, facilities management, capital projects, workplace experience, sustainability, financial modeling, forecasting, benchmarking, and scenario planning.

  • Experience with integrated workplace management systems, lease-administration platforms, facility-management systems, occupancy technologies, or corporate real estate databases.

  • Experience working with outsourced service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and cross-functional global teams.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, DAX, data warehouses, cloud platforms, application programming interfaces, or data-integration tools.

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Copilot.

  • Experience implementing AI-enabled workflows, large language models, intelligent automation, or predictive analytics.

  • Intermediate or advanced Microsoft PowerPoint skills and strong data-visualization and storytelling capabilities.

  • Relevant certification in analytics, data governance, artificial intelligence, project management, Power BI, or commercial real estate.

The position will also provide technical guidance and oversight to junior and mid-level chemists performing data validation activities.

This role will manage environmental sample and analytical data throughout the project lifecycle, from sampling preparation and laboratory coordination through data validation, database management, usability assessment, and final reporting.

This is a remote, office-based position and does not involve routine laboratory bench work.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform chemical data validation and independent technical reviews of inorganic and organic analytical laboratory data packages.
  • Evaluate laboratory deliverables for completeness and compliance, assess quality control results, and assign appropriate data validation qualifiers based on applicable criteria.
  • Oversee and review Stage 2 data validation performed by junior and mid-level chemists.
  • Prepare data validation narratives, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) reports, and data usability assessments documenting findings and conclusions.
  • Author, review, and implement Uniform Federal Policy Quality Assurance Project Plans (UFP-QAPPs) and associated quality assurance documentation.
  • Support environmental field sampling activities through database setup, sample identification, labels, chain-of-custody documentation, and review for compliance with project planning documents.
  • Manage environmental samples and analytical data throughout the project lifecycle using applicable environmental data management systems.
  • Perform quality control reviews of data entered into environmental databases, including EQuIS, ERPIMS, ADR.net, and FUDSChem.
  • Query, evaluate, and reconcile environmental data in response to project needs and verify final database information against laboratory-reported results.
  • Manage analytical laboratory subcontractors, coordinate sample delivery and analytical schedules, review laboratory performance, and resolve laboratory QA/QC deficiencies.
  • Coordinate closely with project managers, environmental scientists, engineers, field personnel, laboratories, and data management staff to meet project requirements and schedules.
  • Provide technical guidance to project managers and junior staff regarding analytical chemistry, laboratory methods, data quality, validation requirements, and interpretation of chemical data.
  • Support environmental investigations, site characterization, remediation, environmental permitting, effluent monitoring, waste characterization and disposal, and other environmental restoration activities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a closely related scientific discipline and at least 10 years of relevant experience in environmental chemistry, including validation of inorganic and organic analytical data and environmental data/database management.
  • Demonstrated experience validating analytical data for environmental investigation, remediation, restoration, or compliance programs.
  • Experience with PFAS analytical data and other emerging contaminants.
  • Experience overseeing and providing technical review of junior and mid-level chemists performing Stage 2 data validation.
  • Strong working knowledge of EPA SW-846 methods, Contract Laboratory Program (CLP) requirements, and environmental analytical chemistry methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate laboratory QA/QC results and determine the usability and quality of environmental analytical data.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage responsibilities across multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Self-motivated with strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing or reviewing Stage 3 and/or Stage 4 data validation.
  • Working knowledge of the Department of Defense (DoD) Quality Systems Manual (QSM) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) National Functional Guidelines for Data Review.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing UFP-QAPPs for federal environmental programs.
  • Experience supporting CERCLA, RCRA, DoD, USACE, EPA, or other federal environmental remediation/restoration programs.
  • Experience with environmental data management systems such as EQuIS, ERPIMS, ADR.net, and/or FUDSChem.
  • Experience with database and data management tools such as Microsoft Access and SQL.
  • Experience managing analytical laboratory subcontractors and resolving laboratory data quality or performance issues.

Must be able to pass a Public Trust background investigation; due to contract requirements, U.S. Citizenship or U.S. Permanent residency is required.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
jobs.excerpt: Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with.
jobs.description:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

What You Will Do

  • Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
  • Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
  • Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
  • Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
  • Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
  • Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Who You Are

  • You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
  • High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
  • Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
  • Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
  • Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.

Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect at This Level

  • 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
  • Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
  • Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
  • Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
  • Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.

Not Suitable for the Role If…

  • You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
  • You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
  • You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
  • You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.
  • You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.

Why CoverGo

Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • 100% Remote Work
  • Paid Annual Leave
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Company Activities and Events
  • Learning and Development Plan

jobs.description:
About Scale Media

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition and Amazon teams across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands.

This is a senior role, but not a pure strategy role. We need someone with deep platform expertise who is in the data every day, managing performance with the team and raising the bar on media buying. We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers, so strong Meta experience is essential, and you'll lead performance across every paid channel.

On top of daily performance, you'll work with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, decide what signal we send to every channel, and help shape how paid media supports retention. DTC paid media drives significant halo to Amazon, so you'll lead Amazon alongside DTC and manage how the two work together.

You'll partner closely with Analytics, Creative, and Ecommerce, and report to the VP of Growth.

What You'll Own

  • Daily performance management. Reviewing performance every day across brands, channels, and Amazon, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them.
  • Leading the paid acquisition and Amazon teams. Managing and developing both teams, raising the bar on media buying, and building the next layer of leaders.
  • Cross-channel strategy and budget allocation. Deciding where the next dollar goes across brands, product lines, and channels (Google, Meta, Bing, others).
  • Unit economics and targets. Working with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, and holding acquisition to them.
  • Signal strategy. Deciding what signal we send to each platform, such as value-based bidding, LTV- or margin-weighted conversions, and offline events, and making sure it's implemented correctly.
  • Amazon. Leading the Amazon channel and measuring and managing the halo between DTC paid media and Amazon sales.
  • Paid media and retention. Shaping how paid media supports retention, including existing-customer suppression, win-back, and new vs. returning customer reporting by channel.
  • Measurement. Working with Analytics and our measurement partners (MTA, lift testing, MMM) to continuously improve how we decide where to allocate budget.
  • Testing. Running a structured test roadmap across channels, tactics, offers, and landing pages, and knowing which results to scale and which to cut.
  • AI-enabled workflows. Driving the use of AI tools and automation across acquisition to speed up reporting, analysis, and optimization.

What Success Looks Like

  • Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level LTV/CAC and MER targets
  • Scaled paid media spend across channels and brands
  • A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks
  • A media buying team that's measurably stronger and makes better decisions on its own
  • Budget allocation driven by marginal returns and incrementality, not platform-reported ROAS
  • Platform signal that steers bidding toward higher-value customers
  • A measured view of DTC-to-Amazon halo that shapes how we invest across both
  • Paid media and retention working together, with clean new vs. returning customer reporting

What We're Looking For

  • Deep platform expertise. You've led 8-figure Meta and paid social spend, can diagnose an account yourself, have a playbook for scaling without losing efficiency that adapts as platforms evolve, and know the major platforms well enough to challenge your team's decisions.
  • Drive to be in the numbers every day. Seniority hasn't taken you out of the data. You review performance daily, notice when something moves, and work with the team until you understand and address it.
  • People leadership. You've managed media buying teams, developed strong buyers into leaders, and raised the bar through others.
  • Cross-channel ownership. You've owned budget and performance across multiple paid channels for consumer brands.
  • Unit economics depth. You've set or materially shaped LTV/CAC, payback, or MER targets and know how to translate them into channel and product-line targets.
  • Measurement sophistication. You understand MTA, lift testing, and MMM, the limits of each, and how to use them together to make budget decisions.
  • Signal and data strategy. You've improved platform optimization through better conversion signal, such as value-based bidding, Conversions API enrichment, or offline conversions.
  • Marketplace understanding. You understand how paid media drives Amazon sales and how to measure and plan for that halo.
  • Cross-functional influence. You work well with Analytics, Creative, and Ecommerce, and can align them around shared targets.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including managing teams and owning multi-channel budgets.

Strong candidate backgrounds include:

  • Heads of growth or acquisition at scaled DTC brands who still run performance day to day
  • Directors who have owned multi-channel budgets and are ready for broader scope
  • Agency leaders who've run performance for large, multi-channel ecommerce clients

Preferred, but Not Required

  • Hands-on Amazon Ads or marketplace experience
  • Experience with retention or CRM programs
  • Experience in supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription businesses
  • Experience operating across multi-brand portfolios

What We Offer

  • Salary: $200,000 - $300,000 depending on experience
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly WFH stipend
  • Generous Paid Time Off program
  • Discounted Products

As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.

  • Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment

  • Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team
  • Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams
  • Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth
  • Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character
  • Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools
  • Understanding of core accounting principles

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience
  • Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis
  • Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

jobs.description:
Opportunité

À Valtech, vous trouverez un environnement propice à l’apprentissage continu, à l’impact concret et à la croissance professionnelle. Que vous développiez de nouvelles solutions digitales, remettiez en question les idées reçues ou construisiez la prochaine génération d’expériences client, votre travail contribuera à transformer les secteurs d'activité.

Nous sommes fiers de:

  • Nos valeurs : « share, dare, care »
  • Une culture d'entreprise qui favorise la créativité, la diversité et l'autonomie
  • Notre structure mondiale sans frontières, qui permetune collaboration fluide

La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise, car le rôle implique des communications régulières avec des clients et des collègues situés à l'extérieur du Québec.

Rôle

Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur technique visionnaire et opérationnel(le) pour rejoindre notre practice Cloud & DevOps au Canada. Ce rôle de leadership senior combine une expertise technique approfondie, du conseil stratégique, de l’architecture de solutions et du leadership en matière de delivery, afin d’aider nos clients à moderniser leurs plateformes, à accélérer la livraison de logiciels et à créer de la valeur grâce aux technologies cloud-native et aux solutions basées sur l’IA.

Le profil idéal possède une solide expérience de Microsoft Azure, des architectures modernes d’applications web, notamment Next.js, ainsi que des technologies émergentes d’IA agentique (Agentic AI). Vous accompagnerez des initiatives de transformation d’entreprise, contribuerez à définir la stratégie technique, accompagnerez les équipes d’ingénierie et collaborerez avec les parties prenantes métiers afin de développer et déployer des solutions innovantes à grande échelle.

Responsabilités du poste

Leadership technique
Définir et piloter la vision technique, les stratégies d’architecture et les bonnes pratiques pour les projets Cloud et DevOps.
Diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions cloud-native à grande échelle sur Microsoft Azure.
Établir les standards d’ingénierie, les cadres de gouvernance, les contrôles de sécurité et les pratiques d’excellence opérationnelle.
Agir comme conseiller(ère) de confiance auprès des dirigeants, des responsables technologiques et des équipes produit des clients.
IA agentique et innovation
Diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA agentique utilisant des frameworks modernes d’orchestration de l’IA, des LLM, des copilotes, des workflows autonomes et des agents intelligents.
Accompagner les clients dans l’identification des opportunités d’automatisation de processus métiers complexes grâce à des systèmes basés sur l’IA.
Évaluer les technologies émergentes en matière d’IA et définir des stratégies d’adoption alignées sur les objectifs de l’entreprise.
Concevoir des solutions d’IA sécurisées, évolutives et responsables au sein d’environnements d’entreprise.
Excellence Cloud & DevOps
Piloter les initiatives d’adoption du cloud, de modernisation, de migration et de platform engineering.
Mettre en place des pipelines CI/CD, de l’Infrastructure as Code (IaC), des pratiques d’observabilité, de reliability engineering et de gouvernance cloud.
Accompagner les équipes plateforme dans la mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels DevOps évolutifs et de stratégies d’automatisation.
Veiller à ce que les solutions répondent aux exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de performance et de fiabilité.
Delivery et relation client
Diriger des équipes d’ingénierie multidisciplinaires sur plusieurs projets.
Participer aux activités de prévente, de conception de solutions, aux ateliers de découverte technique et à la préparation de propositions.
Assurer une communication de niveau exécutif et un leadership technique tout au long de la réalisation des projets.
Gérer les risques techniques, les décisions d’architecture et la qualité des livrables.
Développement des talents
Accompagner et encadrer les architectes, ingénieurs et responsables techniques.
Favoriser une culture d’innovation, d’amélioration continue et d’excellence technique.
Contribuer au développement des compétences et des capacités au sein de la practice Cloud & DevOps.

Qualifications requises

Afin d’être éligible à ce poste, vous devez posséder les qualifications essentielles suivantes:

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en software engineering, architecture cloud, platform engineering ou DevOps.

  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans des fonctions de leadership technique, d’architecture ou de conseil.

  • Expertise approfondie de Microsoft Azure, notamment des services Azure, des patterns d’architecture, de la gouvernance, de la sécurité et des opérations.

  • Solide expérience dans la conception et la livraison d’applications d’entreprise utilisant Next.js, React et des architectures web modernes.

  • Expérience démontrée dans la mise en œuvre ou l’architecture de solutions d’IA agentique, d’automatisation basée sur l’IA, de workflows autonomes, de copilotes ou de frameworks avancés de solutions IA.

  • Expérience des architectures cloud-native, des microservices, des API, des conteneurs et des systèmes distribués.

  • Solide expérience en conseil auprès de clients et en gestion de parties prenantes au niveau exécutif.

  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Azure : App Services, AKS, Functions, AI Services, Networking, Security, Identity, Data Services et capacités de Platform Engineering.

  • Maîtrise des plateformes et pratiques DevOps, notamment GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code et automatisation.

  • Expérience des technologies de conteneurisation et d’orchestration telles que Docker et Kubernetes.

  • Bonne connaissance des écosystèmes modernes JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Expérience en observabilité, monitoring, reliability engineering et bonnes pratiques de sécurité cloud.

  • Expérience de l’intégration de solutions d’IA et de machine learning dans des applications d’entreprise.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Certification Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert ou autre certification Microsoft pertinente.

  • Expérience avec Azure OpenAI Service et la mise en œuvre de plateformes IA en environnement d’entreprise.

  • Expérience en platform engineering et en plateformes internes pour développeurs (Internal Developer Platforms).

  • Expérience dans des environnements de conseil, de transformation numérique ou d’intégration de systèmes.

  • Expérience dans la direction d’équipes de delivery distribuées et internationales.

Si vous ne possédez pas toutes les qualifications mentionnées ou si vous avez des lacunes dans votre parcours, nous vous encourageons à postuler. À Valtech, nous reconnaissons la richesse des talents et valorisons la pluralité des perspectives ainsi que la soif d’apprendre.

Engagement pour l’inclusion

Nous concevons des expériences qui conviennent à toutes les personnes — et cela commence par nos équipes. À Valtech, nous avons à cœur de bâtir une culture inclusive où chaque individu se sent soutenu pour grandir, s'épanouir et atteindre ses objectifs. Quel que soit votre parcours, vous avez votre place. Explorez notre site Diversité et Inclusion pour en savoir plus sur nos actions en faveur d’un Valtech plus équitable.

Bénéfices et avantages

Une fois votre candidature envoyée, notre équipe Talent Acquisition l’examinera sous quelques jours. Si vos compétences et votre expérience correspondent au poste, nous vous contacterons pour les prochaines étapes.

⚠️ Attention aux fraudes : n’interagissez qu’avec des adresses e-mail officielles se terminant par @valtech.com.

Nous nous engageons en faveur de l’inclusion et de l’accessibilité. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement raisonnable pendant le processus de recrutement, veuillez l’indiquer dans votre candidature ou en informer votre Talent Partner.

À propos de Valtech

Valtech est une entreprise d’innovation et d’expérience qui a pour vocation d’offrir une meilleure façon d'appréhender le monde. En combinant expertises, secteurs et cultures, nous aidons les marques à créer de la valeur dans un monde de plus en plus digital.

À l’intersection des données, de l’IA, de la créativité et de la technologie, nous accompagnons la transformation de grandes entreprises telles que L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, et bien d’autres.

À Valtech, la transformation ne se limite pas aux discours. Nous la concrétisons. Nos collaborateurs sont au cœur de notre succès, et nous cultivons un environnement où chaque talent peut s’épanouir, évoluer et innover.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Location: Caribbean/Remote

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Proficiency in agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Experience with process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, and backlog management.
  • Clear understanding of technical concepts, including familiarity with APIs, mobile/web technologies, and SDLC.
  • Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).
  • Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Ability to apply structured, logical, and data-driven approaches to understand complex business problems and deliver actionable insights.
  • Consistently demonstrates the ability to work autonomously, proactively seeking out information and resources to understand tasks and deliver results
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities, makes informed decisions, and manages assignments with minimal supervision or reliance on others for context or direction.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic project settings.
  • Commitment to industry best practices (IIBA BABOK, Agile Manifesto).

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified Product Owner (CSPO), IIBA Agile Analysis Certification (IIBA-AAC), or equivalent.
  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.
