Category: Technology

Location:


About Remotual

Remotual was founded in 2020 to redefine how companies work with overseas professionals. We are a fully remote, globally distributed team spanning five continents, offering services across Executive Assistance, Administration, Marketing, Bookkeeping, and Data Analysis. We pride ourselves on being a critical and embedded extension of our clients’ operations. Our team is fast-paced, diverse, and committed to operational excellence.

Role Summary

We are hiring a Remote Project Manager to oversee day-to-day project execution, manage internal workflows, coordinate team members across departments, and maintain clear communication with clients. This role is essential in ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and at the high standards Remotual is known for. The Project Manager will also help streamline operations and implement systems to support future growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee project timelines, deliverables, team capacity, and task prioritization

  • Act as a central point of contact between internal teams and clients

  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts, ensuring alignment and timely execution

  • Track progress through project management platforms (e.g., Asana, Trello, ClickUp)

  • Identify risks or bottlenecks early and implement mitigation plans

  • Prepare status reports and lead project-related meetings

  • Improve and document internal processes for repeatable workflows

  • Assist with onboarding new team members and standardizing team operations


Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in project or operations management

  • Prior experience in a remote working environment

Decision Science Analyst

The Decision Science Analyst will architect the analytical foundation of Red Robin's Growth, Intelligence & Decisioning capability. Equal parts data miner, performance analyst, model builder, and strategic thought partner, this role will build the analytical frameworks, measurement methodologies, and decision support infrastructure leadership relies on to understand performance and optimize business outcomes.

This role will provide ongoing support and performance visibility across Marketing, Loyalty, CRM, Paid Media, Culinary, Pricing, Customer Experience, and First Choice initiatives and will be responsible for connecting customer, transaction, menu, pricing, media, digital, and operational data to drive enterprise decision making.

The Decision Science Analyst will help build analytical capabilities for Red Robin, leveraging data from customer platforms, engagement platforms, digital commerce platforms, enterprise data environments, customer experience platforms, and intelligence platforms to create actionable insights and recommendations.

This position will both build something new while supporting critical initiatives such as First Choice segmentation, pricing strategy, menu innovation, customer growth, loyalty optimization, media effectiveness, and hyper local marketing approaches. Success requires a builder mindset and comfort operating in an environment where analytical frameworks, measurement standards, and decision support capabilities are actively being developed.

The role will partner closely with internal stakeholders including Marketing, Culinary, Pricing, Finance, Customer Experience, Operations, and Executive Leadership, while also collaborating with external partners including Analytica, Surface, media agencies, and strategic analytical partners supporting growth initiatives and customer decisioning.

Essential Functions of the Job

Decision Science, Measurement & Performance Analytics

Data Mining, Segmentation & Intelligence Development

  • Support First Choice segmentation and hyper local marketing strategies through customer, geographic, behavioral, and trade area analysis.
  • Leverage location intelligence and spatial analytics tools to identify market opportunities and competitive advantages.
  • Build scalable datasets, analytical frameworks, and reusable decision support tools.
  • Analyze customer lifetime value, retention, engagement, frequency, migration, and loyalty performance.
  • Develop analytical solutions supporting menu optimization, pricing strategy, customer acquisition, customer retention, and media effectiveness.
  • Support development of future analytical capabilities enabled through Bikky and other customer intelligence platforms.
  • Translate disparate data sources into integrated views of customer and business performance.

Commercial Decision Support

  • Serve as an analytical partner to Marketing, Loyalty, CRM, Paid Media, Culinary, Pricing, Customer Experience, and Growth teams.

  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Partner with stakeholders to prioritize opportunities and quantify business impact.
  • Support annual planning, quarterly business reviews, and ongoing performance optimization efforts.
  • Provide analytical support for enterprise growth initiatives and emerging business opportunities.

Dashboarding for Operational Visibility

  • Create measurement dashboards focused on customer behavior, loyalty performance, pricing, menu performance, media effectiveness, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop self-service analytical environments that allow stakeholders to explore performance drivers and business opportunities.
  • Build reporting solutions that improve visibility into customer, menu, pricing, and marketing performance.
  • Maintain analytical datasets and reporting structures that support recurring business reviews and decision making.
  • Ensure analytical outputs are scalable, repeatable, and aligned to enterprise reporting standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • Executives and business leaders have clear visibility into the drivers of traffic, frequency, retention, profitability, customer growth, and ROI.

jobs.description:
Overview

Multi-Line Claim Specialist – National Accounts (Complex Coverage Focus)

Location: RemoteSchedule: Full-TimeSalary Range: $95,000 to $115,000

Build Your Career With Purpose at CCMSI

At CCMSI, we partner with global clients to solve their most complex risk management challenges, delivering measurable results through advanced technology, collaborative problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to their success.

We don’t just process claims—we support people. As the largest privately-owned Third Party Administrator (TPA), CCMSI delivers customized claim solutions that help our clients protect their employees, assets, and reputations. We are a certified Great Place to Work®, and our employee-owners are empowered to grow, collaborate, and make meaningful contributions every day.

Job Summary

The Multi-Line Claim Specialist is responsible for the investigation, coverage analysis, and strategic management of high-exposure, complex, and heavily litigated liability claims, with a primary focus on Workers' Compensation Employers Liability (WCEL), complex liability coverage issues, contractual risk transfer, and catastrophic loss exposures within a national accounts environment. This role manages claims from assignment through resolution and serves as a technical expert in coverage interpretation, litigation strategy, and claim resolution involving significant legal, coverage, and exposure concerns.

This position is designed for highly experienced professionals with 8+ years of multi-line claims experience and a demonstrated ability to handle complex losses with significant legal involvement. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong litigation management skills, and the ability to navigate nuanced coverage issues, including contractual risk transfer.

This is not a transactional claims role. Success in this position requires strategic thinking, advanced negotiation skills, and the ability to partner closely with clients and legal counsel to drive optimal outcomes on high-stakes claims.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, evaluate, and manage complex, high-exposure multi-line claims in accordance with CCMSI standards, client-specific instructions, and applicable state laws
  • Lead claim strategy on heavily litigated files, working closely with defense counsel to drive resolution
  • Perform detailed coverage analysis, including policy interpretation and application
  • Analyze and apply contractual risk transfer, including indemnity and additional insured provisions
  • Establish and manage significant reserves, including ongoing reserve strategy and exposure evaluation
  • Direct and oversee defense counsel, expert witnesses, and vendors to ensure effective claim progression
  • Negotiate high-value settlements in alignment with legal strategy, client expectations, and authority guidelines
  • Review and approve complex legal, medical, and damage-related invoices for accuracy and relevance
  • Provide clear, strategic communication and reporting to clients, including claim status, exposure analysis, and resolution strategy
  • Coordinate with excess and reinsurance carriers, including reporting and collaboration on large-loss files
  • Identify and pursue subrogation opportunities where applicable
  • Maintain comprehensive and defensible claim documentation within the claim system
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor for less experienced adjusters when needed
  • Ensure full compliance with corporate claim handling standards and client service commitments

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of multi-line claim handling experience
  • Minimum 5+ years manageing complex, high-exposrue, and heavily litigated liability claims
  • Strong expertise in litigation management, defense counsel oversight, and claim resolution strategy
  • Advanced knowledge of WCEL, complex liabiltiy coverage analysis, contractual risk transfer, indemnity, additional insured provisions, and umbrella/excell liability exposures
  • Exceptional analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive-level client interacation
  • Ability to independently manage highly complex claims with minimal supervision
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Current adjuster license in home state (multiple licenses strongly preferred)

Nice to Have

  • Strong legal background
  • Prior TPA experience handling national accounts
  • Experience with construction defect, construction liability, general liability, or large commercial trucking losses
  • Experience handling CROP claims
  • Industry designations such as CPCU, AIC, or ARM
  • New York and Hawaii Licenses

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • 4 weeks (Paid time off that accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy) + 10 paid holidays in your first year
  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • Retirement plans: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Career growth: Opportunities for advancement into leadership or highly specialized technical roles
  • Culture: A supportive, team-based work environment with a focus on expertise and ownership

How We Measure Success

At CCMSI, great adjusters stand out through ownership, accuracy, and impact. We measure success by:

  • Quality claim handling – thorough analysis, defensible decisions, and strategic file management
  • Litigation outcomes – effective partnership with counsel and favorable resolution of complex claims
  • Financial accuracy – strong reserve management and cost containment
  • Client partnership – proactive communication and trusted advisor relationships
  • Professional judgment – sound decision-making on high-exposure matters

Compensation & Compliance

The posted salary reflects CCMSI’s good-faith estimate in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal equity. This role may also qualify for bonuses or additional forms of pay.

CCMSI offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Paid time off accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy, with paid holidays and eligibility for retirement programs in accordance with plan documents.

Visa Sponsorship: CCMSI does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

ADA Accommodations: CCMSI is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and hiring process.

Equal Opportunity Employer: CCMSI complies with all applicable employment laws, including pay transparency and fair chance hiring regulations.

Background checks, if required for the role, are conducted only after a conditional offer and in accordance with applicable fair chance hiring laws.

Our Core Values

At CCMSI, we believe in doing what’s right—for our clients, our coworkers, and ourselves. We look for team members who:

  • Lead with transparency We build trust by being open and listening intently in every interaction.
  • Perform with integrity We choose the right path, even when it is hard.
  • Chase excellence We set the bar high and measure our success. What gets measured gets done.
  • Own the outcome Every employee is an owner, treating every claim, every decision, and every result as our own.
  • Win together Our greatest victories come when our clients succeed.

We don’t just work together—we grow together. If that sounds like your kind of workplace, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.excerpt: About Board of InnovationBOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact.
jobs.description:
About Board of Innovation

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.

About the Role

We're looking for a Tech Lead to own the technical side of our most demanding AI builds, end to end. You step in the moment a client request lands, shape the scope and the solution with the team, turn it into an architecture and a build plan, lead the engineering through project delivery, and be the client's technical counterpart until the system runs in their environment.

This is a senior, on-project engineering role. Our builds typically run for several months, with three to five BOI engineers, inside the client's own cloud environment. You make the technical decisions within your projects, running one flagship build close to full-time or two or three smaller builds at once, depending on the portfolio. You report directly to our Engineering Director.

What You'll Do

You lead the technical delivery of enterprise AI builds, from agentic systems and LLM-powered services to the platforms around them, deployed into clients' own environments. The work runs in four strands.

Shape the solution. When a request lands on one of your accounts, you work out with the team what to build, how, with whom and in how many weeks. You write the technical side of the proposal and defend the estimate. Occasionally you do the same for a new deal, when a pitch needs an engineer who can credibly say how it will be built.

Lead the build. You own the architecture, make and document the decisions that shape it, review the team's work, and keep client stakeholders aligned on progress, trade-offs and risks. The engineers on the project look to you for direction, and you give it.

Build where it matters. When the critical path needs it, you build it yourself, whether that's a prototype that proves an approach in days, a hard integration, or a fix nobody else can land. What you ship is production-grade.

Carry the client. You're the technical voice in the room. You explain what we're building and why to people who don't write code, you earn their confidence that we can deliver, and you handle the realities of a large organization, from approvals and platform teams to security reviews and politics. You know when to push, when to work around, and when to escalate.

Between builds, you work on the internal tooling and templates that make every BOI engineer faster.

What You Bring

Experience. You have 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least two in which you technically led a build and the engineers on it, ideally for clients who were not technical themselves. You've taken systems from a design on paper to production in someone else's environment, and you know what that costs.

Applied AI depth. Your core strength is applied AI engineering, meaning agents, tool use, retrieval, MCP, evals and the orchestration around them. You've shipped LLM-based systems into production and have opinions about reliability, cost and evaluation that came from being burned. Our Engineering Director covers the deep ML side, so the best complement is someone whose instincts sit in systems, agents and delivery.

Engineering fundamentals. Python, CI/CD, testing, review discipline and infrastructure-as-code are second nature, and you use AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, Codex and MCP-based workflows fluently, with the guardrails that keep generated code production-grade. Real production cloud experience, Azure preferred, and experience deploying inside locked-down enterprise environments are a big plus.

Communication and judgement. You can explain an architecture to a VP in five minutes and hold a client room without a project manager running interference for you. You're creative in finding a path when the obvious one is blocked, you build trust fast, and you know what to decide yourself, what to flag, and when to escalate.

People management and hiring sit with the Engineering Director. You mentor the engineers on your projects, and the role can grow toward team-level leadership over time.

How You Work

You treat a build as yours. You make decisions and own them, keep the people who depend on you informed in writing, briefly and regularly, and ask for help early when the commercial or people side of a project needs it.

You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain, a new client culture and a new set of constraints, and you work in the open with strategists, designers and consultants.

The field moves quickly, and so do we. You pull in what's useful, bring it back to the team, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

Contract & Setup

You're based in Lisbon or elsewhere in Portugal, where our engineering team sits. We're open to permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements, and the final setup depends on your situation and local compliance requirements. We'd like you to start in November 2026.

Interested?

Apply with your CV and a short note on a build you technically led, what went wrong, and what you'd do differently. Bonus points for something we can actually look at.

jobs.title: Manager, Instruction and Program Design
jobs.excerpt: The Organization: Meritus CollegeMeritus College is a new kind of not-for-profit online college, built from the ground up to meet the needs of working adults and career-changers who’ve been overlooked by traditional higher education.
jobs.description:
The Organization: Meritus College

Meritus College is a new kind of not-for-profit online college, built from the ground up to meet the needs of working adults and career-changers who’ve been overlooked by traditional higher education.

The problem is clear: only 33% of Pell grant recipients complete their degrees at two-year colleges within six years. College has become too rigid, too expensive, and too disconnected from both student realities and career outcomes. Meritus College is different. Our online, asynchronous programs and "workplace as laboratory" approach allow students to learn and apply new skills directly to their jobs, while receiving personalized support from dedicated coaches every step of the way. We focus on real-world skills and stackable credentials in high-demand fields, ensuring graduates are prepared for today's jobs and tomorrow's opportunities. Founded in 2025 with an inaugural Associate of Applied Science in Technology and Innovation degree, Meritus College is building a mainstream pathway to economic mobility—one designed not for the privileged few, but for the talented many who’ve too often been left behind.

Role Overview

The primary mission of the Manager, Instruction and Program Design is to build the courses Meritus College teaches and to lead the team that supports learners through them. This is a player-coach role that combines two distinct responsibilities: hands-on instructional and program design and program/project management for the function’s people and work. You will design and build learning experiences yourself while leading the program designers, technology coordinators, coaches, and learner support staff who deliver and sustain them.

As Meritus College launches and builds in real time, you will own the course build process end to end, including partnering with subject matter experts and adjunct faculty to translate their expertise into competency-aligned, accessible, well-structured online courses, and holding that work to a consistent design standard. You will also be the connective point between how a course is designed and how learners actually experience it, using what coaches and support staff see in live delivery to improve the next build rather than waiting for a formal review cycle.

Just as importantly, you will serve as the program and project manager for the Instruction and Learner Support function translating priorities into plans, coordinating people and dependencies, tracking work, resolving blockers, and ensuring follow-through. This role requires someone comfortable moving between hands-on design work, managing a small multidisciplinary team, managing the function’s portfolio of work, and building the templates, standards, and workflows that do not yet exist. The Manager, Instruction and Program Design will report to the Director of Instruction and Learner Experience, and on an interim basis to the Managing Director of Curriculum & Instruction until that role is filled.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities of will include, but are not limited to, the following:

Team Leadership and Program Management (40%):

    • Lead the full instruction and learner support workplan within the integrated College workplan. Maintaining projects, milestones, owners, timelines, and statuses.
    • Lead the function's operating rhythm: as needed facilitate weeklies, key meetings, and internal reviews; set agendas; document decisions and next steps; ensure follow-through.
    • Drive functional work forward: translate priorities into actionable plans, track commitments, follow up with owners, and unblock issues as they arise.
    • Represent the program and learning design function in Functional Lead syncs within Meritus College, raising progress, asks, dependencies, decisions needed, and wins.

Support hiring and capacity planning recommendations as enrollment and course volume grow.Learning & Program Design (30%):

  • Design and build college courses in the learning management system, including course structure, sequencing, activities, assessments, media, and learner-facing materials.
  • Translate competencies and learning outcomes into instructional design that works for working adult learners in an online environment.
  • Create and maintain course design standards, templates, and style guides so that courses are consistent, accessible, and buildable at pace as Meritus College grows.
  • Design assessments, activities, and materials with an eye to how AI has changed skill demonstration in the field, integrating AI-enabled tools where they support learning and building in safeguards that protect academic integrity.
  • Ensure every course meets accessibility requirements and that learner-facing materials are clear, usable, and aligned to what the catalog and syllabus promise.

Subject Matter Expert Partnership & Course Builds (20%):

  • Serve as the primary partner to contract subject matter experts and adjunct faculty on new course builds, scoping the work, setting expectations, and guiding them through the design process.
  • Manage course build timelines and dependencies so that courses are ready ahead of term start, and flag risks early when a build is at risk of slipping.
  • Review SME-produced content for instructional quality, outcome alignment, and readiness, and give direct, usable feedback.

Quality & Continuous Improvement (10%):

  • Use feedback from course delivery (e.g., learner performance, coach and support observations and LMS data) to identify where courses are not working and to drive revisions.
  • Maintain course and design documentation to a standard that holds up under accreditation review, in partnership with the Compliance team.
  • Proactively spot gaps in process, tooling, or ownership across design and learner support, and build practical solutions rather than waiting for direction.

Skills and Competencies

We recognize that some individuals from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet 100% of the listed qualifications. Please don’t let that discourage you from applying! We value the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each applicant brings, and we encourage you to apply if you believe your background demonstrates the required skills and competencies:

Must Haves for all roles at Meritus College:

  • Committed to Merit America’s mission to pave pathways to family-sustaining careers, break the poverty cycle, and create upward mobility for low-wage workers
  • Demonstrated history of embodying our values, which inform our work and drive our organization's culture
  • Shared sense of responsibility and ownership for our collective work in making a positive impact on the community we support, true to our value of Win & Lose Together
  • Committed to continuous learning and growth in advancing inclusive excellence and closing gaps across lines of difference
  • Passionate about fostering a workplace culture that embraces and values individual differences, aligned with our core value of inclusivity

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in higher education, counseling, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years in instructional or learning design, with a portfolio of courses you personally built. Experience designing for online, competency-based, or workforce-aligned programs serving working adults is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing people or leading a team, formally or as a project lead. You do not need to have carried a full management portfolio, but you should want to and be ready to.
  • Experience partnering with subject matter experts, with the judgment to draw out what they know, push back on what will not work for learners, and keep a build moving without damaging the relationship.
  • Strong technical fluency with learning management systems, authoring and media tools, AI-enabled instructional tools, and accessibility standards, plus the judgment to know when emerging technology strengthens a course and when it should give way to academic integrity. Comfortable learning new tools quickly.
  • Highly organized with strong project management instincts, able to keep multiple course builds and team workstreams moving against firm term deadlines.
  • Comfortable in a start-up environment, creating templates, standards, and processes where none exist, and moving the work forward while building the system around it.
  • Learner-centered judgment, with instincts for where working adults and non-traditional learners get stuck and the drive to fix the issues rather than documenting it.

Other Logistics

  • This position is full-time
  • Location:Remote
  • Salary: $113,000

We take care of our employees by providing the following perks and benefits (please note that some of the benefits do not apply to temporary employees):

  • Medical, Dental and Vision insurance (100% Paid Employee Only Coverage)
  • Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account
  • Dependent care Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Reimbursement Account fully funded by Merit
  • Education & personal development reimbursement
  • Catalog of courses for professional learning and development
  • Short and long-term disability
  • Flexible PTO (after a 90-day introductory period)
  • Paid Parental Leave and Adoption benefits (after 1 year of employment)
  • 11 federally recognized holidays
  • 2 week holiday office closure in December/January
  • 401(k) retirement plan with automatic Merit contribution
  • Wellness Benefits/Wellness Resources
  • Discount perks at work program
  • Phone/technology stipend
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Affinity groups and community building via virtual, in-person, and/or regional meetups

*Eligibility for some benefits may vary based on employment status, full-time or part-time. Eligibility will be outlined during the hiring process.

Remote Work & Sponsorship

Candidates must reside within the 50 states or District of Columbia and have full authorization to work in the 50 U.S. states & the District of Columbia (international work abroad, including the U.S. territories (Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, and other islands are excluded). In addition, Merit America doesn't offer employment visa sponsorship.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Building an inclusive, high-performing team that is diverse across lines of personal identity is integral to our success and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

This means we do not discriminate against any job applicant or employee because of their race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

We actively strive and evolve to develop and maintain workspaces that are fully inclusive. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply.

Still excited about our work? You can learn more about our work inthis video we made with our founding partner, Google.

Fair Chance Ordinance

Applicants who have arrest or conviction records and are in unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County will be considered in accordance with the state’s fair chance ordinance law. Employment under the ordinance includes part-time work, seasonal work, contract work, contingent work, work on commission, and work through the services of a temporary or employment agency.

E-Verify Statement

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the I-9 Form.

jobs.description:
Job title:Senior Manager, Engineering - Billing

Reports to:Director, Engineering

Department:Central Services

Location:Remote

Grade:22

About Priority:

Our vision in Product & Technology is to engineer the world's most resilient, AI-native financial ecosystem that empowers businesses to transcend table-stakes and lead the Agentic future, where every financial transaction is intelligent, every developer is accelerated, and every experience is unified.

At Priority, we are building the Priority Commerce Engine, a unified platform that enables businesses to collect money, store money, lend money, move money, and build modern commerce experiences at scale.

About the Role:

Senior Managers at Priority lead a mix: you manage other managers (Managers or Team Leads, or both), and you often continue to manage one or more teams and their engineers directly yourself. Managing other managers is what makes this level distinct from Manager — it's the point where indirection becomes a real mode of leadership alongside the direct management you may continue to do. The scale you cover is multiple teams within an area, and the newly-yours craft is making those teams perform consistently — through the leaders you develop and the standards you hold across the scope.

Your leverage flows through both modes — the leaders you grow and the team(s) you run directly. The cross-team work — making standards hold, making cross-team commitments stick, making the slowest team get help instead of blame — is the part that's newly yours. You'll also pick up the keyboard when the work genuinely calls for it; the day-to-day craft, though, is making multiple teams move together as a unit.

You own three bars across the teams in your scope: the hiring bar — kept consistent across teams so every hire raises the bar where it lands; the performance bar — held for the engineers you directly manage and for the leaders under you, with the same honesty and the same early intervention; the culture bar — built deliberately on every team you cover, not assumed to propagate.

You own the area's business, customer, and OKR/KPI alignment across your teams — in partnership with your peers at this level in Product Design and Product Management. You and your Product Design and Product Management peers at the multi-team scope are the area's leadership trio. Together you make sure the area's OKRs and KPIs ladder up coherently across teams and up to the workstream, and that the "why" behind the work is consistent across teams. Business fluency doesn't slip when it isn't you in the room — the Managers and Team Leads under you carry the trio partnership at team level the way you carry it at the multi-team level, because that's the standard you set and hold.

You and the Staff (or Senior Staff) Software Engineers — or Software Architects — across the area's teams share accountability for those teams' customer and business outcomes. You lead through delivery, the people, the organization of the teams, and the partnerships with those Staff+ engineers needed to move those outcomes. They lead through architecture, technical direction, and engineering excellence within their teams. Multiple interlocking partnerships across the area — and those teams need them all to work.

You run the semi-annual Skills & Knowledge Assessment for the engineers you directly manage; you oversee the Managers under you running it for their reports. Scores roll up into the workstream Engineering Maturity Model (EMM) score. Consistency of the assessment bar across teams is your job — Managers under you don't grade differently than you would.

When the area hits a cross-team high-pressure moment — a major incident spanning teams, a multi-team escalation, a critical multi-team delivery — you're the leader the area looks to across those teams. You're on point, you stay on it until it's resolved, and you show up regardless of time of day, day of week, or weekend.

You drive AI-native transformation as a consistent standard across your teams — not as an option each team adopts at its own pace. Agentic PDLC adoption is measured, coached toward, and held to the bar across the teams in your scope.

Developing leaders is the new multiplier of the job — and you keep developing the engineers on the team(s) you run directly. Managers and Team Leads under you grow measurably. Engineers on the team(s) you manage directly grow into and beyond their levels, and some grow past your scope into bigger roles.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop the Managers and Team Leads who report to you — they grow measurably because of you; managing other managers is a real craft you actively practice.

  • Directly manage engineers on at least one team yourself, with the same hiring, performance, and team-health expectations as a Manager, when scope calls for it.

  • Keep hiring and performance bars consistent across teams in your scope.

  • In partnership with your peers at this level in Product Design and Product Management, own the area's understanding of the customer, the business, and the OKRs and KPIs the area's teams are measured on; make sure those OKRs and KPIs ladder up coherently.

  • Set and hold the standard for business fluency across teams — the Managers and Team Leads under you carry the trio partnership with their Product Design and Product Management peers at team level the way you carry it at the multi-team level.

  • Align delivery across teams; sequence cross-team dependencies so the commitments those teams make to business partners, stakeholders, and customers hold.

  • Balance investment across teams against priority — not the loudest voice; consolidate duplicated effort.

  • Make sure delivery, quality, and reliability practices are consistent across teams — the slowest team gets help, not blame.

  • Lead during cross-team high-pressure moments — major incidents that span teams, multi-team escalations, critical multi-team deliveries — regardless of time of day, day of week, or weekend.

  • Make sure no team in your scope has a single-human point of failure — including at the leader level.

  • Root-cause systemic defect patterns across team boundaries; the same incident class doesn't recur in a second team.

  • Run the semi-annual Skills & Knowledge Assessment for the engineers you directly manage; oversee the Managers under you running it for their reports — scores roll up into the workstream EMM score.

  • Drive AI-native and Agentic PDLC adoption as a standard across teams; consolidate shared tooling friction into platform tasks backed by evidence.

  • Keep ADR (architecture decision record) practice the norm; respect and amplify the Staff+ engineers' architectural ownership across teams.

  • Develop the next generation of leaders — Team Leads who become Managers, Managers who become Senior Managers.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Your teams' delivery and maturity are consistent, not lumpy.

  • The Managers and Team Leads under you cite you as a reason they grew; the team(s) you manage directly perform at least as well as the teams led by your direct-report leaders.

  • The area's OKRs and KPIs ladder up coherently; every team's contribution is visible; business fluency is consistent across teams because you set and hold the standard.

  • You and your Product Design and Product Management peers at multi-team scope operate as a real trio; the Managers under you operate the same way at team scope

  • Cross-team commitments to business partners, stakeholders, and customers hold; fixes propagate across teams instead of staying local.

  • No team in your scope has a single point of failure you haven't addressed — including at the leader level.

  • Customer and business outcomes across your teams move on your watch — not just system metrics.

  • AI-native practice is consistent across your teams — daily, judgment-driven, no nagging required.

  • Engineers and leaders grow into and beyond their levels because of you.

What We're Looking For:

  • Roughly 10–15 years of relevant experience, with real experience managing managers — not just multi-team scope, but people-managing people-managers as an active craft.

  • A record of leading a full team well (hiring, performance, delivery, growth) and of developing other leaders who then led well themselves.

  • Hybrid leadership credibility — comfort managing other managers while also running a team directly, without favoring one mode and neglecting the other.

  • Multi-team coordination experience — shared standards and cross-team commitments that held under pressure.

  • Demonstrated partnership with Product and Design peers at multi-team scope as a real trio — joint ownership of area-level OKRs and KPIs.

  • Comfort and credibility leading through cross-team crises — multi-team outages, cross-functional escalations, critical multi-team deliveries — regardless of hour.

  • Coaching and delegation as demonstrated strengths — impact through others, not presence.

  • Experience driving engineering-practice change (AI-native, quality, delivery) consistently across multiple teams.

  • Honest, direct communication — willing to have hard conversations early at both the IC and the leader level.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience leading multi-team engineering organizations within fintech, payments, lending, or other regulated financial systems.

  • A track record of measurably improving how multiple teams work together at scale — visible gains in delivery, quality, developer experience, or on-call health, sustained past your tenure.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience.

  • Advanced degree in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Master's or PhD).

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range:$202k - $230k

We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • Bonus programs

  • 401(k) match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

Health & Well-being

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health

  • Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

  • Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

Time Off

Growth & Development

  • Education expense reimbursement

  • Leadership development programs

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

Traditional Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.

  • Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Serves as a strategic analytics partner to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and Payment Integrity teams by delivering actionable business intelligence, financial reporting, operational insights, and statistically sound audit support. This role combines advanced data analysis, dashboard development, healthcare claims expertise, and stakeholder engagement to identify fraud, waste, abuse, payment accuracy opportunities, and operational improvement initiatives.

The analyst develops reporting and analytical solutions that support provider investigations, overpayment recovery efforts, prepayment and post-payment audit programs, and executive decision-making. This role is responsible for translating complex healthcare data into meaningful insights, measuring program effectiveness, supporting statistically valid sampling methodologies, and driving measurable savings and operational efficiencies across the organization.
  • Partner with Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Payment Integrity, Clinical, Finance, and operational stakeholders to identify business needs and develop analytical solutions that support fraud, waste, abuse detection, payment accuracy, and operational performance management.
  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into investigation outcomes, provider risk, savings, recoveries, cost avoidance, inventory management, and key performance indicators.
  • Analyze healthcare claims, provider, member, audit, and investigation data to identify trends, anomalies, emerging risks, and opportunities for financial and operational improvement.
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc financial and operational reporting used by leadership to measure program effectiveness, resource utilization, productivity, return on investment, and strategic objectives.
  • Design, execute, validate, and document statistically valid random sampling methodologies to support provider audits, overpayment identification, error rate measurement, and extrapolation activities.
  • Collaborate with business partners, BI Analysts, Data Scientists, and others to define data requirements, improve data quality, and operationalize advanced analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering, solution design, and stakeholder review sessions to ensure reporting and analytical solutions meet business objectives and deliver measurable value.
  • Validate data accuracy, reconcile reporting outputs, and ensure consistency of financial, operational, and analytical metrics across multiple systems and audiences.
  • Communicate analytical findings, insights, risks, and recommendations to business partners and leadership through effective visualizations, presentations, and written summaries.
  • Establish and maintain reporting standards, documentation, governance practices, and development methodologies to ensure scalable, reliable, and sustainable analytical solutions.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while proactively communicating status, risks, dependencies, and opportunities to stakeholders and leadership.

What You Bring

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required)
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, SIU, Payment Integrity, or a related field
  • In lieu of degree, 5+ years of experience in related field.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA), Payment Integrity, claims auditing, or provider payment review functions.
  • Knowledge of healthcare claims processing, reimbursement methodologies, CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, DRG, and provider billing practices.
  • Experience with statistical sampling methodologies, confidence intervals, extrapolation, and audit-related analytics.
  • Experience measuring healthcare savings, recoveries, cost avoidance, and operational performance metrics.

jobs.description:
The Organization: Meritus College

Meritus College is a new kind of not-for-profit online college, built from the ground up to meet the needs of working adults and career-changers who’ve been overlooked by traditional higher education.

The problem is clear: only 33% of Pell grant recipients complete their degrees at two-year colleges within six years. College has become too rigid, too expensive, and too disconnected from both student realities and career outcomes. Meritus College is different. Our online, asynchronous programs and "workplace as laboratory" approach allow students to learn and apply new skills directly to their jobs, while receiving personalized support from dedicated coaches every step of the way. We focus on real-world skills and stackable credentials in high-demand fields, ensuring graduates are prepared for today's jobs and tomorrow's opportunities. Founded in 2025 with an inaugural Associate of Applied Science in Technology and Innovation degree, Meritus College is building a mainstream pathway to economic mobility—one designed not for the privileged few, but for the talented many who’ve too often been left behind.

Role Overview

The primary mission of the Director of Operations is to serve as the connective tissue of Meritus College, ensuring priorities, information, and decisions move effectively across functional areas and that teams have the clarity and infrastructure they need. As Meritus College launches and builds in real time, you will connect dots across the College, proactively identify and unblock issues, escalate issues as needed, and serve as a trusted first line of feedback and thought partnership across the organization.

You will also play a critical role in building the systems, operating rhythms, and infrastructure of the College as it grows, often creating the process while simultaneously moving the work forward. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and culture, requiring exceptional resourcefulness, critical thinking, and stakeholder management skills to move fluidly between seeing the big picture, building what’s missing, and driving the details forward.

The Director of Operations will report directly to Melinda Day, Chief Academic Officer, and will work crossfunctionally across Meritus College teams.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:

Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Drive alignment and accountability across Functional Leads through regular status meetings, 1:1 connects, and follow-ups. Introduce and standardize practices, tools, and approaches that strengthen both execution and communications.
  • Maintain a clear view across all College workstreams, connecting priorities, dependencies, decisions, and information across functional areas.
  • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, working with Functional Leads and escalating issues to leadership when quick decisions or intervention are needed.
  • Build a strong, supportive culture among Functional Leads, fostering trust, collaboration, shared accountability, and connection across teams.

Operations & Systems Building

  • Own and continuously improve key College operating rhythms, meetings, workflows, and ways of working.
  • Proactively spot gaps in systems, processes, communication, or ownership and design and implement practical solutions.
  • Jump into emerging priorities and problems that don’t yet have a clear owner or playbook, bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous work.

Stakeholder Communications, Change & Culture

  • Own key College-wide forums, including All Hands meetings, gathering updates from Functional Leads and developing materials, and ensuring College sharebacks clearly and compellingly communicate progress and wins.
  • Help shape communications and sharebacks to Merit America staff and leadership, tailoring the message, context, and level of detail for different stakeholder groups.
  • Support change management and proactively build practices and rituals that strengthen communication, collaboration, accountability, recognition, and culture across the College.

Strategic Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner and first line of review, pressure-testing work, providing feedback, and determining what requires senior leadership input or approval.
  • Surface patterns, risks, opportunities, and organizational needs to leadership based on a close understanding of what is happening across the College.
  • Develop first drafts of key narratives, presentations, and materials for College leadership across important internal and external moments.
  • Partner with leadership to work through the College’s stickiest problems, bringing structure, sound judgment, and a bias toward action to complex or ambiguous challenges.

Skills and Competencies

We recognize that some individuals from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet 100% of the listed qualifications. Please don’t let that discourage you from applying! We value the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each applicant brings, and we encourage you to apply if you believe your background demonstrates the required skills and competencies:

Must Haves for all roles at Meritus College:

  • Committed to Merit America’s mission to pave pathways to family-sustaining careers, break the poverty cycle, and create upward mobility for low-wage workers
  • Demonstrated history of embodying our values, which inform our work and drive our organization's culture
  • Shared sense of responsibility and ownership for our collective work in making a positive impact on the community we support, true to our value of Win & Lose Together
  • Committed to continuous learning and growth in advancing inclusive excellence and closing gaps across lines of difference
  • Passionate about fostering a workplace culture that embraces and values individual differences, aligned with our core value of inclusivity

Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of relevant experience, ideally including Chief of Staff, operations, consulting, program management, or similar roles in complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. Higher education experience is a plus, but not required!
  • Education, Bachelor's degree required; an MBA or other master's degree is a plus but not required, particularly for candidates with substantial operations, or consulting experience in fast-scaling organizations
  • Experience building in a 0→1 environment, including a startup, agency, nonprofit, or fast-scaling organization. A track record of creating and rolling out structure, systems, and processes.
  • Highly organized with strong program management instincts, able to keep multiple interconnected workstreams moving while maintaining attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the judgment to navigate different perspectives, build trust, and tailor communication and approach to different audiences.
  • A systems thinker and proactive problem solver, able to see around corners, connect dots, identify what’s missing, and build practical solutions.
  • Strong executive communication skills, able to synthesize complex information and turn it into clear, compelling narratives, presentations, recommendations, and decisions.
  • High capacity and resourcefulness, comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Willing to jump in wherever needed to get the work done.
  • Comfort with AI and emerging technologies, with good judgment about where they can strengthen systems, workflows, and decision-making at a fast-scaling start-up college, and where they shouldn't be relied on.
  • Sound judgment and executive presence, with the ability to serve as a credible thought partner to senior leaders while building strong relationships across all levels of the organization.

Other Logistics

  • This position is full-time
  • Location:Remote
  • Salary: $148,000

We take care of our employees by providing the following perks and benefits (please note that some of the benefits do not apply to temporary employees):

  • Medical, Dental and Vision insurance (100% Paid Employee Only Coverage)
  • Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account
  • Dependent care Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Reimbursement Account fully funded by Merit
  • Education & personal development reimbursement
  • Catalog of courses for professional learning and development
  • Short and long-term disability
  • Flexible PTO (after a 90-day introductory period)
  • Paid Parental Leave and Adoption benefits (after 1 year of employment)
  • 11 federally recognized holidays
  • 2 week holiday office closure in December/January
  • 401(k) retirement plan with automatic Merit contribution
  • Wellness Benefits/Wellness Resources
  • Discount perks at work program
  • Phone/technology stipend
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Affinity groups and community building via virtual, in-person, and/or regional meetups

*Eligibility for some benefits may vary based on employment status, full-time or part-time. Eligibility will be outlined during the hiring process.

Remote Work & Sponsorship

Candidates must reside within the 50 states or District of Columbia and have full authorization to work in the 50 U.S. states & the District of Columbia (international work abroad, including the U.S. territories (Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, and other islands are excluded). In addition, Merit America doesn't offer employment visa sponsorship.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Building an inclusive, high-performing team that is diverse across lines of personal identity is integral to our success and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

This means we do not discriminate against any job applicant or employee because of their race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We actively strive and evolve to develop and maintain workspaces that are fully inclusive. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply.

Still excited about our work? You can learn more about our work inthis video we made with our founding partner, Google.

Applicants who have arrest or conviction records and are in unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County will be considered in accordance with the state’s fair chance ordinance law. Employment under the ordinance includes part-time work, seasonal work, contract work, contingent work, work on commission, and work through the services of a temporary or employment agency.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

Within the Video Security & Access Control (VS&AC) business unit at Motorola Solutions, we are helping solve some of the biggest challenges around safety and physical security by developing advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and products. Avigilon, a Motorola Solutions brand, designs, develops, and manufactures advanced AI, video analytics, network video management software and hardware, and surveillance cameras that help change the way people interact with their security systems.


Job Description

Reporting to the Group Product Manager, AI & Analytics, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for key AI and analytics initiatives across the Avigilon platform. You'll be part of an empowered product team operating with a start-up mindset inside a large enterprise.

Artificial Intelligence is transforming the physical security landscape, and this role is at the center of that evolution. You will bring a proven track record of having shipped AI/ML products at scale, taking complex models out of research and deploying them into production environments serving high-volume, real-world workloads. In this role, you will turn next-generation AI, from computer vision and object detection to Vision-Language Models (VLMs), generative workflows, and agentic AI, into intuitive, high-value user workflows that make our entire end-to-end product ecosystem shine.

Beyond your own initiative areas, you will help shape how the broader video product team integrates intelligence to solve complex security problems for our customers. You will maintain clear ownership over product vision, discovery, user experience, and technical model trade-offs while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure seamless delivery.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Own Strategic AI Product Area(s): Take full ownership of assigned AI and analytics capabilities within the Avigilon platform. Define the vision for your area, set outcomes, run discovery, and drive the multi-quarter roadmap for high-scale AI capabilities in close partnership with AI research and engineering teams.

  • Bridge AI Research & Technical Scale: Engage deeply with AI Platform Engineering and AI Research teams to evaluate technical trade-offs around model accuracy, inference latency, compute-to-serve costs, infrastructure scaling, and edge vs. cloud deployment. Translate cutting-edge AI capabilities into well-framed problem statements and intuitive operator experiences.

  • Lead Continuous Discovery: Run a rigorous market discovery practice. Conduct customer interviews, observe security workflows in the field, analyze usage data, and synthesize findings to ensure AI capabilities solve real operational pain points rather than serving as "technology-first" novelties.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Platform Alignment: Partner with Video Management Software (VMS), Access Control, Appliances, and Devices Product Management teams to ensure AI features feel like unified platform experiences across the entire ecosystem.

  • Define and Own Scale Metrics: Build the measurement framework for your assigned AI capabilities. Instrument your product to track adoption, field accuracy, inference reliability at scale, engagement, and business impact. Use data to validate hypotheses, refine models, and make the case for future investment.

  • Influence Across the Organization & Field Engagement: Work with Sales, Support, Training, and Product Marketing to ensure successful launches, strong feedback loops, and customer enablement. Create technical value propositions, respond to field inquiries, and help align stakeholders around AI priorities.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering software, cloud, or enterprise solutions, with a demonstrated track record of shipping AI/ML-driven products or capabilities at production scale (e.g., serving thousands of active users, processing high-volume streaming data, or managing large-scale inference workloads).

  • Production AI/ML Depth: Deep understanding of computer vision, deep learning, LLMs/VLMs, and analytics workflows, with the technical fluency to engage meaningfully with AI researchers on model deployment, optimization, latency trade-offs, and cost-to-serve at scale.

  • Empowered Product Thinking: Exceptional critical thinker who is decisive, possesses both technical and business acumen, and has a proven track record of taking complex AI products from research/discovery through to commercial deployment.

  • Continuous Discovery Practice: Experience running customer discovery, conducting field interviews, and translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product strategy and clear requirements.

  • Systems & Scale Thinking: Ability to visualize how edge-to-cloud AI implementations interact at scale, balancing model execution on local hardware versus cloud/on-prem compute costs, bandwidth constraints, and system load.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and relationship skills to present product strategy to senior leadership and align cross-functional engineering, hardware, and marketing teams without direct authority.

What Sets You Apart:

  • Large-Scale GenAI or Agentic AI Deployment: Experience launching or scaling products in production that leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), or multi-step AI agents.

  • AI Prototyping: Ability to rapidly stand up AI-generated prototypes to explore possibilities, test hypotheses, and iterate on workflows before engineering build.

  • Security & Computer Vision Domain Knowledge: Prior experience deploying computer vision models or video analytics at scale within physical security, video management systems (VMS), or IoT/hardware environments.

  • Cloud + On-Prem Hybrid Architecture: Experience scaling products that bridge cloud and on-premise deployments, or managing edge-to-cloud model distribution strategies.

Target Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $150,000 CAD

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Manager
jobs.excerpt: Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture.
jobs.description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

Why This Role Matters

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils’ promise of “production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days” actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

What You’ll Do

Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams
  • Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models
  • Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers
  • Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget
  • Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

AI Enablement

  • Help implement the AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) across your engagements, and set the standard other delivery managers follow for standing it up
  • Use AI yourself day-to-day, and set the standard for how your engagements run an AI-augmented delivery process — modeling and coaching the delivery managers you mentor on how planning, building, and review change when agents are doing part of the work
  • Know observability for agentic and AI-driven work well enough to partner credibly with an AI product manager and AI engineers across your engagements — judge whether their approach is actually solid, catch risks early, and drive them to resolution — and hold the delivery managers you mentor to the same bar. You’re not the one building the instrumentation, but none of it should be a black box to you.
  • Define what “success” looks like for an AI-augmented delivery process and set the metrics standard across your engagements — quality, rework, review overhead, and velocity, not just tests passed
  • Build — or direct the building of — status-visibility tooling for complex AI-driven pipelines, using AI yourself, and expect the delivery managers you mentor to do the same
  • Understand context management and latency trade-offs deeply enough to make the call on when an agentic approach is the wrong tool for a client’s needs, and defend that call to the client
  • Set the standard for what infrastructure an agentic delivery pipeline needs — compute, orchestration, logging, guardrails — and know enough to hold engineering accountable for it, even though you’re not the one building it
  • Own the delivery approach for AI-native and agentic engagements: partner with AI/ML engineering leads on model risk, data readiness, and evaluation strategy, and translate technical uncertainty into a delivery plan and risk register the client can act on
  • Work with AI product managers and AI engineers to set the standard, across your engagements, for what a “definition of done” looks like for probabilistic or AI-driven features — evaluation thresholds, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, post-launch monitoring — well enough to judge whether it’s actually good, and hold the team to it
  • Coach delivery managers and delivery coordinators you mentor on the difference between shipping an AI product, using AI to accelerate a traditional delivery, and running an agentic development process to build the work itself — and help them adapt scope, staffing, and risk management accordingly
  • Serve as a credible voice with clients and internal leadership on what “production-ready AI” actually requires — setting realistic expectations for iteration, evaluation, and drift over time

Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement
  • Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence
  • Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences
  • Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what’s next
  • Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence
  • Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans
  • Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement
  • Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements
  • Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm
  • Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership
  • Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)
  • Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations
  • Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments
  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills
  • Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms
  • Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)
  • Track record leading at least one engagement where AI/ML or agentic capability was core to the solution — including how you managed model risk, evaluation, and client expectations, not just how you used AI tools to work faster
  • Able to set delivery standards for AI-native work across an engagement or practice — evaluation criteria, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, monitoring — and coach other delivery managers on them
  • Track record leading a team through an agentic development/delivery process yourself — not just using AI tools personally — including how you approached observability, success metrics, and status visibility for a process that isn’t fully deterministic
  • Comfortable setting the standard, across engagements, for the infrastructure, context-management, and latency trade-offs an agentic delivery pipeline needs — enough to hold engineering and delivery managers accountable, even though you’re not the one implementing it
  • PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred
  • Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing
  • Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise
  • Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Calm when it gets hot. When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You’d rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $160.000 CAD - $ 200.000 CAD.  We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
