jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

Envysion, a leading provider of video-based SaaS technology solutions for restaurants, convenience stores and retailers is seeking an experienced Product Marketing Manager to join our marketing team. This individual will report to the head of marketing and sit on the marketing team with a direct line to the product team to deliver go-to-market strategies.


Job Description

You will be responsible for all aspects of bringing our cutting-edge products to market, from developing the critical messages and go-to-market strategy, working with marketing and creative to develop assets, to working with the product team to get early user feedback for all of our product lines. You will also define and craft the overall strategy and approach for nurturing and growing our existing products.

Who you are:

  • You are a creative storyteller and highly capable communicator, comfortable presenting to internal teams and directly in front of customers to span writing, speaking, and presenting.

  • You are curious and approach market research with humility. You ask questions, are open to having your assumptions challenged by data, and are eager to learn new technologies, new audiences, and new markets.

  • You can take complex products or features and distill them into clear, concise, value-focused messages.

  • You have the talent to create compelling and exciting messages to differentiate your product in the market.

  • You are organized, able to break large projects apart into short-term milestones, and communicate progress and roadblocks effectively, as you bring them to completion.

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments and can build relationships across teams to drive the greatest impact.

  • You can creatively problem solve, and adapt to shifting projects and moving targets.

What you’ll do:

As a Product Marketer, you will work across Marketing and the Product Management teams to develop and deliver exceptional marketing for our Envysion solution. You will be tasked with driving strategy and go-to-market plans, bringing new products and features to market. Your focus will be on crafting messaging, creating marketing assets and sales enablement materials, and supporting campaigns.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Own product and feature launches, including naming, messaging and positioning, identifying target audiences, and creating content to support the launch, such as web pages, social media, collateral, presentations, and more. Develop launch strategies by creating dynamic campaign plans, defining messaging angles, and delivering plans to the Growth Team for execution. Manage weekly reporting meetings, adapt campaigns on a weekly basis to maintain flexibility, and review teaser performance to adjust based on real-time learnings.

  • Develop the Product Positioning Guide (PPG) by formally defining product positioning, messaging, benefits, and competitive differentiation. Craft messaging and positioning that ties our products and features together and differentiates them in the market.

  • Acquire deep customer knowledge through market research, customer interviews, and segmentation analysis that help us understand the psychographic and demographic traits of our key target customers. Drive target market research to gain first-hand insights directly from the Application Innovation Council (AIC). Conduct competitor and market research to better understand our differentiation, target customers, key industries, and buyer personas. Collaborate with Product Management to conduct experiments that test market demand for new concepts and validate various messaging strategies ahead of full product development.

  • Develop critical sales enablement collateral, including 1-pagers, slides, talk tracks, and pitch decks. Assist in developing robust sales training materials and lead the marketing presentation portion of product kickoffs.

  • Draft webpages, structure newsletter messaging, and develop engaging email messaging for campaigns. Deliver customer-facing product content including release notes, factsheets, datasheets, FAQs, video scripts, website content, sales decks, event collateral to effectively position and sell all layers of the Envysion product stack.

  • Partner with Product Management to be the voice of the customer. Communicate new benefits/features, update messaging actively as needed, and consistently keep marketing team members abreast of new launch timing and updates.

  • Work alongside the Growth Marketing Team to develop and execute marketing campaigns to increase awareness and drive demand for products, solutions and software partnerships.

  • 6+ years experience in Product Marketing, preferably in a business to business role.

  • Experience working with software cloud (SaaS) solutions is a plus.

jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

OVERVIEW:

In this role, you will play a critical part in driving the growth and success of Salomon’s Sportstyle business across the North American marketplace, with an emphasis on order book management, monitoring marketplace sell-thru, managing the Sales calendar (Sales Meetings, Pre-lines, QBR’s, T2T’s etc), creating and managing sales tools, driving process and best practices across the sales organization, managing the cross functional relationships with Planning, Customer Service and Sales Ops, supporting the Key Account Executives, and driving alignment with sales agencies. Reporting directly to the US Business Sales Director, Sportstyle, you will support the strategic initiatives, the management of key account relationships, and ensure operational excellence to deliver profitable, long-term growth. You will collaborate closely with internal teams and the independent sales force to elevate Salomon’s growing presence in the lifestyle market.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Execution and Account Management

  • Support the Director in implementing the strategic vision for Sportstyle within assigned national and specialty accounts.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal stakeholders, serving as a trusted partner and resource.

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Sales Operations, Customer Service) to ensure alignment and flawless execution of account and marketplace plans.

Operational and Financial Performance

  • Execute annual sales plans to achieve revenue targets and key KPIs (PGP, EBIT, Market Share).

  • Using POS and internal reporting monitor account performance, identify growth opportunities and risks, and provide actionable insights to optimize results.

  • Partner with credit, supply and customer service teams to ensure order book flow and management.

Category and Forecast Management

  • Manage the category order book for assigned accounts, ensuring accuracy and compliance with corporate standards.

  • Lead seasonal forecasting process for wholesale in partnership with demand planning, ensuring inventory optimization and readiness for major retail moments and brand activations.

Go to Market

  • Drive sell-in processes and standards for seasonal assortments, ensuring consistency with sales team

  • Negotiate and manage seasonal marketing investments in collaboration with trade marketing team

Team and Agency Collaboration

  • Provide leadership and guidance to the Ket Account Executives and independent sales force, including agency coordination, performance evaluations, and market travel.

  • Support the Director in preparing seasonal and annual sales projections and developing sales programs aligned with strategic objectives.

  • Support the Director in creating and implementing streamlined processes (weekly, monthly, seasonal, annual) that are uniform across the sales team

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, ABILITIES & COMPETENCIES

  • Proven experience managing a footwear business in the Lifestyle category in a Sales, Merchandising or Planning role

  • Comprehensive understanding of the North American lifestyle consumer

  • Well versed in the New York City and LA marketplaces

  • Demonstrated success in supporting strategic sales plans and achieving revenue targets.

  • Strong ability to build internal and external relationships and influence stakeholders across multiple levels.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and negotiation skills.

  • High business acumen with proficiency in data analysis and forecasting.

Samsara is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data team, comprising both Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. Our team is at the forefront of enhancing data analysis efficiency and effectiveness. Our data engineers develop and maintain data pipelines integral to our analytics data model.

As a Data Engineer, your primary responsibility will be designing and maintaining data pipelines, primarily utilizing SparkSQL and Pyspark, within our central data lake. These pipelines are crucial for ingesting and transforming source data from our IOT devices and software products into our core data model, facilitating statistical analysis, model training, and dashboard creation.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain highly reliable computed tables, incorporating data from various sources, including unstructured data like video and audio, Samsara sensor & product data, and customer metadata.
  • Access, manipulate, and integrate external datasets with internal data.
  • Deliver high-quality data with strong uptime and reliability requirements, including customer-facing data sets.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as Data Science & Analytics, AI/ML, and other Data Engineers to ensure high-quality data for diverse purposes from causal inference, model training, and dashboarding.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BA / MS degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience in a data engineering-focused role.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing data models at scale.
  • Proficiency in building ETL pipelines to handle large volumes of data.
  • Experience with Spark-based data platforms.
  • Strong command of at least one data orchestration tool (e.g Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect).
  • Expertise in SQL, Python, and working with REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals and reading backend development code.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git/GitHub.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with time series data and late-arriving data.
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Delta Lakes, and Dagster.
  • Previous experience working in a public cloud (e.g AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Exposure working on a data model for a product’s first-party data.
  • Exposure to complex data, including ML outputs and/or client-side signals.

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Annual Base Salary
$99,365—$167,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: We are looking for a Solution Manager to join our team!
jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a Solution Manager to join our team! In this role, you will enable the successful execution of Penn Mutual's complex business and technology initiatives that span multiple teams and functions. You will bring together business, product, technology, operations, architecture, and shared services to translate approved priorities into achievable, coordinated deliverables.


The Solution Manager facilitates initiative readiness, capacity-aware planning, cross-team coordination, dependency management, and execution visibility, enabling teams and leaders to identify impacts and make more informed decisions earlier in the process. By fostering alignment, transparency, and delivery discipline, this role helps Penn Mutual navigate change and achieve business outcomes with greater predictability and success.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Initiative Readiness & Solution Shaping

The Solution Manager ensures approved initiatives are sufficiently prepared before entering planning and delivery activities.


  • Facilitate initiative readiness activities to ensure work is sufficiently understood before planning and execution.
  • Partner with business, product, architecture, operations, and technology stakeholders to clarify scope, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
  • Coordinate discovery and solutioning activities required to support implementation planning.
  • Identify readiness gaps and coordinate actions required before initiatives enter delivery.
  • Ensure implementation approaches, milestones, dependency impacts, and delivery considerations are understood across participating teams.
  • Support transition of approved initiatives into quarterly planning and execution activities.
  • Promote consistency in readiness standards, planning artifacts, and delivery preparation practices.

2. Quarterly Planning & Cross-Team Coordination

The Solution Manager facilitates planning and alignment activities across teams participating in a shared solution or initiative.


  • Lead quarterly planning preparation activities.
  • Facilitate planning events involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Coordinate sequencing and alignment of work across participating teams.
  • Support capacity-aware planning by identifying dependencies, constraints, risks, and execution impacts.
  • Maintain visibility into planning commitments, milestones, objectives, and delivery targets.
  • Drive alignment when priorities, timing, resourcing assumptions, or delivery commitments require adjustment.
  • Facilitate ongoing synchronization activities that support execution throughout the planning cycle.
  • Ensure key delivery decisions, assumptions, and commitments remain visible and understood by stakeholders.

3. Dependency, Risk & Delivery Management

The Solution Manager helps teams successfully navigate the complexity of delivering large cross-functional initiatives.


  • Maintain visibility into cross-team dependencies, assumptions, constraints, and delivery risks.
  • Facilitate proactive identification and resolution of delivery issues.
  • Coordinate remediation activities for execution risks and delivery challenges.
  • Escalate impediments requiring leadership awareness or decision-making.
  • Monitor initiative health and delivery progress against agreed commitments.
  • Support issue resolution across business, product, technology, operations, compliance, architecture, and shared service teams.
  • Facilitate tradeoff discussions when constraints or dependencies impact delivery commitments.
  • Help teams maintain focus on achieving agreed delivery outcomes.

4. Delivery Visibility & Continuous Improvement

The Solution Manager provides transparency into execution health and supports continual improvement across delivery practices.


  • Develop and maintain solution-level dashboards, reporting, and delivery insights.
  • Provide transparency into delivery progress, readiness, dependencies, risks, impediments, and overall execution health.
  • Facilitate retrospectives and improvement activities across planning and delivery processes.
  • Identify recurring organizational impediments and recommend opportunities for improvement.
  • Promote adoption of Penn Mutual delivery standards, planning practices, and governance expectations.
  • Support leadership discussions with clear, actionable execution insights.
  • Partner with Product Owners, and team leaders to improve planning, coordination, and delivery effectiveness.
  • Encourage continuous learning and operational excellence across participating teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of experience leading complex business, technology, product, program, or transformation initiatives.
  • Experience coordinating work across business and technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and dependencies.
  • Strong facilitation, planning, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to influence and align stakeholders in a matrixed environment without direct authority.
  • Experience with Agile delivery practices and iterative planning approaches.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale business or technology initiatives across multiple teams.
  • Experience with quarterly planning, portfolio execution, dependency management, or enterprise delivery coordination.
  • Experience within the financial services or insurance industry.
  • Experience with Jira and enterprise planning or reporting tools.
  • Relevant Agile, Product, Program, or Change Leadership certifications.

Success Measures

A successful Solution Manager:

  • Improves initiative readiness before execution begins.
  • Increases visibility into dependencies, risks, constraints, and delivery commitments.
  • Enables more predictable and realistic delivery plans.
  • Reduces delivery friction caused by unresolved cross-team dependencies.
  • Improves coordination across business, product, technology, and operational teams.
  • Facilitates informed decision-making through timely and transparent execution reporting.
  • Strengthens planning discipline and delivery effectiveness across participating teams.
  • Supports successful delivery of approved business initiatives.

Capabilities for Success

  • Enterprise mindset and systems thinking.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across business and technology organizations.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and organizational complexity.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both executive leaders and delivery teams.
  • Commitment to collaboration, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to lead through influence and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Role Differentiation

The Solution Manager operates at the initiative and solution level rather than serving as the manager of an individual project, team, or product.


The role does not own:

  • Strategic planning
  • Portfolio prioritization
  • Business case development
  • Funding decisions
  • Investment governance
  • Resource allocation authority
  • Executive portfolio reporting
  • Value realization governance

Instead, the Solution Manager focuses on:

  • Initiative readiness
  • Solution-level planning
  • Cross-team coordination
  • Dependency management
  • Delivery facilitation
  • Execution visibility
  • Risk management
  • Continuous improvement

Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $130,000

Through our partnership with Financial Professionals across the U.S., we help instill the confidence and reliability that comes from a stronger financial future. Intelligence Products and Systems Manager

BLV Applied Intelligence Products and Decision Systems

  • Reports to: Chief Data and Analytics Officer
  • Department: IDEA — Intelligence, Data, Engineering & Analytics
  • Team structure: Two Team Leads and four Analysts across BLV and Applied Intelligence Products

Position Summary

  • The Intelligence Products and Systems Manager is the senior hands-on product leader for BLV and WBL's broader portfolio of applied intelligence products. Reporting to the CDAO, this role manages through two Team Leads, each responsible for two Analysts.
  • One team owns BLV, the corporate valuation product; Applied Intelligence Products owns the broader portfolio of AI-enabled, model-driven, rules-based, and decision-support products. The Manager identifies high-value business problems, determines where AI/ML, rules, optimization, document intelligence, or other approaches are appropriate, and leads products from discovery and business case through requirements, acceptance, deployment, adoption, monitoring, improvement, and retirement.
  • The role requires enough technical depth to prototype, evaluate approaches, challenge evidence, and diagnose product performance while working across Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Business Applications, and business owners.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead Intelligence Product Teams
    • Manage, coach, and develop two Team Leads and four Analysts, with clear ownership, technical standards, feedback, and accountability.
    • Own and prioritize product roadmaps based on user needs, business value, feasibility, data readiness, operational risk, and capacity, with clear success measures and acceptance criteria for each initiative.
    • Own the product portfolio and resource plan; hire, assess performance, develop Team Leads, and build succession coverage for critical product capabilities. Maintain regular hands-on involvement in priority delivery.
  • Build and Operate Intelligence Products
    • Oversee product discovery, prototyping, acceptance, deployment into business use, monitoring, improvement, and retirement. Analytics / Data Science owns analytical methods, predictive model development, and model-performance evidence; Software Engineering owns application architecture, implementation, and release quality.
    • Ensure each product integrates into business processes, supports appropriate human oversight and user adoption, and delivers measurable outcomes. Own product acceptance against agreed criteria; business owners approve policy, intended use, and operating decisions. Coordinate user enablement with Business Applications.
    • Develop product business cases and lead discovery through adoption; use evidence of value, feasibility, and risk to recommend which products to fund, scale, improve, or retire.
  • Govern Models and Systems
    • Establish product controls for evaluation, documentation, explainability, privacy, security, change control, monitoring, and responsible use. Coordinate any required independent validation and business approval separately from development and product acceptance.
    • Own product performance monitoring, exception triage, escalation, and corrective-action follow-through. Route model issues to Data Science, data issues to Data Engineering, and software defects to Software Engineering; coordinate user communication with Business Applications.
    • Review product outcomes with senior business leaders, challenge weak performance evidence, and adjust priorities and controls as user needs and operating conditions change.

Requirements

  • Education:
    • Relevant education or professional training in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, product management, or a related technical discipline is valued. Demonstrated product judgment, technical depth, leadership, and production delivery experience are the primary qualifications; a degree is not mandatory.
  • Required Experience
    • Twelve or more years of progressive experience across applied AI/ML, data science, software, analytics, decision systems, or technical product development, including at least five years of people leadership and meaningful experience leading Team Leads, managers, or senior technical/product staff.
    • Must have demonstrated delivery of AI-enabled or model-driven capabilities into real production use.
    • Demonstrated success building, scaling, or materially improving an applied intelligence, AI product, decision-product, or technical product capability.
    • Must be able to coach Team Leads, develop technical/product talent, own and prioritize a portfolio, write clear product requirements and acceptance criteria, and deliver usable production products with cross-functional teams.
    • Must have experience making funding, sequencing, and trade-off decisions with senior business leaders. Recent hands-on product and technical delivery is required; this is not a management-only role.
    • Experience taking AI-enabled or analytical products from ambiguous business problem through discovery, business case, prototype, requirements, acceptance criteria, production launch, user adoption, monitoring, and iterative improvement.
    • Experience with modern AI product development and evaluation, including model selection, API-based AI services, structured evaluation, retrieval/grounding, LLM workflow design, human-in-the-loop controls, and production observability, alongside meaningful applied AI experience beyond generative AI.
    • Experience building decision-support or decisioning products that combine data, calculations, rules, models, external data sources, and software into a repeatable user-facing capability.
  • Technical Skills
    • Broad applied AI experience selecting and evaluating the right approach for a business problem, including predictive machine learning, rules and decision engines, optimization, document understanding/extraction, NLP, generative AI/LLMs, retrieval, agents or tool-using workflows, and hybrid human-in-the-loop systems as appropriate.
    • Demonstrated production integration, monitoring, user adoption, and measurable business outcomes for AI-enabled or model-driven products. Generative AI experience is valuable but is not sufficient by itself; candidates must show broader applied-AI judgment and enough technical depth to challenge model evidence, limitations, and suitability for intended use.
    • Strong understanding of model and product risk, evaluation design, explainability, privacy, security, data quality, access controls, monitoring, drift or degradation, exception handling, human oversight, and responsible use. Able to communicate technical choices and risk clearly to senior business leaders and translate business requirements into precise direction for data science and engineering teams.
  • Soft Skills
    • Ability to distinguish product ownership from data science and software engineering ownership: define the problem, user experience, requirements, acceptance criteria, operating controls, and outcomes while holding specialist teams accountable for model evidence and software implementation within their domains.
    • This is a senior manager role with substantial individual contribution. The Manager is expected to lead product discovery, develop prototypes, evaluate applied AI approaches, define product behavior and acceptance criteria, challenge model evidence, and investigate performance issues.
    • The Manager must also build a durable organization through hiring, coaching, delegation, roadmap discipline, standards, performance management, and development of Team Leads. Team Leads contribute substantively to delivery as well as supervise their teams.
  • Preferred Background / Industry Experience
    • Experience in lending or financial services, business-user support, and data reconciliation preferred.

Benefits

What We Offer

💰 Compensation in USD.

🏖️ Benefits include paid time off (PTO).

🌍 Work Environment: Fully remote work environment.

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you - submit your CV in English and hit Apply!

jobs.description:
About Tia

Tia is building a new model for women’s healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, dermatology, and wellness across both in-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike.

About the Role

The Associate Manager, Care Coordination & Billing Operations leads two distinct frontline operational teams: the Care Coordination Team and the Revenue Pod (comprising Billing Care Coordinators and co-managed Billing Support Coordinators). This role ensures exceptional member interactions, high-quality service delivery, and accurate, timely billing workflows.

This role serves as a vital bridge between frontline member experience, financial operations, and revenue management. By balancing care delivery with billing oversight, the Associate Manager guides both teams through complex workflows, coaches staff across all levels, resolves high-level escalations, and collaborates closely with cross-functional leadership — including co-managers and the RCM Manager — to optimize processes for scale and quality.

Why Tia

  • Opportunity to help shape and scale a new model of women’s healthcare
  • Mission-driven environment focused on improving care for women across life stages
  • Collaborative, thoughtful team committed to patient and provider experience
  • Modern care model that integrates clinical care, operations, technology, and innovation
  • Meaningful opportunity to help build scalable systems, workflows, and practices

What You’ll Do

  • Manage Care Coordinators, Billing Care Coordinators, and offshore billing support, providing tailored coaching, training, and oversight across different experience levels.
  • Support onboarding, performance management, professional development, and goal setting while fostering collaboration, empathy, and accountability.
  • Oversee care coordination and billing workflows, including task assignment, queues, workload distribution, SLAs, invoice/payment processes, and complex cases.
  • Partner with RCM and co-management to maintain performance, audit work, balance resources, and align frontline operations with broader revenue cycle goals.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for complex member care and billing issues, conducting root-cause analysis to identify and prevent recurring problems.
  • Oversee QA and peer-coaching processes to maintain service quality, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Represent Care Coordination and Billing Operations in cross-functional initiatives and partner with SMEs and RCM to improve workflows and identify automation opportunities.
  • Use member satisfaction, turnaround time, and team performance data to guide coaching and process improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in healthcare operations, care coordination, or contact center management within a membership-based healthcare setting.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of effectively managing teams, driving performance, and cultivating a positive work environment.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare processes, medical terminology, and member engagement in a healthcare context.
  • Proven billing & RCM experience and exposure.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written, along with the ability to empathize and engage with members and teammates.
  • Proficiency in using contact center software, member relationship management (CRM) systems, and Google Workspace
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed in high-pressure situations.
  • Adherence to strict confidentiality standards and understanding of healthcare data privacy regulations, such as HIPAA.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs

Nice to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Management, or related field preferred.

Work Location

This is a fully remote position. US-wide.

Compensation & Benefits

Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions.

The expected compensation for this role is: $61,000 - $76,000

You are also eligible for benefits in accordance with Tia’s benefit plans and eligibility requirements.

About Tia

Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our “Whole Woman, Whole Life” model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in-person care and a national virtual platform.

We are a Series D, venture-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women.

About Tia’s Culture

Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women.

This position may require attendance at company and team off-sites.

Scam Notice

Tia will never ask for payment, gift cards, or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. All communication from our team will come from an official company email address ending in @asktia.com. If something feels off, please contact .

Equal Opportunity

Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply.

If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high-quality work, and making waves in women’s healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Job Post: Bilingual Medical Sales Representative (Dental)

Position Type: Part-Time (20 hours per week)

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 7:30 PM CDT (30-minute Lunch Break)

Work Days: Saturday and Sunday (10 hours per day)

Salary: $6 - $8 per hour (depending on experience) + performance-based commissions for meeting KPIs

DESCRIPTION

Our client is a growing U.S.-based dental group committed to providing high-quality, patient-centered dental care. Their team focuses on building patient trust, delivering excellent service, and helping more patients access the dental care they need through effective communication, technology, and teamwork.

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Bilingual Medical Sales Representative to join their remote team. This position is ideal for a confident communicator who enjoys connecting with prospective patients, conducting outbound calls, overcoming objections, and turning qualified leads into booked appointments.

You will play an important role in helping prospective and existing patients take the next step in their dental care while supporting the practice's growth goals. You'll manage leads across multiple communication channels, maintain accurate CRM records, coordinate appointments, and consistently follow up with prospective patients.

If you are fluent in both Spanish and English, have a strong sales mindset, enjoy working toward measurable targets, and are motivated by the opportunity to earn additional commissions based on performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Sales & Lead Conversion

  • Conduct outbound sales calls and cold calls to prospective patients
  • Engage leads professionally and build rapport through confident, patient-centered conversations
  • Qualify leads and identify their needs, interests, and potential barriers to scheduling
  • Clearly communicate relevant dental services and their benefits
  • Address questions, concerns, and objections professionally
  • Guide qualified leads toward booking an appointment
  • Conduct consistent follow-ups with leads who are not immediately ready to schedule
  • Support lead nurturing and re-engagement initiatives
  • Work toward established sales, appointment-setting, and conversion KPIs
  • Maintain a professional, empathetic approach while pursuing measurable results

Patient Communication & Appointment Setting

  • Respond to prospective and existing patient inquiries through phone, email, chat, and text
  • Handle inbound calls professionally and efficiently
  • Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate patient appointments
  • Maintain accurate and organized calendars
  • Provide clear information and appropriate next steps to patients
  • Communicate fluently and professionally with both English- and Spanish-speaking patients
  • Maintain a calm, helpful, and patient-focused communication style
  • Organize and prioritize incoming communications
  • Assist with approved newsletters and other patient communications as needed

CRM, Lead Management & Campaign Support

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date lead and patient information in the CRM
  • Document calls, conversations, follow-up activities, outcomes, and appointment status
  • Track lead sources and movement through the sales process
  • Support lead qualification, nurturing, and follow-up workflows
  • Monitor personal performance against established KPIs
  • Accurately track appointment-setting and conversion activity
  • Coordinate outreach efforts with active marketing campaigns
  • Assist with campaign tracking and lead-source reporting
  • Maintain organized records to support accurate performance reporting and follow-up

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means combining an excellent patient experience with consistent sales performance. A successful Medical Sales Representative will:

  • Consistently conduct proactive outbound outreach and follow-ups
  • Convert qualified leads into booked dental appointments
  • Communicate confidently and professionally in both Spanish and English
  • Effectively address questions and objections
  • Maintain accurate CRM and lead records
  • Consistently work toward established KPIs and performance goals
  • Provide prompt and professional responses across multiple communication channels
  • Maintain strong organization and follow-through
  • Deliver a positive experience throughout every patient interaction

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Fluent professional communication skills in both Spanish and English
  • Relevant experience in sales, cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, lead conversion, or a similar results-driven role
  • Experience conducting outbound calls and following up with prospective customers or patients
  • Strong ability to qualify, nurture, and follow up with leads
  • Confident and persuasive communication skills
  • Ability to professionally handle questions, concerns, and objections
  • Strong active listening and interpersonal skills
  • Customer-focused, calm, empathetic, and professional communication style
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Comfortable working toward measurable sales and appointment-setting KPIs
  • Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to manage multiple leads and conversations simultaneously
  • Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail
  • Ability to maintain accurate lead and activity records
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
  • Reliable, resilient, and motivated by achieving results

Sales & Marketing Skills

  • Experience with lead qualification and nurturing
  • Experience managing follow-up sequences and outreach
  • Ability to align outreach efforts with marketing campaigns
  • Ability to accurately track lead sources and performance metrics
  • Understanding of the importance of conversion rates and other sales KPIs
  • Comfortable receiving coaching and adjusting outreach strategies based on performance

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience as a Dental Virtual Assistant
  • Previous dental or healthcare sales experience
  • Experience with dental appointment setting or patient coordination
  • Familiarity with dental terminology
  • Basic understanding of dental insurance
  • Experience using Open Dental
  • Experience using Dentrix
  • Experience using Eaglesoft
  • Experience with CRM platforms
  • Experience with VoIP or cloud-based phone systems
  • Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based dental or healthcare practice

Dental experience is a strong advantage, but candidates with excellent bilingual communication skills and a proven background in sales, cold calling, and appointment conversion are also encouraged to apply.

HIPAA & Patient Confidentiality

  • Understand and follow HIPAA requirements when handling patient information
  • Maintain patient confidentiality across phone, email, chat, text, CRM, and other communication channels
  • Handle patient and lead information professionally and securely

Basic Requirements

  • Must be fluent in Spanish and English
  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English
  • Must have relevant sales, appointment-setting, lead generation, healthcare, dental, or related professional experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required
  • Must be available to work part-time on Saturdays and Sundays for 10 hours per day (20 hours per week)

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.description:
This role is focused on a market-leading Industrial AI solution designed to help organizations measure, disclose, and optimize their impact on the path to decarbonization.

The solution enables customers to move beyond static sustainability reporting to operational, decision-grade intelligence embedded directly into how the business runs.

The platform delivers:

  • End-to-end carbon intelligence across Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions

  • A scalable, actionable pathway for decarbonization in complex industrial environments

  • Near real-time insights that enable faster, smarter operational and strategic decisions

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering scalable, cloud-based Industrial AI solutions that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the business. You will provide technical leadership across both front-end and back-end development, influence architectural decisions, and help evolve the platform into a secure, observable, high-quality product portfolio.

This role requires a strong engineering mindset, hands-on full stack capability, and the ability to work across multiple general-purpose programming languages and frameworks — including, but not limited to, GoLang and React. You will be expected to continuously learn, adapt, and guide others as technologies and product needs evolve.

While this role begins within an Industrial emissions intelligence solution, it is not confined to a single product or problem space. It is an entry point into a broader AI-driven product portfolio, with opportunities to expand across products, domains, and technologies as the platform evolves.

Core Responsibilities :

  • Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of scalable APIs, services, and accessibility-first user interfaces.

  • Drive the modernization of legacy systems into modular, event-driven, API-first components.

  • Deliver AI-native features and improvements across both front-end and back-end, using multiple programming languages where required.

  • Provide technical direction and make sound engineering trade-offs around scalability, maintainability, performance, and product impact.

  • Own reliability and operational excellence, including telemetry, SLOs, error budgets, on-call rotations, incident response, and continuous service improvement.

  • Champion DevOps practices, including CI/CD, deployment automation, monitoring, and application-level operations.

  • Collaborate with Platform Engineers as part of a lean DevOps shared service model, while taking responsibility for application-level DevOps within the team.

  • Mentor engineers, promote engineering best practices, and help raise the technical bar across the team.

  • Champion code quality, documentation, automated testing, performance, security, and maintainability.

  • Take full ownership of the quality of deliverables, including test automation, continuous improvement, and production readiness.

  • Partner closely with Product Management, Design, AI, Platform Engineering, and other engineering teams on product discovery, technical trade-offs, and delivery.

  • Bring a product- and customer-led mindset to solving customer pain points with elegant, scalable engineering solutions.

  • Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve the platform architecture and engineering ways of working.

Essential :

  • Strong experience in full stack software engineering, with proven capability across both front-end and back-end development.

  • Solid experience with modern front-end technologies, particularly React or similar frameworks.

  • Strong back-end engineering experience, ideally including GoLang or comparable general-purpose programming languages.

  • Experience designing and building scalable APIs, services, and cloud-native applications.

  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, automation, and incident response.

  • Experience delivering secure, observable, high-quality production software.

  • Strong focus on code quality, automated testing, documentation, performance, and maintainability.

  • Ability to lead technical design discussions and influence architectural decisions.

  • Effective collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering teams.

  • Ownership mindset, with the ability to take accountability for outcomes from design through to production.

Desirable :

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, distributed systems, or microservices.

  • Experience modernizing legacy systems into modular, scalable platforms.

  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to engineering standards.

  • Experience with AI-enabled, data-intensive, sustainability, carbon intelligence, or enterprise SaaS products.

  • Familiarity with observability, reliability engineering, SLOs, error budgets, and production incident management.

What We’re Looking For :

We are looking for a senior engineer who can combine strong hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You should be comfortable building across the stack, making architectural decisions, improving engineering practices, and influencing how products are designed, delivered, and operated.

You will be successful in this role if you enjoy solving complex customer problems, building scalable cloud-native systems, collaborating across disciplines, and helping teams deliver high-quality software that has real-world impact.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
