jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

Understanding cyber risk at internet scale is a difficult product problem. The data must be broad enough to identify meaningful exposures, accurate enough to support important decisions, and timely enough to be useful when it matters. As Product Manager, Scanning & Risk Data, you will bring a product perspective to this challenge. jobs.description:
OnTrac is hiring a Sr Cyber Security Engineer (PAM / IAM)!

Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!

Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.

Location: Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals. Compensation: The expected starting base pay range for this position is $156,000 - $195,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $156,000 - $234,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan of up to a 20% Bonus Target.

Employment Logistics:

The Sr. Cyber Security Engineer is a senior-level individual contributor and hands-on technical owner for Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Entra ID, Microsoft 365, vulnerability management, and mobile device management. This broad security engineering role requires deep identity expertise alongside the ability to support endpoint, cloud, and SaaS security. The Engineer partners daily with IT to secure infrastructure and end-user services, enables the Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) as a Tier 3 escalation point, and supports Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) by translating control requirements into technical configurations and automated evidence collection.

Unpacking the Benefits:

Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
  • Two (2) floating holidays per year
  • Paid sick leave*
  • Six (6) paid company holidays
  • Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
  • Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.

The Must-Haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in IT and Security, including at least 3 years dedicated to IAM or security engineering in an enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated hands-on ownership of at least two of the following:
  • Entra ID / Microsoft 365
  • A PAM platform
  • Qualys or equivalent vulnerability management platform
  • Intune / JAMF device management
  • Hands-on expertise with identity lifecycle, RBAC design, entitlement and access certification, federation and SSO integrations, and privileged-access tooling and workflows
  • Strong working knowledge of Entra ID, including Conditional Access, Identity Protection, PIM, and entitlement management, plus the Microsoft 365 security and compliance stack
  • Working knowledge of Intune, JAMF, and Google device management, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, and application deployment across mixed operating-system environments
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Python, or Bash
  • Ability to interpret NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 and implement the technical controls and evidence required to meet them
  • Certifications such as SC-300, SC-200, AZ-500, CISSP, CISM, GIAC GCIA, GIAC GDSA, or relevant PAM, JAMF, or Qualys vendor certifications
  • Ability to travel up to 10%
  • ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

Your Mission in Motion:

A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.

  • Identity and privileged-access engineering: Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise identity services across Entra ID and hybrid Active Directory, including SAML/OIDC federation, SSO, Conditional Access, MFA and phishing-resistant authentication, joiner/mover/leaver automation, RBAC, role and group governance, access reviews, credential vaulting, session monitoring, just-in-time elevation, tiered administration, service-account governance, and break-glass procedures.
  • Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security: Harden and administer Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Defender, Purview, and the Entra ID tenant, including configuration baselines, application registration and OAuth consent governance, license-aligned feature enablement, and posture remediation.
  • Vulnerability, endpoint and mobile security: Operate Qualys, including asset coverage, tagging, authenticated scanning, agents, policy compliance, and risk-based reporting; drive remediation within established SLAs; and manage compliance, configuration, enrollment, encryption, patching, application deployment, and device-posture signals across Intune, JAMF, and Google device management for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
  • IT partnership and security by design: Serve as the embedded security engineering partner for directory, endpoint, network, and infrastructure changes, applying security by design to projects, migrations, and new deployments without unnecessarily slowing delivery.
  • CSIRT enablement and Tier 3 escalation: Support complex identity and endpoint incidents through containment actions, including token revocation, account disablement, and device isolation; assist with evidence collection, log-source onboarding, and detection tuning in partnership with CSIRT and the MDR provider.
  • GRC enablement and technical controls: Translate requirements from NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 into technical configurations and automated evidence collection that supports audits, third-party risk reviews, and risk-remediation tracking.
  • Automation, documentation and mentorship: Automate recurring identity, access, integration, and reporting tasks using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and Python; maintain runbooks, SOPs, architecture diagrams, and platform standards; and provide technical guidance to analysts and junior engineers.

Paving your way to your success:

  • You explain technical risk clearly to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across IT, CSIRT, GRC, and business teams.
  • You bring proficiency across identity, endpoint, network security, cloud environments including Azure, GCP, and AWS, and SaaS administration, moving effectively between domains as priorities shift.
  • You analyze complex issues by thoroughly evaluating multiple variables and their technical and business implications.
  • You define appropriate methods and procedures for new assignments, using sound judgment to select, adapt, and evaluate advanced techniques.
  • You build strong stakeholder relationships beyond your area of expertise, adapting your communication style and using persuasive skills to align decisions with broader business objectives.

Posting Timeline:

This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 15 days from the date of posting

  • Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.

Reporting directly to the leader responsible for Adult Traffic Acquisition and collaborating closely with the Head of Marketing Growth, the successful candidate will help scale Our Client's existing affiliate business and unlock new revenue and traffic partnerships. Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with S2S postbacks, tracking parameters, attribution, pixels, ad servers, and conversion-event setups.

jobs.description:
Own and maintain the end-to-end migration strategy and CV.010 Data Migration Pack.

• Start data profiling from mobilisation and establish migration-object inventory, source systems, data owners, templates, history requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Define and obtain approval for source-to-target mappings, transformation/defaulting rules, load methods, sequencing and reconciliation controls.

• Plan and run the migration method through discovery/profiling, mapping/cleansing, trial cycles, business validation/reconciliation, production migration and final sign-off.

• Coordinate sample data for early solution validation and CRP activities.

• Plan and execute mock/full-list migration cycles before final UAT and cutover; refine scripts/mappings based on evidence.

• Coordinate migration defects, rejected records, controlled re-runs and cross-module data dependencies.

• Ensure stable target configuration and master-data ownership decisions exist before dependent loads are baselined.

• Define final extraction freeze, production migration sequence, validation checkpoints and business approval process.

• Produce reconciliation reports and evidence across object counts, financial/control values and exceptions.

• Coordinate production-data masking in lower environments with the Security/OCI lead.

• Support migration-related data defects and reconciliation during hypercare and complete final handover documentation.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of Oracle ERP / Oracle Fusion data migration experience on complex implementations or transformations.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Oracle Fusion migration mechanisms such as FBDI, HDL, BICC or equivalent supported Oracle load/extract approaches.
  • Proven experience in data discovery/profiling, migration-object inventory, source-to-target mapping, transformation rules and load specifications.
  • Experience governing cleansing ownership: business/source owners validate and correct data; the migration team controls templates, rules, defects and evidence.
  • Experience planning and executing sample, mock/full-list and production migration cycles, including controlled re-runs.

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is looking for a Formal Verification Engineer to help ensure the correctness of our next generation of high-performance RISC-V CPUs and AI compute platforms. You’ll use formal methods to prove complex hardware behavior, uncover corner cases that simulation may miss, and give architects and RTL designers confidence in the correctness of their designs. You’ll work closely with CPU architects, RTL designers, and other DV engineers to develop properties, build formal verification environments, analyze failures, and drive issues to closure. This is a hands-on opportunity to apply formal techniques to challenging problems in modern processor design.

This role isremote, based out of North America or Spain.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • A verification engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and finding bugs that are difficult to expose through traditional simulation.
  • Comfortable thinking about hardware behavior in terms of properties, invariants, assumptions, assertions, and proofs.
  • A strong debugger who can analyze counterexamples, understand RTL behavior, and determine the root cause of failures.
  • Collaborative and curious, with an interest in working closely with architects and RTL designers to improve design quality.
  • Excited by the challenges of verifying high-performance CPUs and complex digital hardware.

What We Need

  • 6+ years of experience in design verification, formal verification, or related RTL verification for CPUs, SoCs, ASICs, or complex digital designs.
  • Hands-on experience with formal verification methodologies and tools, including property checking, assertions, assumptions, constraints, and coverage analysis.
  • Strong SystemVerilog skills, including experience writing and debugging SVA.
  • Solid understanding of digital design and computer architecture; experience with CPU pipelines, caches, interfaces, control logic, or other complex microarchitecture is highly valuable.
  • Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Tcl, C/C++, or similar, with excellent debugging and problem-solving abilities.

What You Will Learn

  • Gain deep experience applying formal verification to high-performance, out-of-order RISC-V CPU designs.
  • Learn how to identify which hardware behaviors are best verified through formal methods versus simulation, emulation, and other DV techniques.
  • Develop expertise in writing scalable properties and proofs for complex control logic and interacting microarchitectural blocks.
  • Learn how architectural intent translates into formal properties, assumptions, and measurable verification goals.
  • Work alongside world-class CPU architects and RTL engineers on next-generation processors for AI, HPC, and high-performance computing.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. Founded in 2010, our goal is to scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.”

We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

About the Role:

The Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing a high-volume portfolio of Wunderkind’s SMB clients, with a focus on retention, renewals, and expansion. You’ll own the commercial client relationship, develop a strong understanding of each client’s business priorities, and take a consultative approach to identifying opportunities that deepen the partnership and drive additional value through Wunderkind’s platform and solutions.

You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Portfolio Directors, and other cross-functional teams to ensure clients are realizing value while maintaining clear ownership of the relationship, renewal strategy, and expansion opportunities.

This role requires someone who can balance relationship building with commercial discipline. You’ll manage a high-volume book of business, prioritize effectively across risk and opportunity, and turn a strong understanding of your clients’ businesses into retention and growth.

Success in this role is measured by Gross Retention, Expansion, and Client Relationship Management.

Responsibilities and Level of Effort (LOE):

Retention & Renewals (35%)

  • Own renewal strategy and outcomes across an assigned portfolio of SMB clients, proactively identifying risks and developing action plans to support strong retention.

  • Build trusted relationships with key client stakeholders and understand the business priorities, partnership history, and internal dynamics that influence renewal decisions.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Portfolio Directors, bringing client context, relationship insights, and commercial strategy to renewal conversations.

  • Surface risks early and drive clear next steps rather than waiting for renewal conversations to expose them.

  • Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and ensure client risks, opportunities, and next steps are clearly documented.

  • Lead renewal conversations with confidence, balancing client needs with Wunderkind’s commercial objectives.

Expansion & Growth (30%)

  • Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships through additional products, capabilities, and solutions.

  • Develop a strong understanding of client objectives and connect relevant Wunderkind capabilities to opportunities for incremental value and revenue growth.

  • Lead expansion opportunities from identification through close, including discovery, positioning, solution alignment, and internal coordination.

  • Take a consultative approach to growth. Understand the business problem first, then connect it to the right solution rather than simply selling additional products.

  • Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities and provide accurate forecasting against growth targets.

  • Partner with Customer Success and other internal teams to turn client performance, needs, and evolving priorities into thoughtful growth opportunities.

Client Relationship Management (20%)

  • Serve as a key relationship owner for assigned accounts, ensuring a consistent and professional client experience throughout the lifecycle.

  • Build real relationships across the client organization and develop a strong understanding of each client’s business, objectives, challenges, and growth potential.

  • Communicate Wunderkind’s value clearly and confidently, helping clients understand how our platform and capabilities can support their evolving needs.

  • Establish credibility as a commercial partner clients trust to have direct, productive conversations about their business and partnership.

  • Navigate challenging conversations around risk, renewals, expectations, and commercial terms with professionalism and sound judgment.

Portfolio & Operational Excellence (15%)

  • Manage a high-volume book of business, prioritizing activity based on client health, renewal timing, revenue opportunity, and risk.

  • Maintain accurate and timely account, opportunity, renewal, pipeline, and forecasting information within Salesforce.

  • Partner across Customer Success, Portfolio Directors, Professional Services, Product, and other teams to align on client needs and support account outcomes.

  • Leverage processes, tools, data, automation, and AI to manage the portfolio efficiently and consistently at scale.

  • Maintain strong account discipline and visibility so internal partners have a clear understanding of account health, commercial opportunities, risks, and next steps.

What We're Looking For

  • Commercially minded and client-obsessed. You genuinely want to understand your clients’ businesses and can translate that understanding into stronger relationships, retention, and growth.

  • A relationship builder. You establish credibility quickly, develop trusted client relationships, and know how to navigate different personalities and stakeholders.

  • Consultative. You ask good questions, uncover the real business need, and connect it to a solution that creates value rather than simply pushing a product.

  • Growth-oriented. You naturally look for opportunities to deepen partnerships and are comfortable owning expansion conversations from discovery through close.

  • Full ownership. You don’t wait for someone else to surface a renewal risk, move an opportunity forward, or solve a client issue. You drive to an outcome.

  • Highly organized. You can manage a high-volume portfolio without losing sight of renewal dates, opportunities, risks, or commitments.

  • Data-minded and disciplined. You use account data, client health, pipeline information, and forecasting to decide where to focus your time.

  • A smart, honest user of AI. We give our team modern AI tooling and expect you to use it to work more effectively across research, preparation, analysis, and account management. We also expect you to review outputs, validate information, and own the judgment behind your work.

  • Direct and unafraid. You raise risks early, communicate clearly, and can navigate difficult commercial conversations without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Polished and credible. You’re comfortable representing Wunderkind with client stakeholders and can communicate clearly and confidently in both day-to-day and higher-stakes conversations.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in a client-facing Account Management, Business Development, Customer Success, or similar commercial role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, or a related environment.

  • Demonstrated experience managing renewals, expansion opportunities, or a revenue-generating book of business with success against retention and growth targets.

  • Strong relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and consultative skills, with the ability to understand client objectives and identify opportunities to drive additional value.

  • Experience managing a portfolio or book of business with multiple simultaneous renewals, opportunities, and competing priorities.

  • Strong business judgment and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience with digital marketing, marketing technology, or consumer brands.

  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM to manage accounts, opportunities, pipeline, and forecasting.

  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to drive outcomes through teams you do not directly manage.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

The base salary range for this role is $85,000-$100,000 base + variable. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

jobs.title: Marketing Director
jobs.excerpt: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology company building AI-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry.
jobs.description:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology company building AI-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.

Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Marketing Director to own Marketing end to end, reporting directly to the CEO and leading a lean team of two. Marketing's role is to make Portcast's value clear to the market, build demand with the right customers, and help our Commercial team win.

This is a builder role. You won't inherit a large marketing organisation or an established playbook. You'll set the strategy, decide what matters, and stay close to execution. You'll also own our events and demand generation strategy, with a clear focus on creating measurable business impact.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building, is comfortable operating with limited resources, and naturally takes ownership without waiting for direction. You should be curious about our customers and industry, excited by AI, and able to turn complex products into stories that enterprise freight forwarders understand and care about.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

    • Marketing strategy and direction: Translate company goals and the needs of the CEO, Sales, and Product into a clear, prioritized marketing strategy and quarterly plans with measurable goals, ensuring every initiative contributes to pipeline growth & customer expansion.

    • Demand generation and inbound pipeline: Own the inbound pipeline and the marketing levers that influence it. Work closely with the Growth Marketing Manager to understand performance, identify opportunities, test new approaches, and reallocate effort and spend towards what is working. You should be able to connect marketing activity to pipeline quality and commercial outcomes.

    • Product marketing: Work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Solutions, and customers to deeply understand new capabilities, identify differentiated messaging, and bring new products and features to market. Build sales enablement materials, competitive positioning, customer stories, and launch plans that help our Commercial team succeed. We don't want marketing to simply receive launch requests. We want someone who actively drives the launch process, challenges whether we're telling the right story, and ensures great product work never goes unnoticed.

    • Customer and market insight: Stay close to customers, prospects, competitors, and the logistics technology market. Use customer conversations, sales feedback, win/loss insights, and market research to identify opportunities for sharper positioning, better content, stronger campaigns, and new go-to-market initiatives.

    • Event marketing: Decide which events are worth attending or sponsoring each quarter, own organizer outreach and logistics, and make sure we show up where our buyers are.

    • Cross Functional Leadership: Partner closely with the CEO, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions to align marketing with business priorities. Proactively identify opportunities for launches, campaigns, and market education instead of waiting for requests. You'll be expected to navigate pressure from multiple stakeholders, prioritize effectively, communicate trade offs clearly, and ensure marketing consistently delivers the highest business impact.

    • Team leadership: Lead and mentor a lean team of two marketers. Set clear priorities, coach team members, provide regular feedback, raise the quality bar across marketing, and create an environment where people continue to grow while maintaining high execution standards.

    • Data-driven decisions: Own the inbound pipeline and every lever in it. Measure what matters, find the right insights, and reallocate spend and effort to what's working. Your reporting should make trade-offs obvious.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

    • Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent.

    • Proven marketing leadership experience owning marketing for a complex, enterprise B2B SaaS product with a consultative sales motion, meaningful ACVs, and multiple stakeholders involved in the buying decision. We are not looking for a background primarily in low-ACV, transactional, self-serve, or horizontal SaaS. Experience in logistics, supply chain, industrial, manufacturing, fintech, cybersecurity, data, or other complex B2B technology environments is particularly relevant.

    • Curiosity for Logistics Domain: Experience in logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is highly valued, but so is a genuine curiosity to understand our market in depth.

    • Commercial mindset: You understand that Marketing in an enterprise business needs to contribute to revenue and you have worked closely with Sales on longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and can point to measurable impact on pipeline, opportunities, win rates, revenue, or customer acquisition.

    • Product Marketing Expertise: You have a strong product marketing foundation with experience owning positioning, messaging, go to market strategy, product launches, customer storytelling, and sales enablement. You know how to turn technical products into compelling business narratives.

    • Ownership and Initiative: You naturally spot opportunities before others do. You don't wait for someone to ask you to market a new feature, write a customer story, or launch a campaign. You proactively identify what matters, build momentum across teams, and drive initiatives through to completion with minimal direction.

    • Growth and demand generation: You have a good working understanding of performance marketing and the key metrics behind it. The Growth Marketing Manager will own execution, day-to-day delivery, and experiment design. Your role is to stay close to performance, provide input where needed, and ensure work is aligned to broader business priorities.

    • Content quality and standards: Execution and production of content will sit with the Content Marketing Manager, while your role is to guide direction, review output, and set them to a higher standard.

    • AI Forward Mindset: You consistently apply AI across advanced marketing workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge.

    • Startup Builder Mentality: You thrive in lean, fast moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited. You're comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution and enjoy building processes, programs, and marketing assets yourself when needed.

    • Cross Functional Influence: You are comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating competing priorities, and driving alignment across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Solutions.

    • People leader and mentor: You develop the people around you. You give honest feedback and care about your team's growth as much as their output.

    • Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right. You can simplify complex ideas, influence stakeholders, and build trust across diverse groups.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

    • Build in an industry that's still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics & supply chain technology is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant opportunities to rethink how enterprise software is marketed. You'll have the opportunity to bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great marketing looks like in this industry.

    • Shape how the market sees Portcast and work at the intersection of AI and logistics: We have a strong product, established enterprise customers, and a significant opportunity to sharpen how we position ourselves in the market.

    • We're small by design and fully distributed across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. There are few layers between an idea and execution, and your decisions can directly influence pipeline, revenue, product launches, customer perception, and company growth.

OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO

    • Curiosity: We dig into why a campaign worked or didn't, why a deal moved or stalled, how a freight forwarder actually operates, and what customers really value..

    • Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to market, and we stay on a problem until it actually moves the number.

    • Raising the bar: We don't settle for content or campaigns that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for quality, craft, and the experience our brand creates.

    • Effectiveness: We focus on marketing that creates real pipeline and revenue impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship work that drives outcomes, not just output.

      • Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through marketing that is as sharp as the product behind it.

jobs.description:
Overview

Detection and Response Lead

One Identity · Information Security, Cyber Defense

Senior individual contributor, practice lead · India · Reports to the Director of Information Security

Why this role exists

One Identity builds the software that decides who gets into everything else our customers run, and the ground this practice defends is our own: the corporate environment and the hosted services we operate in the cloud. Coverage spans external attacks and insider threats across everything we run, and the detection work is shaped around that full range.

Twenty-four seven monitoring is handled by a managed provider, which means this is not a shift-rotation job. The provider covers first-line triage and escalates when needed. This role owns everything above the provider: what gets detected in the first place, whether the coverage matches how we're actually attacked, how good the escalations are, and what happens once something real lands on the desk. Directing that relationship well is a large part of the work.

We're separating from Quest Software and building an independent security function. The team is lean and globally distributed, and this role leads the detection and response practice inside it. Scope comes from what you build and from the standard you set for what a real incident response looks like here.

What you'll do

Own what gets detected

  • Set the strategy for detection use cases and own the catalog built from it: identity and authentication abuse, privileged access misuse, cloud control plane activity across Azure and AWS, endpoint and email vectors, and the paths specific to how our own products are deployed internally.
  • Treat detections as code. Version them, review them, test them against real telemetry, and track coverage against a threat model rather than a vendor's rule count. Detection changes arrive as pull requests with the reasoning attached.
  • Own the signal quality problem end to end. Tune what's noisy, retire what's dead, and know which gaps are deliberate.
  • Set the telemetry standard. Decide what we need to collect and retain to investigate an incident properly, and make the case for it when that costs something.

Own the response

  • Lead incident response from escalation through closure: scoping, containment, evidence handling, root cause, and the write-up that survives a customer or auditor reading it.
  • Direct the managed provider. Set escalation criteria, hold the quality bar on what comes through, and close the loop when something should have been caught and wasn't.
  • Run the exercises that make a response work under pressure. Tabletops with engineering and leadership, and the runbooks that make an on-call decision obvious at two in the morning.
  • Own the notification path. Know which obligations attach to which kinds of incident, contractual and regulatory, and make sure the clock is understood before it's running.
  • Work with product security when an incident touches what we ship. Internal detection and customer-facing disclosure are different disciplines that occasionally share a root cause.

Make it scale

  • Decide where agentic workflows belong in detection and response. Enrichment, correlation, and first-pass investigation are tractable now; containment actions are a harder call. You set where automation acts, where it recommends, and how we verify what it did.
  • Automate the response path itself, not just the alerting. The measure is how much of an investigation is already done by the time a person opens it.
  • Bring threat intelligence into the practice with an output attached: adversary tradecraft translated into detection use cases, hunts, or control changes.
  • Advance the program's metrics: coverage against the threat model, escalation quality from the provider, time to detect and time to close, reported in terms leadership steers by.
  • Hunt on a schedule. Structured hypotheses against our own telemetry, and every finding either becomes a detection or gets written down as a deliberate gap.

What we're looking for

Required

Eight or more years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response, with time spent leading incidents rather than only working them. Equivalent depth counts.

  • Detection engineering in a modern SIEM, with the query fluency to build and validate rules yourself. We run Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR.
  • Identity attack fluency. Entra ID and Active Directory attack paths, token and session abuse, OAuth consent, and federation.
  • Hands-on work with AI-assisted detection, triage, or investigation within the last six months, and a considered view on where automation should and shouldn't be trusted to act.

The three above are the bar. Everything below is depth we'd like and can build. If you meet the requirements and bring most of the rest, apply. We'd rather assess the gap ourselves than have you decide it for us.

Also matters: cloud detection across Azure and AWS control planes; scripting and automation in Python or PowerShell; managing or directing an MDR or managed SOC relationship; forensic investigation and evidence handling; writing that holds up when an executive or an auditor reads it.

Helpful: threat hunting from structured hypotheses; insider risk detection, container and Kubernetes runtime detection, SOAR or workflow automation platforms, threat intelligence work with an operational output, prior time on the engineering side.

What you should know going in

This is a practice to build, not a queue to work. The managed tier handles the volume, which leaves you the engineering and the judgment: what we detect, how well, and what happens next. You'll have functional direction of the SOC analysts, with people leadership held by the director, and direct access to engineering leadership. Your incident write-ups will be read at the executive level. If you want to own a detection and response practice rather than inherit someone else's rules, this is that seat.

Company Description

One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyse information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward.

With team members around the globe, we intend to continue to grow revenues and add value to customers.

When you join our team, you will have the opportunity to build and develop products at a scale few others can provide.

Our product portfolio serves a large base of customers and we are addressing the strategic imperatives for enterprise businesses.

Working with some of the most talented employees the industry has to offer, we provide enhanced career opportunities for team members to learn and grow in a rapidly changing environment.

Why work with us?

Life at One Identity means collaborating with dedicated professionals with a passion for technology.

When we see something that could be improved, we get to work inventing the solution.

Our people demonstrate our winning culture through positive and meaningful relationships.

We invest in our people and offer a series of programs that enables them to pursue a career that fulfills their potential.

Our team members’ health and wellness is our priority as well as rewarding them for their hard work.

One Identity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: One Identity is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

All employment decisions at One Identity are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

One Identity will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. One Identity encourages applicants of all ages.

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager – Disaster Recovery & Cyber Resilience in Pharma
jobs.excerpt: The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of a strategic Disaster Recovery (DR) and cyber resilience program across APAC and Europe.
jobs.description:
The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of a strategic Disaster Recovery (DR) and cyber resilience program across APAC and Europe. The role focuses on establishing and expanding regional DR capabilities, enabling recovery of business-critical applications, and introducing recovery automation to improve resilience, recovery speed, and failover readiness. The Project Manager coordinates infrastructure, network, security, application, and business stakeholders to ensure critical services can be recovered within agreed recovery objectives following major disruptions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Disaster Recovery and cyber resilience initiatives across multiple regions and sites.
  • Manage the establishment of an in-region co-location DR facility, including network connectivity, storage, Nutanix, VMware, firewalls, and application onboarding.
  • Coordinate DR enablement and recovery readiness for business-critical applications, including recovery planning, testing, and site failover exercises.
  • Drive implementation of Ansible-based recovery automation, including automated technical runbooks and recovery playbooks.
  • Manage related cyber resilience initiatives, including Citrix modernization, Azure MFA, malware protection, and remediation of identified security findings.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Infrastructure, Network, Security, Applications, Business Continuity, vendors, and regional/site stakeholders.
  • Own project planning, budget, resources, dependencies, RAID management, governance, and executive status reporting.
  • Ensure DR solutions are successfully tested, documented, transitioned to operations, and capable of meeting defined recovery objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of IT project management experience, preferably in Disaster Recovery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or business continuity projects.
  • Strong understanding of Disaster Recovery concepts, business continuity, recovery testing, failover, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Experience in regulated pharmaceutical environments (GxP documentation).
  • Experience managing infrastructure projects involving technologies such as VMware, Nutanix, storage, networking, firewalls, and co-location/data center environments.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation and recovery orchestration; experience with Ansible is highly advantageous.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity technologies such as MFA, malware protection, Citrix, and security remediation.
  • Proven experience managing global or multi-site projects, technical vendors, risks, budgets, and cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, governance, and executive reporting skills.
  • Fluent business English and ability to collaborate effectively across global teams.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN FUSION:

At Fusion, you’ll join a diverse team of talented professionals from around the world, united by a passion for delivering impactful digital transformation in the life sciences industry. You’ll be part of a flat-structured, collaborative organization where decisions are made efficiently, and your expertise directly shapes client outcomes.

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

Joining Fusion means becoming part of a company that:

  • Builds strong, trusted partnerships with clients, delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.
  • Drives delivery excellence, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
  • Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
  • Operates with a truly global mindset, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

WHAT WE OFFER - FUSION BENEFITS

We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well-being, and global mobility.

Growth & Development

  • Invest in Your Learning: Access annual budget for professional development.
  • Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
  • Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.
  • Shape an Inclusive Culture: Thrive in a workplace where your individuality is valued, and your voice drives meaningful change.

Recognition & Reward

  • Earn What You’re Worth: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package that reflects your impact.
  • Refer Talent: Get rewarded for recommending new hires through our referral program.
  • Stay Rewarded: Access loyalty-based benefits starting from your third year via the Unity Scheme.

Global Mobility & Local Support

  • Navigate Global Moves: Get help with visas, permits, and international assignments.
  • Benefit Locally: Enjoy perks tailored to your country of residence.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work in a diverse, inclusive culture where global teamwork drives success

Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S/4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.
