jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Emerging Transportation Technology
jobs.excerpt: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities.
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

We are looking for a motivated and curious Technical Project Manager who is ready to grow their career while taking on meaningful responsibility across technology-focused client engagements. This role offers the opportunity to manage projects, work directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams, develop expertise in emerging solutions, and gain broader exposure to the business behind the projects. As part of Parsons X, you will bring together client teams, Parsons technical and business resources, partners, and subcontractors to solve complex problems and deliver successful outcomes, while building the experience needed to take on increasingly complex project leadership roles.


This position is well suited for someone with several years of experience supporting or managing technology projects who is ready for greater ownership and responsibility. We are not necessarily looking for the most seasoned Project Manager. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sound judgment, initiative, and the drive to grow.


Approximately 70% of the role will focus on project delivery, with the remaining time supporting Parsons X business operations and strategic priorities.

An initial area of focus will be Asset Guardian, a growing Parsons X solution that brings together sensor-generated and other infrastructure data to help clients put trusted asset information to work within their existing environments. Early engagements will include pilots and smaller implementations, with the opportunity to manage larger and more complex implementations as client adoption grows.


This role is not limited to Asset Guardian. The Technical Project Manager will have opportunities to support other Parsons X technology projects and emerging solution engagements based on client and business needs.

The role reports directly to the head of Parsons X, providing exposure to leadership priorities, client engagements, proposals and pursuits, management briefings, presentations, and other initiatives across the business. For someone who is curious about how projects, clients, technology, people, and growth come together, this role offers a unique opportunity to develop a broader business perspective while building a project management career.


Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery and Client Management

  • Manage technology projects and client engagements from initiation through completion, including scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, risks, issues, and overall project performance.
  • Bring together client teams, Parsons technical and business resources, partners, and subcontractors to create an integrated project team with clear roles, shared priorities, and accountability for delivery.
  • Lead internal and client project meetings, establish clear objectives, facilitate productive discussions, capture decisions and action items, and ensure commitments are followed through to completion.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, dashboards, status reports, financial forecasts, risk and issue tracking, and other tools required to provide clear visibility into project health and outcomes.
  • Communicate project status succinctly to clients, project teams, and leadership, focusing on progress, outcomes, schedule, financial performance, risks, decisions, and required actions.
  • Manage project budgets and forecasts and understand how project performance, staffing, scope, and schedule decisions affect monthly and overall financial results.
  • Identify risks and issues early and take an active role in driving them toward resolution.
  • Build trusted client relationships and confidently take the lead in client conversations, including on-site meetings and project activities when appropriate.
  • Listen beyond immediate project requirements to understand broader client needs and identify opportunities where Parsons may be able to provide additional value.
  • Foster collaboration across organizations and disciplines, working through competing priorities and differing perspectives while keeping teams focused on shared project outcomes.

Emerging Solutions and Technology Delivery

  • Serve as Project Manager for Asset Guardian pilots and implementations, as well as other Parsons X technology and emerging solution engagements as assigned.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of the solutions being delivered, including the technology, data, client environment, and intended business outcomes.
  • For Asset Guardian, develop an understanding of how sensor and other infrastructure data are generated, processed, and integrated into client environments.
  • Work closely with solution leaders, technical teams, clients, partners, and subcontractors to coordinate implementation activities and resolve delivery issues.
  • Develop sufficient solution knowledge to confidently support customer demonstrations, onboarding, training, and ongoing client engagement.
  • Help establish repeatable project management processes, templates, tools, and delivery practices that can scale as emerging solutions mature and client adoption grows.
  • Apply sound project management practices while remaining flexible enough to work in technology environments where the solution or delivery approach may continue to evolve.

Business Operations and Leadership Support

  • Support coordination of Parsons X quarterly business briefings and other leadership activities, including gathering information from business leaders and developing clear, executive-level materials.
  • Coordinate across the Parsons X leadership team to gather information, track commitments, and support management reporting and business priorities.
  • Support development and coordination of proposals, client deliverables, sales presentations, and other business materials.
  • Help prepare for important internal and external presentations by organizing information, developing and refining presentation materials, and helping ensure key messages are communicated clearly and professionally.
  • Provide hands-on coordination for special initiatives, client activities, and other business priorities as needs arise across Parsons X.

What Will Make You Successful


You take ownership. You do not wait to be told every next step. You see what needs to happen, take initiative, and follow through. When something is at risk, you surface it early and help drive it toward resolution.

You are a collaborative project leader. You know successful delivery depends on bringing people together around a common outcome. You work effectively across client teams, Parsons technical and business teams, partners, and subcontractors. You clarify roles and expectations, work through differences constructively, and create the alignment and accountability needed to keep teams moving forward.

You are organized without being bureaucratic. You value schedules, budgets, forecasts, action items, dashboards, and accountability because they help move the work forward, not because project management is simply about maintaining a process.

You are comfortable with ambiguity. Some assignments will have established processes. Others, particularly emerging solution engagements, may not. You can apply sound project management thinking while helping determine the best way forward.

You are curious about technology. You do not need to be the technical expert, but you want to understand how the solution works, how the pieces fit together, and how technology and data help solve a client's problem. You can learn enough to communicate confidently with clients and technical teams.

You communicate clearly and succinctly. You can run a meeting, ask good questions, listen, capture what matters, and leave people clear about decisions, responsibilities, and next steps. You can also turn complex information into a concise project dashboard, executive update, proposal, or presentation.

You are financially minded. You understand that successfully managing a project includes managing the business of the project. You pay attention to budgets, forecasts, scope, changes, and the financial implications of project decisions.

You are comfortable with clients. You enjoy building relationships, are confident taking the lead in client conversations, and listen for what the client is really trying to accomplish. You recognize where Parsons may be able to help solve additional problems and expand the value we provide.

You are present, responsive, and dependable. People know they can count on you. You follow through, close loops, communicate proactively, and remain engaged and accessible to clients and internal teams.

You are willing to roll up your sleeves. You are not overly concerned with whether something falls perfectly within your job description. Whether it is resolving a project issue, improving a presentation, preparing for an important client meeting, or pulling together information for a leadership briefing, you are willing to jump in and help get it done.

You want to grow. You may not have every skill required to manage a large, complex technology program today. You have the foundation, judgment, curiosity, initiative, and ambition to develop into that level of project leader.


What We Are Looking For

  • Several years of experience supporting or managing technology-focused projects, with demonstrated readiness to take on increasing project ownership and responsibility.
  • Strong foundational project management skills across scope, schedule, budget, risk, issues, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Experience managing project budgets and forecasts, with an understanding of project financial performance.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and organizational boundaries.
  • Confidence interacting directly with clients, technical teams, partners, subcontractors, business leaders, and senior leadership.
  • Strong PowerPoint and presentation-development capabilities, including the ability to organize complex information into clear, professional, executive-ready materials.
  • Comfort learning new technology and working with technical subject matter.
  • A self-starter mindset with demonstrated initiative, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • Experience with intelligent transportation systems, sensors, data platforms, infrastructure technology, or related environments is a plus, but is not required.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed to support client engagements, project delivery, training, presentations, and other business needs.

Working Environment


This is a remote position that requires a high degree of engagement and responsiveness throughout the workday. The successful candidate will maintain a professional remote work environment that supports focused work, frequent virtual meetings, and regular interaction with clients, project teams, partners, and senior leadership.


Because this is a highly visible and client-facing position, the Technical Project Manager should be comfortable working on camera and maintaining a professional presence during virtual client and internal meetings. The role also requires flexibility to travel as needed for client engagements and other business activities.

Security Clearance Requirement:

We work in collaborative teams, both within the company and with our partners and customers, to plan, design, build, and modernize infrastructure. We take special pride in projects and solutions that improve communities as well as people’s quality of life by promoting economic growth, enhancing mobility, and increasing sustainability and resiliency. Powered by our people, we provide the imagination necessary to support our customers’ visions—and to help them see what's next!Salary Range: $103,500.00 - $181,100.00We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle!This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled.Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status.We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE):

The Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society. For 80 years, FEE has been committed to inspiring and educating individuals on the values of personal freedom, entrepreneurship, and sound economic thinking. Through various programs, publications, and events, FEE empowers individuals to understand the economic principles that drive prosperity and fosters a society rooted in individual rights and limited government.

About FEE's Student Engagement Team:

The Student Engagement department leads FEE’s student-facing events. Through a mix of in-person and virtual programs, FEE partners with schools, educators, and organizations to introduce students to the principles of a free society, fostering deeper understanding and thoughtful discussions. From outreach and relationship-building to event logistics and execution, the Student Engagement team works to create engaging, high-impact experiences that challenge and inspire the next generation. Domestically, FEE’s programs have reached students in nearly all 50 states. Internationally, FEE has a growing footprint in Latin America.

About FEE in the Classroom International

FEE in the Classroom International brings FEE's educational programs to students and educators in Latin America. Working with schools, educational institutions, and local partners, the program delivers workshops and seminars in Spanish that introduce young people to the ideas of a free society.

About the Role

The Program Outreach Intern will support FEE in the Classroom International's efforts to expand its network of partner institutions across Latin America. Working closely with the outreach team, the intern will help identify high schools, universities, and student organizations that are a strong fit for FEE's programs, and support the strategies that turn those contacts into lasting partnerships. This is an opportunity for the ideal candidate to combine a love for the ideas of a free society with hands-on experience in market research, outreach, and relationship-building in an international nonprofit setting.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market research across Latin American countries to identify potential institutional partners and expansion opportunities.
  • Source and map contact information for high schools, universities, student organizations, and youth leadership networks.
  • Assist in prospecting and developing outreach strategies, including drafting personalized outreach emails and supporting email cadences.
  • Analyze market trends and provide actionable insights to the outreach team.
  • Collaborate with the team to develop strategic approaches for engagement with high school educators and university leaders.
  • Support the preparation of program proposals for potential partner institutions.
  • Enter and update lead and contact information in Salesforce.
  • Learn and apply outreach KPIs to evaluate the success of different initiatives.

Skills:

  • Business, Economics, Project Management, or other related majors desired, but not required.
  • Basic Spanish proficiency required (able to read and write simple emails and hold basic conversations); intermediate or advanced level is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong customer service skills.
  • Ability to juggle multiple priorities while keeping everything on track and maintaining careful attention to detail.
  • The ability to work independently and take initiative with minimal supervision.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial spirit to improve existing programs.
  • A collaborative personality; unafraid of challenge.
  • An unwavering commitment to the mission and principles of FEE.

jobs.description:
At GoGlobal, the Business Applications Lead owns the internal business applications stack — CRM, ERP / finance, HRIS, and ticketing — configuring, integrating, and evolving the tools that Delivery runs on every day. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who understands both how the business works and how to make SaaS platforms work for it.

You will be the single point of accountability for the availability, configuration, and continuous improvement of these core platforms, translating operational needs into reliable application change while keeping access, audit, and data integrity tight. Sitting within Digital Operations, you partner closely with delivery teams, vendors, and the master-data function to keep the application landscape joined-up and dependable.

This role suits a pragmatic systems owner who enjoys both the configuration detail and the bigger picture of how applications connect, and who can lead a small specialist team while staying close to the platforms themselves.

As part of this remit, the Business Applications Lead also leads automation and AI adoption across Delivery — identifying where workflows can be simplified or automated, embedding AI-assisted tools into the applications and day-to-day processes teams rely on, and partnering with the Automations function and delivery leaders to prioritise, build, and scale these capabilities responsibly, so that automation and AI measurably improve accuracy, efficiency, and turnaround for clients while remaining secure, well-governed, and genuinely adopted by the people who use them.

Responsibilities:

Application Portfolio Ownership

• Administer and evolve the core business applications portfolio, keeping each platform stable, current, and fit for how Delivery works.

• Own configuration, release management, and vendor relationships for each application, including roadmap, renewals, and service levels.

• Capture operational requirements from across Delivery and translate them into well-scoped, well-tested application changes.

Integration & Data

• Lead integrations between applications — SSO, data synchronisation, and process orchestration — so information flows cleanly end to end.

• Partner with Master Data Management (MDM) on master-data flows across applications, protecting consistency and quality.

Adoption & Support

• Drive user adoption through clear training, documentation, and responsive day-to-day application support.

• Promote consistent, well-governed ways of working across the application landscape as the foundation for scalable, reliable operations.

Security, Access & Compliance

• Ensure access controls, audit trails, and segregation-of-duties (SoD) compliance are maintained across all applications.

• Work within internal controls and regulatory requirements, supporting internal and external audits with accurate evidence.

Key Performance Indicators

• Application availability and incident volume.

• Change throughput and backlog burn-down.

• User satisfaction and adoption.

Requirements

Requirements

• 8+ years working with business applications, including hands-on SaaS administration and configuration of CRM, ERP / finance, HRIS, or ticketing platforms.

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• Strong SaaS administration and configuration skills across multiple enterprise applications.

• Integration and API fluency — practical experience with SSO, data sync, and process orchestration between systems.

• Vendor management experience, including release management, renewals, and service-level oversight.

• Strong requirements-gathering skills — able to turn operational needs into clear, testable application changes.

• Solid grasp of access controls, audit trails, and segregation-of-duties (SoD) compliance.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to support and train non-technical users.

• Comfort working with AI-assisted tools and an openness to AI literacy as the function evolves.

Preferred

• Experience leading a small team of application specialists.

• Exposure to master-data management and data-governance practices.

• Relevant platform certifications (e.g. Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, ServiceNow, or equivalent).

ABOUT US:
GoGlobal is the leading professional services company to guide, establish and manage global operations with compliance and confidence. We bring the human touch to entering new markets and consolidating vendors through a single point of management. With a presence in over 140 countries on six continents and growing, we make running a global business easy.

Business & Corporate Services provided:

    • Entity Solutions: Entity establishment, Corporate secretarial & directorship services, Domicile services, Dormancy/Liquidation
    • HR Solutions: Global recruitment, Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), Global benefits, Global payroll, International HR Consulting
    • Finance Solutions: Accounting & Tax

For more information, please visit GoGlobal.com

OVERVIEW

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.

Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now!

The Alberta Provincial Medical Lead will collaborate to assist new physicians, across all provinces, with a specific focus on their province (Alberta) to onboard and grow on the platform. They will additionally help to grow and optimize the clinical side of the company through strategic planning. The primary objective of the Alberta Medical Lead is to help develop Rocket Doctor’s brand and product in Alberta;

Key responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the Provider Success team in recruitment and retention of Alberta physicians;
  • Investigating and responding to concerns and safety issues raised by patients, Patient Care Coordination (PCC) team, and/or MDs on the platform;
  • Ensuring Rocket Doctor’s product aligns with the goals and needs of practicing physicians from across Alberta;
  • Liaison with Provincial health authorities & organizations in Alberta to ensure efficient practices for physicians;
  • Maintaining regular communication with practicing physicians in the province, including (but not limited to) regular participation on relevant Slack channels, co-leading “All Docs on Deck” quarterly meetings and other community-building events;
  • Other Roles (common to all MD Advisors):
    • Attending and actively participating in regularly scheduled MD Advisory meetings;
    • Assisting to onboard new physicians and familiarizing them with the Rocket Doctor platform;
    • Helping develop and continually improve our physician handbook;
    • Engaging with the physician advisory team and the product development team for improvement initiatives;
    • Troubleshooting and strategic guidance around emerging physician roadblocks and challenges;
    • Acting as a resource to physicians on the RD platform regarding billing and virtual care practices and protocols for both insured and non-insured patients;
    • Assist in the development of communications in support of physicians and RD staff;
    • Supporting the Patient Care Coordinators (PCC) team to ensure adequate clinical coverage for the platform;
    • Assisting in the coordination of regular meetings and events for Rocket Doctor physicians.

EXPECTATIONS:

  • Be organized, positive and uplifting. As a representative of Rocket Doctor the Physician Lead is an exemplar of how we work on our platform, perform, and interact with patients and Rocket Doctor staff;
  • Maintain a high standard of professionalism as established by the College of Physicians and Surgeons;

  • Maintain a record of all decisions made;
  • Ability to work with confidential company information.

COMPENSATION:

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity with the medical landscape in Alberta;

jobs.title: Manager of Business Analytics - Fraud
jobs.excerpt: At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold.
jobs.description:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

What You’ll Do

Fraud is one of the largest challenges plaguing financial institutions today, with an estimated $27 billion in annual losses from identity theft alone1. In addition to identity theft, there is a growing trend of synthetic IDs, manipulated IDs, and scam incidents.

Koalafi is continuing to scale its payments and financing platform across direct-to-consumer and merchant channels. As fraud attack strategies evolve alongside this growth, the company is investing in stronger and more adaptive fraud defenses. The Manager of Business Analytics – Fraud will report directly to the Director of Fraud Strategy & Analytics and play a central role in developing and optimizing Koalafi’s fraud risk strategy.

This role will lead analytical efforts to develop and iterate fraud policies, evaluate new fraud defense capabilities and data sources, and strengthen fraud monitoring and reporting frameworks. The position will focus on improving Koalafi’s resilience against evolving fraud trends while enabling responsible growth across new products, channels, and partners. This individual will serve as a key analytical partner to Product, Engineering, Risk Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure fraud controls are effectively embedded in customer and merchant workflows.

Fraud Policy Development

Lead the analysis and continuous improvement of Koalafi’s fraud defense framework, including policies, decision rules, thresholds, and model targeting.

Responsibilities include:

  • Analyze fraud trends and attack patterns to continuously strengthen automated and manual fraud defenses.
  • Develop and iterate fraud defense strategy (rules, policies, thresholds, decision logic) to maintain strong protection against both ambient fraud activity and coordinated fraud attacks.
  • Design and implement defenses tailored to emerging channels, including direct-to-consumer, to support enterprise-wide scaling initiatives.
  • Evaluate and integrate new fraud detection capabilities, tools, and third-party data sources that improve risk detection and operational efficiency.
  • Enhance and optimize merchant-level fraud risk monitoring and reporting, identifying patterns that may indicate merchant abuse or elevated risk exposure.

Monitoring Suite & Risk Reporting

Improve and scale the fraud monitoring framework to ensure early detection of emerging threats and clear visibility into fraud performance.

Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and enhance fraud monitoring dashboards and reporting that track fraud performance metrics and trends across customer segments, merchant verticals, and channels.
  • Build analytical tools and monitoring processes designed to detect segment-level anomalies and emerging fraud patterns.
  • Implement automated alerting and anomaly detection to enable timely response to new fraud threats.
  • Partner with Analytics and Data teams to ensure fraud metrics and reporting are accurate, scalable, and aligned across systems.

Product Launch Support & Ad Hoc Analysis

Support new product launches and business initiatives by providing analytical insights into fraud risk and mitigation strategies.

Responsibilities include:

  • Support product design and rollout decisions by quantifying trade-offs among fraud risk, approval rate, unit economics, and customer experience.
  • Conduct targeted analyses to evaluate fraud exposure across new merchant partners, verticals, and products.
  • Monitor fraud performance during product launches, pilots, and scaling phases, identifying early indicators of emerging risk.
  • Provide ad hoc analytical support for fraud strategy initiatives and evolving risk mitigation efforts.

Cross-Functional Influence & Execution

Serve as a key analytical partner across teams to ensure fraud defenses are embedded effectively within Koalafi’s products and operational processes.

Responsibilities include:

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams during product development to ensure fraud risk controls are built into key workflows.
  • Collaborate with Risk Operations to ensure manual review processes align with fraud policy intent and evolving fraud patterns.
  • Provide analytical insights that support clear decision-making across stakeholders and initiatives.
  • Help drive alignment across teams by defining project milestones, delivering analytical insights, and maintaining effective communication with key stakeholders.

About You (Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree required, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, or Engineering preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in an analyst, data science, or consulting role
  • 3+ years of experience in fraud risk analytics
  • Experience in consumer financing industry, such as credit cards, personal loans, auto loans, BNPL, or similar fields
  • Proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Python for data analysis
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to develop strategic project plans and execute against them
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, dynamic entrepreneurial environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Location: Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.

Salary Range: $131,000-$165,000 per year (depending on experience and location)
Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.

The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

Benefits:

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 20 PTO days + 11 paid holidays
  • 401(k) retirement with company matching
  • Student Loan & Tuition Reimbursement
  • Commuter assistance
  • Parental leave (maternal + paternal)
  • Inclusion and Associate Engagement Programs

Who we are & what we value:

  • We focus on what’s most important
  • We set clear expectations and deliver
  • We embrace challenges to reach our full potential
  • We ask, “How can this be better?”
  • We move fast together

The vision for the Batch Infra team @ Affirm team is to provide reliable, scalable, self-serve and Affirm-optimized compute solution to enable ML, Product, and Financial Engineering success. Our team is responsible for building and maintaining compute platform that serves as a backbone for processing various Business critical batch workloads at Affirm through a wide suite of scheduled and on-demand compute solutions built on the cloud. Affirm is growing rapidly and so is the need for reliable and high availability frameworks. If solving infrastructure challenges at scale excites you, come join us!

What you’ll do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For:

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • Experience building and managing Workflow Orchestration frameworks like Airflow, Flyte, Prefect, Temporal, Luigi, etc.
  • Experience with or working knowledge for efficiently scaling frameworks like Spark/Flink for extremely large scale datasets on Kubernetes.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field

Base Pay Grade- N

Equity Grade- 9

About Us

Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Through its advanced technology, called people magic, Mighty helps the members of those networks build relationships with each other by surfacing the most relevant and interesting connections.

Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M.

The Role

As a Community Strategist, you’ll work with our premium Mighty Pro customers to help them create deeply engaging community experiences that lead to powerful outcomes.

You will lead workshops, co-create launch strategies, and shape the early member experience for some of the world’s boldest and most influential Hosts. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention.
  • Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy.
  • Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention.
  • Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey.
  • Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars.
  • Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate.
  • Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience.
  • Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment.
  • Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business.
  • 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role.
  • Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver.
  • Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale.
  • Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles.
  • Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps.
  • Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve.
  • Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes.
  • Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking.
  • Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off.
  • Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support.
  • The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next.

Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro!

jobs.excerpt: About METRWe are a nonprofit research organization that develops scientific methods to assess AI capabilities, risks, and mitigations, with a specific focus on threats related to AI R&D automation and misalignment.
jobs.description:
About METR

We are a nonprofit research organization that develops scientific methods to assess AI capabilities, risks, and mitigations, with a specific focus on threats related to AI R&D automation and misalignment.

METR has consistently set precedents for catastrophic AI risk evaluations, including the first independent safety evaluations (working informally with Anthropic and OpenAI in 2022), the first loss-of-control evaluations and first agentic dangerous capability evaluations, the first evaluations using finetuning (mentioned briefly here), the first independent evaluations using internal information about training, the first review partnership for company risk analysis, the first embedded redteaming, and the first evaluations of internal deployments.

We’ve been consulted and/or favorably referenced by groups on opposite ends of various spectra, including a16z, Khosla, Gary Marcus, Obama, and Dean Ball, and are known for producing one of the most positive results on AI capabilities (the time horizon trend) and the most negative (our downlift study). We’re generally referenced as the canonical third party assessor, e.g. as the obvious candidate to verify conditional pause agreements, and are trusted with AI incident investigations by frontierlabs and governments.

We believe it is robustly good for policymakers and civil society to have a clear understanding of risks from AI systems, and we are extremely excited to build a team of ambitious, excellent people to tackle one of the most important challenges of our time.

About the role

  • As part of informing the world about risk from frontier AI systems, METR often runs and publishes evaluations of frontier models.

  • Time Horizons is a central tool the world uses to understand AI progress. Our methodology has been included in system cards, called an "obsession" by the NYT, has wide reach online, and is used by governments to inform national policy. It is essential to our broader risk assessment work to have good capability evaluations.

  • Task Development Engineers contribute to METR’s expanding ambition of our evaluations with high quality tasks supporting the Time Horizons methodology. We expect our results to be seen by policymakers, frontier labs, national security stakeholders, and other key decisionmakers influencing society’s response to AI progress.

What this role looks like

  • (Primarily, and most importantly) Developing difficult, novel tasks for models. You will build well-scoped tasks that remain challenging as model time horizons grow, potentially to hundreds of hours.

Job details and compensation

  • Location: Remote (worldwide)
  • Hours: 20-40 hours per week (flexible schedule determined by you)
  • Timezone Requirements: A minimum of 1 hour of overlap with the Pacific Coast Time workday, but you determine your exact work schedule.

  • You decide the manner in which you complete your tasks to a standard that matches other professionals in this field.
  • Compensation: $150-300/hour.
  • Top of this range is reserved for exceptional candidates.

Our Culture

METR is a mission-driven organization. We believe our work can meaningfully shape humanity's future for the better, and we want to be the best people in the world doing this work. We have a tight-knit, collaborative research culture rooted in truth-seeking and integrity. We're fiercely committed to producing high-quality, trustworthy science. We're honest and transparent about our results, especially when they may go against the grain. We've earned trust as reliable partners who handle confidential information with care. We maintain a low-ego, drama-free environment focused on what matters.

jobs.title: Director - Content
jobs.excerpt: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Sprinto operates in a category where trust is everything—and content has the opportunity to shape who customers trust before they ever speak to Sales.

As Director – Content, you'll define how Sprinto thinks, speaks, teaches, and shows up in the market. You'll build a content engine that makes complex ideas around security, compliance, risk, and trust genuinely worth reading—while turning that attention into brand preference, organic growth, and qualified pipeline.

This is a role with both creative and commercial ownership. You'll shape our editorial point of view, build content properties people actively come back to, lead a high-performing team, and experiment with how content gets discovered in a world being reshaped by AI and changing search behaviour.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build a category voice—not just a content calendar—this is your canvas.

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Build a content brand people actively seek out. Define Sprinto's editorial strategy, voice, and point of view across thought leadership, SEO, newsletters, Academy, product storytelling, and original content properties.
  • Turn expertise into influence. Take complex ideas across security, compliance, risk, and trust and turn them into sharp, useful narratives that make Sprinto a brand practitioners and business leaders learn from—not simply one they discover through search.
  • Build content that creates commercial impact. Connect content strategy to organic pipeline, demand generation, ABM, product launches, and sales conversations, creating a clear line between what we publish and how the business grows.
  • Rethink organic growth for an AI-first world. Evolve Sprinto's approach to SEO and discoverability as traditional search changes, experimenting with new formats, distribution channels, content clusters, and ways of earning visibility across search and AI-driven discovery.
  • Create once, compound everywhere. Build a strong repurposing and distribution engine that turns great ideas into multiple formats and ensures our best thinking travels much further than the original piece.
  • Build the team behind the brand. Lead writers, editors, and external partners while raising the bar for editorial craft, speed, experimentation, and commercial thinking. Your impact should show up not only in the content Sprinto produces, but in how much stronger the people producing it become.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

    You'll likely thrive in this role if...

    • You've spent 7+ years building content, including 3+ years leading teams and meaningful experience within B2B SaaS, and you're ready to own a company's content direction rather than one channel within it.
    • You're an editor at heart. You can recognise a powerful idea, sharpen an argument, challenge mediocre writing, and turn complicated subjects into stories people actually want to consume.
    • You've built content strategies for SMB and mid-market B2B audiences and understand how content needs to work differently across awareness, consideration, ABM, product education, and sales enablement.
    • You understand growth as deeply as craft. You've built SEO and organic programs, understand funnels and attribution, and can connect editorial decisions to pipeline and business outcomes.
    • You have strong opinions about how content is changing in an AI-first world and are excited to experiment with new approaches to search, distribution, production, and discoverability rather than defending yesterday's playbook.
    • You know that great content isn't created by Marketing in isolation. You're comfortable working with Product Marketing, Sales, Product, subject-matter experts, and leadership to find the ideas worth telling.
    • You've built and developed strong content teams. You know when to coach, when to edit, when to challenge, and how to create standards without becoming the bottleneck.
    • You think in systems as much as stories—editorial calendars, repurposing engines, distribution loops, analytics, content operations, and clear OKRs are what allow great creative work to compound.
    • You're ultimately interested in building a brand, not filling a calendar. You care about what Sprinto becomes known for, what audiences remember, and whether the work you create genuinely moves the business.

      • Experience in cybersecurity, compliance, developer tools, or similarly technical categories, along with exposure to ABM, newsletters, HubSpot, GA4, Semrush, Webflow, or similar platforms, will help you ramp faster—but we're primarily looking for someone with the editorial judgment and commercial instinct to make Sprinto's content impossible to ignore.

      If you're looking to inherit a content calendar and optimise what's already there, this probably isn't it. But if you want to build a distinctive content brand, shape how a category thinks, and prove that exceptional content can be both creatively ambitious and commercially powerful, we'd love to meet you.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

GURU is AH's cloud based, flat rate virtual finance department providing bookkeeping, payroll, AR/AP, GST/HST, and year end coordination. You will play a central role in delivering accurate, timely financial insights that help entrepreneurs grow with confidence.

We're looking for a highly skilled Senior Accountant/Bookkeeper based in the Philippines, engaged as an independent contractor, to manage day to day accounting operations for a dedicated portfolio of 10 to 30 clients while serving as the primary point of contact for those clients.

This is a client facing role: you will own the relationship with your clients, lead client meetings, and ensure their books are accurate, timely, and well managed.   • Tech savvy with advanced computer skills
  • Able to work night shift (aligned with Canadian hours)
  • Self starter with strong attention to detail and multitasking ability

Who Thrives Here?

Self managed, tech savvy, detail oriented professionals who value excellence, ownership, and collaboration. If you're a strong communicator who enjoys working directly with clients and is passionate about helping businesses grow, you'll thrive at Achen Henderson.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Strategist
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCompany OverviewCapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners.
jobs.description:
Description

Company Overview

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across Marketing, IT, Analytics, CRO, and Media Buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Strategist who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
  • Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
  • Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
  • Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
  • Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
  • Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
  • Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
  • Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  • Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

AI & Experimentation Mindset

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
  • Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills.
  • Proficient English language skills.
  • Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
  • Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
  • Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

Job Overview

We are seeking a short-term Insurance Coverage Specialist whose primary responsibility is to make outbound calls to insurance companies to gather information about our patients’ medication coverage. This role is initially for 1-2 weeks, with the potential to expand if our needs continue and performance warrants an extension. You will work closely with our internal team, verifying coverage details to ensure our patients have accurate information about their medication costs and benefits.

  • Insurance Verification:

    • Make outbound calls to insurance companies to confirm coverage details for specific weight loss medications.

    • Obtain critical information such as eligibility, coverage limits, co-pays, and any prior authorization requirements.

    • Accurately record all coverage details and communication logs in our internal systems.

  • Collaboration & Communication:

    • Coordinate with internal team members to relay findings from insurance calls.

    • Communicate any coverage issues or discrepancies promptly for swift resolution.

  • Follow-Up & Issue Resolution:

    • Proactively follow up with insurance companies when information is incomplete or unclear.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Allied Health profession (Nursing, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Psychology, etc.)

  • Prior experience working in prior authorization, insurance verification, or related roles, as well as a strong understanding of insurance policies, prior authorization processes, and medical terminology.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively interact with patients, insurance companies, and internal team members.

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work Eastern Time Zone

  • Strong at-home internet access

Term & Compensation:

  • $5 USD/hour

  • 8 hours/day

  • Starting contract for 1-2 weeks, with opportunity to expand based on performance and the company's needs

jobs.description:
About IXOPAY

IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.

About the Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager, Agentic Commerce to help define the future of autonomous payments and AI-driven commerce at IXOPAY.

In this hands-on leadership role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for our Agentic Commerce platform, shaping how AI agents securely discover, authorize, and complete transactions on behalf of merchants and consumers. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, enterprise customers, and strategic partners, you'll build intelligent payment capabilities that combine orchestration, tokenization, identity, risk, and AI to enable the next generation of digital commerce.

This is an opportunity to influence an emerging market, shape industry direction, and help position IXOPAY as the leading platform for agentic commerce.

What You'll Do

Define Product Strategy

  • Lead the strategy and roadmap for IXOPAY's Agentic Commerce product portfolio.

  • Define product capabilities that enable secure agent-to-merchant and agent-to-agent payment experiences, including identity, authentication, authorization, delegated payment mandates, and trust frameworks.

  • Shape the evolution of AI-driven payment infrastructure by translating emerging technologies and market trends into scalable platform capabilities.

  • Drive the roadmap for tokenization, payment optimization, fraud and risk management, and identity services that support autonomous commerce.

Deliver Customer Value

  • Partner with enterprise customers, payment providers, AI technology partners, and strategic collaborators to understand emerging commerce use cases and industry challenges.

  • Lead customer proof-of-concept engagements through production launch, validating new agentic payment experiences with real-world merchants.

  • Translate customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends into differentiated product capabilities that improve payment performance, security, and customer outcomes.

  • Define and measure success through KPIs including adoption, payment performance, conversion, token utilization, fraud reduction, agent transaction success rates, and platform growth.

Lead Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver innovative platform capabilities from concept through launch.

  • Support go-to-market initiatives alongside Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

  • Champion customer-centric product development, data-driven decision-making, and rapid experimentation across the Product organization.

Shape the Industry

  • Represent IXOPAY as a thought leader in Agentic Commerce through conferences, webinars, customer advisory sessions, industry events, and published content.

  • Collaborate with payment networks, standards organizations, and emerging AI commerce initiatives to help shape the future of autonomous payments.

  • Build relationships with analysts, strategic partners, and industry influencers to strengthen IXOPAY's leadership position in intelligent payments.

Advance Product Excellence

  • Introduce AI-assisted product management practices that improve research, discovery, prioritization, prototyping, and product delivery.

  • Help scale AI-enabled workflows across the Product organization to improve speed, quality, and decision-making.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • Extensive Product Management experience within B2B SaaS, FinTech, or payments infrastructure, including ownership of product strategy and roadmap execution.

  • Deep expertise in one or more of the following: payment orchestration, tokenization, fraud and risk management, payment gateways, acquiring, payment optimization, or digital identity.

  • Experience building enterprise platform products, APIs, and developer-focused capabilities.

  • Proven success leading complex cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.

  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and customer-centric decision-making.

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, emerging technology markets with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems.

  • Experience representing products or organizations externally through industry events, speaking engagements, published content, or customer advisory activities.

Preferred

  • Experience with Agentic Commerce concepts, AI agent payment protocols, delegated payment models, or emerging commerce standards.

  • Experience with network tokenization, card lifecycle management, or payment network integrations.

  • Familiarity with PSPs, acquirers, issuers, and alternative payment methods.

  • Experience applying AI or machine learning concepts to product development or payment optimization.

  • Experience working within high-growth FinTech or infrastructure software companies.

Why Join IXOPAY?

At IXOPAY, you'll help define the future of enterprise payments by building products that combine orchestration, tokenization, AI, and data intelligence into a single platform. You'll work on meaningful industry challenges, collaborate with experienced teams, and have a direct impact on the direction of our products and business.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Professional growth and leadership opportunities

  • A collaborative, international team environment

Compensation: $185,000-$200,000 USD annually, depending on location and experience.

US Benefits Include

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA)

  • Employer-paid Life, AD&D, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

  • 401(k) Plan with Employer Match

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We know great candidates don't always meet every qualification. If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear what you can bring to IXOPAY. What Makes an IXOPAYer? We are a global team bound by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change. We thrive on progress over perfection - choosing direction over motion, working smart with modern tech and AI, and constantly learning through continuous iteration. If you are tenaciously curious, empowered to take ownership, and passionate about delivering customer-first solutions in the fast-paced world of global payments, you’ll fit right in.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IXOPAY is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

IXOPAY participates in E-Verify.
