Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and proactive Senior Incident Response & Resiliency Engineer to join our InfoSec team. In this role, you will lead and mature the operational readiness of Cloudera’s Incident Response (IR), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), Disaster Recovery (DR), and Backup/Recovery programs. Reporting to the Director of InfoSecOps, you will take ownership of maintaining emergency playbooks, leading tabletop exercises, facilitating crisis communications, and driving enterprise-wide resilience across systems and business operations.

The successful candidate is a structured, results-driven professional who excels at both strategic planning and operational execution. You bridge the gap between technical teams, infrastructure operations, and executive leadership, ensuring that our response plans are continuously validated, regulatory readiness remains sharp, and technical recovery capabilities align with organizational RTO/RPO targets.

As a Senior Incident Response & Resiliency Engineer you will:

  • Proactively map and maintain clear application and service ownership chains across matrixed teams to establish zero-day readiness and eliminate attribution gaps before threats emerge.

  • Serve as the primary operational connector during critical advisories and zero-day events, rapidly resolving ownership gaps, tracking down unassigned assets, and executing swift escalation workflows between IR, SecOps, and engineering leads.

  • Maintain, test, and optimize dynamic call trees, out-of-band crisis communication channels, and external outreach protocols (including Legal, PR, regulatory agencies, and retained forensics firms) to ensure operational readiness during major outages.

  • Support Response Engineers during high-severity (Sev-1/Sev-0) security incidents or disaster activations by facilitating crisis workflows, cross-functional stakeholder updates, and operational timelines.

  • SupportResponse Engineers during high-severity (Sev-1/Sev-0) security incidents or disaster activations by facilitating crisis workflows, cross-functional stakeholder updates, and operational timelines.

  • Lead the continuous review, expansion, and alignment of Cloudera’s Incident Response plans, BCP/DR frameworks, and technical playbooks against evolving threat vectors, regulatory requirements, and cloud infrastructure architectures.

  • Oversee enterprise Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) to establish baseline Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) across critical applications, mapping vendor dependencies and ensuring SLA alignment.

  • Partner with IT Infrastructure, Cloud, and Engineering teams to audit, validate, and document backup retention policies, immutable snapshot architectures, and air-gapped controls necessary to guarantee operational survival during ransomware scenarios.

  • Organize and lead hands-on technical DR restoration tests and failover simulations to validate data integrity, recovery workflows, and cross-functional business continuity during catastrophic infrastructure failures.

  • Proactively audit SIEM ingestion coverage, security tooling, and backup monitoring platforms to identify operational blind spots across cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Partner directly with application owners, IT infrastructure, and business unit leaders to define required log sources, audit event logging levels, and field-level telemetry needed for effective detection and incident forensics.

  • Document telemetry gaps and collaborate with the IR team to onboard new log feeds and validate data ingestion pipelines.

  • Design, execute, and evaluate comprehensive tabletop exercises (TTXs) spanning IR, BCP, and DR scenarios for both technical engineering teams and executive leadership.

  • Lead Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Post-Exercise After-Action Reports (AARs) to capture critical takeaways, establish remediation roadmaps, and track cross-functional action items to resolution.

  • Develop key performance indicators (KPIs) and maturity metrics for IR readiness, backup success rates, BCP coverage, and DR testing results.

  • Centralize and maintain all resilience documentation, SOPs, and contact matrixes across primary corporate knowledge repositories.

We are excited about you if you have:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Continuity, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, Incident Response, Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCP/DR), IT Risk Governance or GRC.

  • Resiliency Expertise: Proven experience designing or maintaining enterprise BCP/DR plans, conducting BIAs, and overseeing technical backup restoration testing within cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Technical & Framework Mastery: Strong working knowledge of NIST SP 800-61, ISO 22301, NIST SP 800-34, security automation frameworks (e.g., SOAR playbooks, workflow orchestration), and common cybersecurity and resiliency standards.

  • Operational Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives independently, facilitate complex tabletop scenarios, and drive technical post-incident remediations across matrixed teams.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical risks into actionable operational requirements for non-technical stakeholders (Legal, PR, Executive Leadership).

  • Tools: Proficiency with modern security platforms, ticket management systems (Jira, Confluence), emergency messaging systems, and enterprise BCP/DR tracking tools.

  • Certifications: Preferred industry certifications include CISSP, CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional), CISM, GIAC (GCIH, GCFA), CySA+, or PMP.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is:

  • California: $114,000-$142,000

Individual compensation within the published range is determined by the candidate's skills, experience, qualifications, and primary work location. In addition to base pay, sales roles are eligible for Cloudera's commission plan, while non-sales roles are eligible for the corporate incentive plan. This role is not eligible for immigration support or relocation.

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or codebases without direct reporting authority — demonstrated Staff-level scope, not just Senior-level execution

Position Summary
The Project Manager leads client-facing IT infrastructure and managed services projects from initiation through closure. This role translates technical scope into practical project plans, coordinates technical teams, vendors, procurement, and client stakeholders, and keeps projects aligned with scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. By delivering organized, proactive project leadership, this position strengthens the client experience, supports timely delivery and revenue, and expands the Project Management Office’s capacity.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of client-facing IT projects, including managed services onboardings, migrations, offboardings, infrastructure implementations, cybersecurity deployments, hardware refreshes, and environment upgrades.
  • Review statements of work, technical requirements, budgets, dependencies, and resource needs to confirm delivery readiness before kickoff.
  • Develop clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, go-live checkpoints, and transition-to-support activities.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects while monitoring scope, schedules, budgets, labor hours, documentation, client commitments, and hardware or vendor dependencies.
  • Lead client-facing and internal project meetings, communicate status and decisions, and ensure required actions are completed.
  • Coordinate engineers, technical leads, Procurement, Account Management, Sales, vendors, and client stakeholders across interdependent workstreams.
  • Identify risks, scope changes, blockers, and conflicting requirements early; recommend solutions and escalate decisions when needed.
  • Validate implementation readiness, quality assurance, client acceptance, billing milestones, and closure criteria.
  • Maintain accurate project records and status updates in project management systems and contribute to process improvements and lessons learned.
  • Build trusted relationships while setting clear expectations, holding owners accountable, and maintaining a confident, solutions-oriented approach.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Project Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • Experience supporting healthcare, senior care, or another regulated industry.

  • PMP, CAPM, CompTIA Project+, Network+, Security+, ITIL, or another relevant project management or technical certification.

A high-performing Project Manager keeps a complex portfolio moving with clear plans, accurate documentation, proactive risk management, and consistent follow-through. Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

Location Note

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Member Communication Platform team, you'll design and operate secure, scalable data products that power audience selection, eligibility, preferences, consent, campaign inputs, delivery data, and operational reporting. In your first year, success means delivering reliable Databricks-based pipelines and integrations, improving data quality and observability, and providing technical leadership across cross-functional initiatives that support timely, relevant, and compliant member communications.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You'll lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure data architectures for member communications, defining data models, contracts, lineage, and ownership.
  • You'll independently lead complex data engineering initiatives from technical requirements and design through production delivery, coordinating work across multiple engineers and stakeholders while proactively managing dependencies, risks, and technical trade-offs
  • You'll design, develop, and optimize production-grade data pipelines and integrations using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and SQL, while modernizing appropriate legacy workloads.
  • You'll build reliable data-loading, reconciliation, retry, idempotency, recovery, and deployment patterns, and help operate data lakehouse and operational data assets for performance, integrity, availability, and security.

  • You'll partner with Product, Communications, Analytics, Engineering, Risk, Privacy, Compliance, and other stakeholders to translate needs and technical trade-offs into actionable solutions, drive release readiness through automated testing, CI/CD, rollout planning, and post-release measurement, monitor pipeline performance, quality, timeliness, cost, and reliability, and look for practical ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You're a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ambiguous business needs into reliable, scalable technical solutions. You take ownership of production outcomes, communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, and help raise the bar through mentorship, thoughtful design reviews, and continuous improvement.

You're comfortable balancing member experience, privacy, compliance, reliability, performance, and cost when making technical decisions.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • You'll have a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; strong proficiency in Python/PySpark and SQL; and strong leadership, problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.

  • Familiarity with Unity Catalog or comparable data-governance tooling, and experience with Java or Scala.

  • You've used AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools to improve engineering productivity, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, data quality, or operational effectiveness.

  • Familiarity with using AI agents or automations to research, prototype, test, document, and deliver solutions across a broad technology stack with sound judgment for security, privacy, accuracy, and human review.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

About Moneybox:

At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We’re guided by our belief that wealth isn’t about the money, it’s about the means to more: more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind.

Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping nearly two million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they're saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.

And now Moneybox is building the means to help more people in more ways - through personal financial advice. We believe that great advice should be available to everyone, at every stage of life, and that technology can help us deliver it with the care, clarity and accountability people deserve.

We're building a new kind of advice service from the ground up, and the people who join us now will help shape how millions of people plan for their future.

The Senior Financial Advisor is one of the most experienced practitioners in the advice team. You are the technical anchor for complex cases — particularly pension consolidation and drawdown — and you carry significant accountability for the quality and suitability of advice we deliver to customers.

You will work alongside the Advice Engine rather than replacing it: the engine generates the plan, and you ensure it is right for the customer. You will also play a leading role in shaping the House Rules that govern advice outputs. You will coach less experienced Advisers and Money Guides, and be the senior point of escalation for the team to deliver good advice outcomes. You may have line manager responsibility for a team of Financial Advisers.

What you'll be doing

    Customer-facing advice

    • Running video consultations, collecting information & establishing customer goals, walking customers through their plan, answering questions and helping them feel confident about their next steps.

    • Handle the most complex escalations from the support team — vulnerable customers, customers with multiple pension pots, customers where suitability needs to be carefully assessed, and customers who need to be off-boarded with care.

    • Make final calls on whether a customer should be off-ramped from the service, documenting the rationale clearly and ensuring the customer leaves the interaction with a good outcome and a clear next step.

    • Respond to customers flagged as insistent, doing the right thing for the customer while protecting them and the firm.

      • Quality assurance and oversight

      • Review engine-generated plans against our suitability standards within the agreed SLAs, signing off plans for release.

      • Review flagged customer cases before their plan is released, deciding whether to further fact find, off-ramp or release the plan.

      • Carry out QA checks on advice given and calls delivered by other Advisors and on customer interactions handled by the support team, feeding findings into the T&C scheme.

      • Own a portfolio of QA themes (e.g. drawdown suitability, vulnerable customer handling) and report findings into governance forums.

        • Shaping the service

        • Provide expert input into the House Rules — the restrictions and parameters that govern what the advice engine can and cannot recommend.

        • Work with the Risk & Compliance team on stress testing the advice model, including operational and technological stresses, not just market scenarios.

        • Partner with Product on improvements to the fact find, suitability report and Advisor Management System based on what you see in real customer cases.

        • Contribute to compliance monitoring activities and represent the advice team in governance and audit meetings as required.

          • Leadership and development

          • Act as the senior technical reference point for Advisors, Paraplanners and Money Guides — the person the team turns to on hard cases.

          • Coach and develop less experienced Advisers, including supporting their T&C progression, observing customer calls and providing structured feedback.

          • In specific circumstances, the role will include direct line management of 1 or more Financial advisers

          • Help shape recruitment, onboarding and ongoing competence frameworks as the team scales.

What we're looking for

    Essential

    • Diploma in Regulated Financial Planning (QCF Level 4) or equivalent, with significant additional qualifications in pensions — (AF7) or equivalent is required given the drawdown remit.

    • Substantial post-qualification experience as a regulated advisor, with a strong track record of delivering retirement and at-retirement advice.

    • Deep technical knowledge of UK pensions, drawdown, tax-free cash sequencing, ISAs and the tax treatment of investments and pensions.

    • Demonstrable experience of QA, file checking or T&C supervision — you've reviewed other people's advice and can articulate what good looks like.

    • Comfortable operating in a restricted advice environment and explaining the boundary between advice and guidance clearly to customers and colleagues.

    • Fluent with the Consumer Duty regime and able to evidence good customer outcomes in your day-to-day work.

      • Desirable

      • Chartered or working towards Chartered Financial Planner status.

      • Experience working in or alongside an automated or robo-advice environment, or in a hybrid advice service.

      • Experience contributing to House Rules, advice models or other forms of advice logic.

    The advice service runs in standard UK business hours at launch, with video calls bookable by customers via Calendly and customer chat handled through Intercom. QA huddles, team learning sessions and case discussions.

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.


What’s this role about?

As a software engineer at Auvik, you’ll be part of an agile team of coders, developing a network management service that monitors millions of devices, while solving big challenges for our customers. Drawing on your love of developing creative solutions, your can-do attitude, and your drive to do great work, you’ll help Auvik continue to build software our customers can rely on.

What will I be doing?

The industry is shifting towards cloud based systems and distributed work environments. We need senior software developers like yourself to level up on our product offerings. In this role, you will:

  • Focus on designing architectures for microservices that are consistent, scalable, high quality and tolerant to faults and failures.
  • Deploy and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes orchestration.
  • Design and implement protocols for communication in a highly scalable, distributed system.
  • Develop reliable and performant code for our collector deployed at tens of thousands of customer sites.
  • Develop tooling using information from Netflow, Syslog, and other networking standards.
  • Help expand the depth and breadth of our solution based on your deep knowledge of networking devices and protocols.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product management to deliver software components to meet the needs of our customers.
  • Apply AI-enabled techniques to solve complex engineering problems, using intelligent tooling, automation, and data-informed debugging to build scalable systems, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery across the stack.

What are we looking for?

  • Proven experience developing quality code and architectures preferably using or Golang or Javascript).
  • Background in designing and developing microservices.
  • Knowledge of cloud computing, preferably AWS.
  • Adept in building reliable, highly available, and scalable software on top of the Kafka streaming platform.
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies such as scrum.
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD pipeline to test and deploy.
  • Passion for mentoring and guiding junior and intermediate team members.
  • Enthusiasm towards researching new technologies and making recommendations based on experiences and findings.
  • Accountability towards following processes and making suggestions for improvements.
  • Desire to collaboratively create elegant, scalable, modern, code that evolves our products.
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal) to work collaboratively with the immediate team and the larger organization.

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.

About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing multi-touch attribution models.

  • Event Tracking Frameworks

  • Communication & Influencing Skills

jobs.description:
Title: Senior Director, Revenue Operations


Reporting to: Chief Revenue Officer


Location: This position can be based remotely within the US


Opportunity

The Director of Revenue Operations will be responsible for developing and managing the processes, systems, data, analytics, and operating cadence that support GW Rhythm's go-to-market organization.

This role will serve as the connective tissue across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance, and Executive Leadership, ensuring that the company has a clear and reliable view of pipeline, bookings, revenue, customer activity, sales performance, and growth opportunities.

The ideal candidate is both strategic and highly operational—someone who can establish and maintain the infrastructure required for a rapidly growing healthcare technology company while also personally driving improvements in forecasting, pipeline management, CRM utilization, reporting, compensation, and sales productivity.

Responsibilities

Revenue Strategy & Operating Model

● Develop and continuously improve the company's revenue operating model across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success.
● Establish standardized processes and definitions across the revenue organization, including pipeline stages, opportunity qualification, forecasting, bookings, ARR, renewals, expansion, and customer lifecycle metrics.
● Partner with executive leadership to translate growth objectives into measurable revenue plans, capacity requirements, and operating targets.
● Identify bottlenecks and opportunities to improve the efficiency and scalability of the revenue engine.

Pipeline Management & Forecasting

● Own the company's revenue pipeline reporting and forecasting processes.
● Establish rigorous pipeline inspection and forecasting methodologies.
● Develop and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline coverage, conversion rates, sales velocity, deal progression, win/loss trends, and forecast accuracy.
● Partner with GTM leadership to identify pipeline gaps and develop strategies to address them.
● Create a consistent executive-level view of current and future revenue performance.

CRM & Revenue Technology

● Own the strategy, governance, and optimization of the company's CRM (Salesforce) and revenue technology ecosystem.
● Ensure CRM data is accurate, complete, and actionable.
● Establish appropriate workflows, automation, reporting, and data standards.
● Evaluate and implement technologies that improve sales productivity, intelligence, forecasting, and customer engagement.
● Integrate CRM data with financial and operational systems where appropriate.

Sales Performance & Productivity

● Develop metrics and reporting that measure sales-team productivity and effectiveness.
● Analyze performance by representative, territory, market segment, customer type, and sales stage.
● Support territory planning, account segmentation, quota setting, and sales capacity planning.
● Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, shorten sales cycles, and increase conversion rates.

Revenue Analytics

● Build a comprehensive revenue-performance reporting framework for the executive team and Board.
● Develop reporting around Key Metrics such as (ARR, Pipeline Coverage, Renewal/Retention, Win-Rate, ACV, Sales Velocity, Forecast Accuracy, CAC, other)

Cross-Functional Revenue Alignment

● Establish common operating processes across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, and Product.
● Improve handoffs between functions throughout the customer lifecycle.
● Develop a shared understanding of target accounts, opportunities, customer requirements, implementation status, renewals, and expansion opportunities.
● Partner with Finance to ensure revenue forecasts and operating metrics are aligned with financial reporting.

Enterprise Healthcare GTM Support

● Track opportunities across health systems, health plans, and other strategic healthcare customers.
● Help leadership understand sales cycles, buying committees, contracting processes, pilots, implementations, expansions, and enterprise adoption.
● Develop account-level intelligence that supports strategic account planning and executive engagement.
● Support analysis of the company's Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and identify patterns among high-value prospects and customers.

Strategic Projects

● Lead special projects designed to improve revenue growth, scalability, and operating efficiency.
● Support development of annual revenue plans and go-to-market strategies.
● Develop business cases and ROI analyses for new markets, channels, products, or investments.
● Provide analytical support for strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and other growth initiatives as appropriate.

Requirements

● 7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Strategy, Finance, or a related field.
● Experience supporting a B2B enterprise sales organization.
● Strong understanding of CRM systems and revenue technology.
● Demonstrated experience building and managing forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, and revenue analytics processes.
● Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
● Excellent communication and presentation skills.
● Ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations for executives.
● Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
● Adhere to all organizational information security policies and protect all sensitive information including but not limited to ePHI and PHI in accordance with organizational policy and Federal, State, and local regulations.

Even Better

● Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, AI, or enterprise software.
● Experience selling to health systems, hospitals, health plans, or other healthcare organizations.
● Experience with long, complex enterprise sales cycles.
● Experience with Salesforce or another leading enterprise CRM.
● Experience building Revenue Operations functions within a growing company.
● Familiarity with SaaS metrics and financial concepts including ARR, ACV, NRR, GRR, CAC, LTV, pipeline coverage, bookings, and revenue forecasting.

About GW RhythmX

GW RhythmX is revolutionizing healthcare through connected, AI-native intelligence that unites clinical insight, patient engagement, and system-wide care orchestration. The company combines market-leading AI precision care technology with extensive trusted patient engagement leadership to help health systems deliver the right care, at the right time, through the right clinician and channel. Its solutions are deployed across more than 150 health systems, touching more than 85M patients including 8M U.S. military veterans. The company's award-winning solutions were recognized again in 2024 by KLAS Research, Fierce Healthcare, and AVIA Marketplace. A SymphonyAI Group company, GW RhythmX leverages various firm assets, including $1B+ in R&D investment, longitudinal data related to 300 million patients, 4.4 billion total annual claims, and 1.8 million healthcare professionals at more than 3,000 facilities globally.

Most relevant press releases:

Presbyterian Healthcare Services Expands Use of GW RhythmX to 200 Primary Care Clinicians in the First Full System Deployment of a Precision Care AI Platform - RhythmX AI

Get Well, a leader in patient engagement software, and RhythmX AI, a leader in AI-powered precision care, will combine to form GW RhythmX to usher in the next generation of precision care

About SymphonyAI Group

SymphonyAI Group (SAIGroup) is a private investment firm building leading global enterprise AI businesses by accelerating innovation and growth. SAIGroup companies ConcertAI, SymphonyAI, and GW RhythmX deliver AI solutions that transform industries and bring value to companies, workers, healthcare professionals, and patients. The companies collectively represent a workforce of more than 4,000 talented engineers, data scientists and industry/healthcare experts. SAIGroup is backed by a $1 billion commitment from Founder and CEO Dr. Romesh Wadhwani, a noted entrepreneur and philanthropist. Learn more at www.saigroup.ai and follow SAIGroup on LinkedIn.

When it comes to careers, our approach is simple: empower employees to do their best work and live their best professional and personal lives. Meeting the needs of a diverse group of employees across more than 30 states means offering tools to support financial, physical and emotional well-being and the choice to design what meets your needs. You’ll find everything you’d expect and many things you don’t: exceptionally generous paid time away from work, a variety of paid leave programs, savings opportunities with 401(k) and incentive plans, internal education programs, full array of health benefits, fitness reimbursement, cell phone subsidy, casual offices with snacks and drinks, peer recognition programs, health advocacy and employee assistance programs, chili cook-offs, pet insurance (yes, really) and so much more. Our most valuable benefit? An environment that supports YOU. The estimated pay range for this position is $150,000-$170,000 in base salary plus bonus. Base salary is dependent on many factors including, but not limited to education, experience and skills. This range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

GW RhythmX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age or veteran status.

Unleash Your Talents with Us!

Hi there, our future Web2Print Specialist! Happy to see YOU here.

Here at Integrated OS, you'll be part of a team of passionate individuals who are committed to delivering exceptional offshoring services. Bringing in an array of skills and talents from different areas of business from Finance, Human Resources, Information Technology, Customer Service, and Marketing to Sales and Operations.

From humble beginnings, we have built our company from our first team member onwards. Initially, we were lending support to an Australian print manufacturer - The Lamson Group.

Since then, we have continued to uphold our core values and culture and developed a deeper understanding of how people need help to succeed in their goals. And YOU might be a part of this amazing growth as our team keeps growing above all expectations!

﻿

What you'll do:

﻿As a Web2Print Specialist, you will be responsible for the architecture, configuration, governance, templating standards, and integrations within our Infigo environment. Working as part of the wider Web2Print team and in collaboration with internal IT, ERP, and WMS specialists, you will help ensure seamless ordering across variable print and finished goods while maintaining production integrity, integration reliability, and proper release governance.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

INFIGO Platform Architecture & Governance

  • Design and maintain master/child site structures and override controls
  • Configure roles and permissions following least-privilege principles
  • Manage Dev/Test/Prod environments and structured release cycles
  • Control product lifecycle (draft pilot live deprecate)
  • Monitor render queues, logs, and webhook failures
  • Optimize storefront performance (asset weight, template efficiency, caching strategy)
  • Maintain SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and UX standards

﻿Product & Catalogue Configuration﻿

  • Print & Variable Products
    • ﻿Configure static and variable print products
    • Implement complex pricing matrices and approval workflows
    • Apply tax/GST and shipping logic aligned with finance systems
    • Ensure cart checkout order fulfilment traceability
  • Finished Goods & Inventory Products
    • ﻿Configure stocked SKUs and inventory-aware ordering
    • Manage stock visibility, backorder logic, and reorder thresholds
    • Support kitting and bundled product logic
    • Align storefront product states with warehouse workflows

WMS & ERP Integration (Collaborative Ownership)

  • Working alongside internal IT and warehouse teams:
    • Support API and webhook integrations to WMS/ERP platforms
    • Validate order payload structures (SKUs, metadata, tax, shipping)
    • Monitor export reliability and idempotent order handling
    • Assist in diagnosing sync failures and reconciliation discrepancies
    • Participate in integration testing and release validation
    • Document integration behaviors and support models

﻿﻿﻿Technical Art working & Template Governance﻿

  • Structured Artwork & InDesign Expertise
    • ﻿Build robust INDD files using structured paragraph/character/object/table styles and GREP styles
    • Recreate supplied artwork into reusable, templated-ready structures
    • Apply scripting awareness (Extend Script/UXP) for light automation
  • Print Production & Preflight Control
    • ﻿Prepare assets for proof and production (resolution, color space, transparency, vector integrity)
    • Detect and correct print risks (overprint, rich black, missing fonts, excessive ink)
    • Output certified PDFs (e.g., PDF/X) with correct ICC profiles
    • Manage font licensing, embedding, and substitution risks
  • INFIGO Templating
    • ﻿Create and maintain INFIGO templates, output presets, and render settings
    • Bind dataset fields, build repeaters/tables, manage pagination
    • Implement conditional logic and regex validation
    • Review legacy Page DNA configurations and assess redesign needs

Data Preparation & Validation

  • Clean and normalize datasets (Power Query, Excel advanced functions)
  • Implement validation lists and structured error flagging
  • Produce ingestion-ready tables
  • Export predictable UTF-8 CSVs with correct delimiter discipline

QA, Monitoring & Release Control

  • Develop regression packs and golden datasets
  • Maintain structured release notes and rollback paths
  • Track integration health metrics (render SLA, webhook latency)
  • Use version control (Git or similar) for configuration tracking
  • Maintain operational dashboards (orders, adoption, SLA, fulfilment sync)

﻿﻿﻿﻿Successful candidates must have:

    • 3–6+ years Web2Print platform experience
    • Strong hands-on experience with INFIGO
    • Experience configuring both print and finished goods products
    • Exposure to WMS/ERP integrations in an eCommerce or fulfilment environment
    • Advanced Adobe InDesign knowledge in structured template building
    • Experience operating within structured Dev/Test/Prod environments

jobs.description:
The Director, Customer Success — US Manufacturing is a critical post-sales leadership role within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG), responsible for driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion across a defined portfolio of US Manufacturing accounts. Reporting to the Senior Director / General Manager of US Manufacturing, this leader will own approximately half of the manufacturing book of business — operating as a general manager accountable for portfolio health, revenue growth, AI adoption, and go-to-market execution.

This is not a maintenance role. We are looking for a commercially minded operator who has driven demonstrable YoY growth through active management of a large book of business, sharp GTM definition, and disciplined cross-functional engagement. You will lead a team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Customer Success Engineers (CSEs), serve as a trusted advisor to manufacturing CIOs and board-level executives, and partner closely with peer CEG functions, Sales, Delivery, and Product to ensure customers realize the full value of their ServiceNow investment and see us as a long-term digital transformation partner.

What You Get to Do in This Role:

  • Run the Business as a General Manager: Own the full health and commercial performance of your manufacturing portfolio. Drive GRR, NRR, and renewal performance, through proactive risk management, downsell reduction, and expansion motions. You will be expected to deliver strong YoY growth — not just protect the base, but actively grow it through strategic GTM planning and disciplined execution.
  • Define and Drive Go-to-Market Execution: Shape and execute the GTM strategy for your half of the manufacturing business — including coverage models, account prioritization, services attach, and AI consumption motions. Partner with Sales leadership

to align on account strategy, pipeline development, and renewal forecasting with precision and commercial rigor.

  • Lead as a Servant Leader: Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of CSMs and CSEs grounded in a servant leadership philosophy. Put your people first — remove obstacles, invest in their development, create psychological safety, and hold the team to high standards with empathy and accountability. Foster a culture where coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are the norm.
  • Engage at the Executive Level and Be a Strategic Advisor: Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite, executive, and other board-level stakeholders at key manufacturing accounts. Co-develop digital transformation strategies in IT with customer executives, positioning ServiceNow as the strategic platform partner for their modernization and AI agendas. Your executive presence and credibility at this level must be a proven strength, not an aspiration.
  • Tell the Story Through Data: Deliver compelling executive presentations — both internally and to customers — that articulate the value of ServiceNow's service offerings through data-driven narratives. You are equally effective presenting a portfolio business review to your leadership team and standing in front of a customer CIO making the case for platform expansion. Strong presentation skills and the ability to build a persuasive story from complex data are essential.
  • Drive AI Consumption and Platform Adoption: Own AI Consumption as a strategic KPI within your portfolio. Design and execute adoption journeys that convert license entitlements into measurable business outcomes, with a focus on emerging agentic capabilities.
  • Champion the Voice of the Customer: Synthesize industry-specific feedback, feature requests, and adoption blockers into structured input for Product Engineering and roadmap prioritization. Stay current on manufacturing industry trends, regulatory environments, and digital transformation priorities shaping your accounts.
  • Operationalize CEG Performance: Define and manage operational KPIs cascaded to all team members. Deliver regular reporting on customer health, adoption trends, downsell risk, and advocacy pipeline. Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms to automate insights and drive proactive outreach at scale.

---

The ideal candidate is a commercially sharp general manager who has owned a large book of business ($400M+), driven measurable growth, and built the GTM motions to sustain it. You combine deep post-sales expertise with the executive presence to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing CIOs and the servant leadership instincts to build a team that performs at the highest level. You are a recognized thought leader — someone whose perspective on customer success, digital transformation, or the manufacturing industry carries weight in external forums, not just internal meetings.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • AI Driven: Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Educational Background: BA/BS or equivalent required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience: 10–15 years of Go-To-Market leadership in technology or SaaS organizations, with at least 7–10 years in Customer Success, Customer Operations, or Delivery roles.
  • General Management of a Large Book of Business: Demonstrated experience operating as a general manager with full accountability for a portfolio of $400M+ in ACV — owning the P&L, coverage model, and commercial outcomes, not just customer health scores. Proven track record of delivering strong YoY growth through active management, not passive stewardship.
  • GTM Strategy and Execution: History of defining and executing go-to-market strategies that drive measurable results — including account segmentation, coverage optimization, services attach, and expansion pipeline development. You don't just run plays; you design them.
  • Business Acumen: Exceptional commercial instincts. You think in portfolio economics, understand the interplay between adoption, consumption, and revenue, and can translate customer outcomes into business impact narratives that resonate with Finance, Sales leadership, and your own team.
  • Executive Presence and C-Suite Engagement: Proven ability to engage at the C-suite and board level — both with customers and internally. Direct experience partnering with CIOs and senior IT executives to co-develop digital transformation strategies. You bring gravitas, credibility, and the ability to influence at the highest levels without relying on positional authority.
  • Presentation Skills and Data Storytelling: Exceptional ability to build and deliver executive-level presentations that articulate a clear, compelling story through data. You can translate complex portfolio performance, adoption metrics, and value realization into narratives that drive decisions — whether presenting to a customer executive committee or an internal leadership review.
  • Recognized Thought Leadership: A visible point of view on post-sales excellence, customer success, digital transformation, or the manufacturing industry. jobs.title: Threat Detection Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Join the mission to make the digital world safer.
jobs.description:
Join the mission to make the digital world safer.

About Team Cymru

Team Cymru's mission is to save and improve human lives by helping public and private sector analysts track and take down cybercriminals. We provide visibility into global cyber threat activity and are a key intelligence source for leading cybersecurity and threat intelligence vendors.

Our Pure Signal™ platform gives enterprise security teams on-demand access to global internet traffic telemetry, providing clarity into what's happening across the internet with a level of visibility comparable to their own internal networks. This allows organizations to close detection gaps, accelerate incident response, and get ahead of critical, recurring threats.

Team Cymru is a fast-paced, distribution-focused, private equity-backed company where your work directly supports a mission that protects millions worldwide.

We're looking for a Threat Detection Analyst to serve as the bridge between detection engineering and intelligence research. You'll develop and guide custom detections for the most active network-based threats, while writing for both practitioner and senior leadership audiences. Your work will power our analytical tools, data analytics systems, and analysis automation, and will help our customers complete their security and intelligence missions effectively. This role suits an analyst who has strong analytic tradecraft, is technically proficient, and is energized by the mission-driven, high-signal nature of threat intelligence work.

Key Responsibilities:

Detection Engineering

  • Translate research findings into durable detection rules and processes that build automated tracking mechanisms for ongoing monitoring of threats and adversary groups
  • Generate detection rules for network infrastructure based on internal datasets, including PDNS, X.509, service banners, NetFlow, and more
  • Develop multi-stage infrastructure detection processes involving sophisticated queries across multiple datasets and advanced filtering
  • Build, maintain, and expand detection process infrastructure on K8s, bare-metal, and virtualized servers
  • Conduct quality assurance (QA) reviews on candidate detections developed by teammates

Threat Research

  • Conduct proactive research into threat actors, malware families, campaigns, and evolving TTPs to deepen Team Cymru's body of knowledge
  • Lead short- and long-term threat tracking projects, identifying intelligence gaps and proposing targeted research to address collection shortfalls
  • Perform deep network traffic and infrastructure analysis to support customer requests and independent research, using Team Cymru's unique global dataset
  • Analyze PCAP, NetFlow, passive DNS (PDNS), open ports, certificates, and other datasets to map malicious infrastructure and identify related threat actor assets
  • Produce written products (internal assessments, customer-facing reports, blog articles, presentations) that clearly communicate threat research to practitioner and senior leadership audiences

Collaboration

  • Work closely with colleagues on the development of tools, data analytics systems, research methodologies, and automated analysis capabilities
  • Leverage analytic and data expertise to support our Sales and Outreach teams
  • Participate in working groups, industry events, and community collaboration as a representative of Team Cymru's intelligence capability

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a threat intelligence analyst, network forensics analyst, or IT security analyst
  • Experience coding with Python, database technologies (e.g. PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), code collaboration tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub), and AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience developing network-level threat detection rules derived from querying and analyzing large, disparate datasets
  • Proven track record of leading complex analytical projects, including managing multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Experience tracking APT, nation-state, or cybercriminal actors, with the ability to place their activity in a broader geopolitical or strategic context
  • Outstanding network infrastructure and traffic analysis skills: PCAP, NetFlow, PDNS, open ports, certificates
  • Deep working knowledge of IP networking and internet services: DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, VPNs, and routing protocols (BGP)
  • Strong familiarity with common OSINT platforms and research techniques
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a distributed, remote team, including a willingness to conduct peer review and share tradecraft
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills

Additional Skills

  • Experience using structured analysis techniques, estimative language, and confidence levels; comfortable forming assessments from incomplete or ambiguous data
  • Hands-on experience managing remote Linux servers and engineering custom proof-of-concept tools to extract, simulate, or generate unique threat data
  • Working understanding of malware and network analysis: YARA, Zeek, Suricata, sandbox reporting
  • Familiarity with using AI systems to rapidly prototype analytical tools and proof-of-concept projects
  • Exposure to malware reverse engineering, including static and dynamic analysis and common tooling (e.g. Binary Ninja, Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg)
  • Familiarity with the operational structures of hosting providers, ISPs, and internet exchanges, including how infrastructure is provisioned, attributed, and abused by threat actors

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience (preferred)

Travel

Occasional travel for industry events and customer engagements may be required.

Why Join Team Cymru?

At Team Cymru, we provide unmatched global threat intelligence that empowers organizations to proactively disrupt adversaries. You'll be at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, helping customers harness the full power of our threat intelligence to achieve critical business and security outcomes.

We offer a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your expertise and impact will directly contribute to improving global security. Our culture is fast-paced, team-oriented, and mission-focused, with ample opportunities to explore, research, and develop new and unique solutions.

We recognize that no candidate will tick every box on this list. If you have strong foundations in threat intelligence and a genuine passion for the work, we encourage you to apply regardless of whether you meet every requirement.

Ready to make an impact? Apply now and join a team protecting millions worldwide.

This job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve as needed. Team Cymru is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. This is a remote position.
